declarations.statement:
theorem gmReflectionRatio_mul_primitiveDeriv {tau v : ℝ}
    (hv : v ≠ 0) (hstat : tau - 2 * Real.pi * v ≠ 0) :
    gmReflectionRatio tau v *
        (((tau / v - 2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          Complex.exp
            ((((tau * Real.log v - 2 * Real.pi * v : ℝ) : ℂ) * I))) =
      (v : ℂ)⁻¹ * Complex.exp
        ((((tau * Real.log v - 2 * Real.pi * v : ℝ) : ℂ) * I))

declarations.name: gmReflectionIntegral_eq_parts
declarations.statement:
theorem gmReflectionIntegral_eq_parts {tau a b : ℝ}
    (hab : a ≤ b) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hstat : ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc a b, tau - 2 * Real.pi * v ≠ 0) :
    gmReflectionIntegral tau a b =
      gmReflectionRatio tau b * gmReflectionPrimitive tau b -
        gmReflectionRatio tau a * gmReflectionPrimitive tau a -
          ∫ v in a..b,
            ((2 * Real.pi / (tau - 2 * Real.pi * v) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) *
              gmReflectionPrimitive tau v

declarations.name: norm_gmReflectionIntegral_le_endpoint_variation
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_gmReflectionIntegral_le_endpoint_variation {tau a b : ℝ}
    (hab : a ≤ b) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hstat : ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc a b, tau - 2 * Real.pi * v ≠ 0) :
    ‖gmReflectionIntegral tau a b‖ ≤
      |tau - 2 * Real.pi * b|⁻¹ + |tau - 2 * Real.pi * a|⁻¹ +
        |gmReflectionRatioReal tau b - gmReflectionRatioReal tau a|

declarations.name: zero_normalized_mem
declarations.statement:
theorem zero_normalized_mem {k : ℝ} (hk : k ≠ 0) :

declarations.name: uniform_zero_modeIntegral
declarations.statement:
theorem uniform_zero_modeIntegral {w : ℝ → ℂ} (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w)

      Summable (fun m : ℤ => ‖nonzeroMode w L 0 m‖) ∧

declarations.statement: def sourcePhase (x : ℝ) : ℂ

declarations.name: fourier_scaled_modulated
declarations.statement:
theorem fourier_scaled_modulated
    (psi : ℝ → ℂ) {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) (y w : ℝ) :
    FourierTransform.fourier
        (fun v : ℝ => psi (A * v) * sourcePhase (y * v)) w =
      (A⁻¹ : ℝ) • FourierTransform.fourier psi ((w - y) / A)

declarations.name: scaled_modulated_poisson
declarations.statement:
theorem scaled_modulated_poisson
    (psi : ℝ → ℂ) (hpsi_compact : HasCompactSupport psi)
    (hpsi_smooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ psi) {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) (y : ℝ) :
    ∑' ell : ℤ, psi (A * ell) * sourcePhase (y * ell) =
      (A⁻¹ : ℝ) • ∑' j : ℤ,
        FourierTransform.fourier psi ((j - y) / A)

declarations.name: mellinConvergent_one_of_compactSupport
declarations.statement:
theorem mellinConvergent_one_of_compactSupport
    {f : ℝ → ℂ} (hf : Continuous f) (hcompact : HasCompactSupport f) :

declarations.name: verticalIntegrable_mellin_of_quadratic_decay
declarations.statement:
theorem verticalIntegrable_mellin_of_quadratic_decay
    {f : ℝ → ℂ} {C : ℝ}
    (hcontinuous : Continuous (fun r : ℝ =>
      mellin f ((1 : ℂ) + r * Complex.I)))
    (hdecay : ∀ r : ℝ,
      ‖mellin f ((1 : ℂ) + r * Complex.I)‖ ≤ C * (1 + r ^ 2)⁻¹) :
    Complex.VerticalIntegrable (mellin f) 1

declarations.name: mellin_inversion_line_one
declarations.statement:
theorem mellin_inversion_line_one
    (f : ℝ → ℂ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x)
    (hconv : MellinConvergent f (1 : ℂ))
    (hvertical : Complex.VerticalIntegrable (mellin f) 1)
    (hcontinuous : ContinuousAt f x) :
    f x =
      ((1 / (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        ∫ r : ℝ,
          (x : ℂ) ^ (-((1 : ℂ) + r * Complex.I)) *
            mellin f ((1 : ℂ) + r * Complex.I)

declarations.statement: def mellinLogLift (f : ℝ → ℂ) (u : ℝ) : ℂ

theorem mellinLogLift_hasCompactSupport

def mellinLogLiftSchwartz
    (f : ℝ → ℂ)

declarations.name: mellin_line_one_eq_fourier_logLift
declarations.statement:
theorem mellin_line_one_eq_fourier_logLift (f : ℝ → ℂ) (r : ℝ) :
    mellin f ((1 : ℂ) + r * Complex.I) =
      𝓕 (mellinLogLift f) (r / (2 * Real.pi))

declarations.name: scaledPower_mul_norm_mellin_line_one_le_seminorm
declarations.statement:
theorem scaledPower_mul_norm_mellin_line_one_le_seminorm
    {a b : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℂ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hsupport : ∀ x, x ∉ Set.Icc a b → f x = 0)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) f) (k : ℕ) (r : ℝ) :
    |r / (2 * Real.pi)| ^ k *
        ‖mellin f ((1 : ℂ) + r * Complex.I)‖ ≤
      SchwartzMap.seminorm ℂ k 0
        (𝓕 (mellinLogLiftSchwartz f
          (mellinLogLift_hasCompactSupport ha hb hsupport)
          (mellinLogLift_contDiff hf)) : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ))

declarations.name: norm_mellin_line_one_le_seminorm_div_scaledPower
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_mellin_line_one_le_seminorm_div_scaledPower
    {a b : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℂ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hsupport : ∀ x, x ∉ Set.Icc a b → f x = 0)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) f) (k : ℕ) {r : ℝ} (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    ‖mellin f ((1 : ℂ) + r * Complex.I)‖ ≤
      SchwartzMap.seminorm ℂ k 0
        (𝓕 (mellinLogLiftSchwartz f
          (mellinLogLift_hasCompactSupport ha hb hsupport)
          (mellinLogLift_contDiff hf)) : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) /
        |r / (2 * Real.pi)| ^ k

theorem fourier_logCutoff (w : ℝ → ℂ)

declarations.statement:
theorem scaled_log_poisson {w : ℝ → ℂ} (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w)

declarations.statement:
theorem cutoff_mellin_inversion {w : ℝ → ℂ} (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w)
    (hws : tsupport w ⊆ Icc (1 / 2 : ℝ) 5) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    w x = ((1 / (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ∫ r : ℝ,
      (x : ℂ) ^ (-((1 : ℂ) + r * Complex.I)) * mellin w ((1 : ℂ) + r * Complex.I)

declarations.name: summable_modeIntegral
declarations.statement:
theorem summable_modeIntegral {w : ℝ → ℂ} (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w)

declarations.name: summable_nat_logCutoff
tsum_int_logCutoff_eq_nat
declarations.statement:
theorem tsum_int_logCutoff_eq_nat {w : ℝ → ℂ}

declarations.name: poisson_nonzero_modes
declarations.statement:
theorem poisson_nonzero_modes {w : ℝ → ℂ} (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w)

    (∑' n : ℕ, w ((n : ℝ) / L) * dirichletPhase ((n : ℝ) / L) v) -

      (L : ℂ) * ∑' m : ℤ, nonzeroMode w L v m

theorem ReflectionCutoff.complex_support (w : ReflectionCutoff) :

declarations.statement: def retainedMode (w : ℝ → ℂ) (L H v : ℝ) (m : ℤ) : ℂ

declarations.statement: def reflectionBand (L H : ℝ) : Finset ℤ

theorem mem_reflectionBand (L H : ℝ) (m : ℤ) :

declarations.statement:
theorem tsum_retainedMode_eq_finite (w : ℝ → ℂ) (L H v : ℝ) :

      ∑ m ∈ reflectionBand L H, modeIntegral w v ((m : ℝ) * L)

declarations.statement: def bandContribution (w : ReflectionCutoff) (L H v : ℝ) : ℂ

declarations.name: nonzeroMode_eq_retained_add_discarded
declarations.statement:
theorem nonzeroMode_eq_retained_add_discarded (w : ℝ → ℂ) (L H v : ℝ) (m : ℤ) :
    nonzeroMode w L v m = retainedMode w L H v m + discardedMode w L H v m

declarations.name: hKernel_sub_bandContribution
declarations.statement:
theorem hKernel_sub_bandContribution (w : ReflectionCutoff) {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (H v : ℝ) :
    hKernel w L v - bandContribution w L H v =
      (L : ℂ) * ∑' m : ℤ, discardedMode (fun x => (w x : ℂ)) L H v m

declarations.name: uniform_fixedBand_and_diagonal_error
declarations.statement:
theorem uniform_fixedBand_and_diagonal_error (w : ReflectionCutoff) {A : ℕ} (hA : 1 < A) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ L H v : ℝ, 0 < L → 0 < H → H ≤ v → v ≤ 2 * H →
      ‖hKernel w L v - bandContribution w L H v‖ ≤ K * L / L ^ A ∧
      ‖hKernel w L 0‖ ≤ K * L / L ^ A

declarations.name: gmReflectionIntegral_add
declarations.statement:
theorem gmReflectionIntegral_add {tau a b c : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c) :
    gmReflectionIntegral tau a b + gmReflectionIntegral tau b c =
      gmReflectionIntegral tau a c

declarations.name: norm_gmReflectionIntegral_le_six_div_sqrt
norm_oscillatoryIntegral_le
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_oscillatoryIntegral_le {a b tau : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    ‖∫ z in a..b, (z : ℂ)⁻¹ *
      Complex.exp (I * ((tau * Real.log z - 2 * Real.pi * z : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ≤
        6 / Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi * a)

declarations.statement: theorem norm_dirichletPhase (x v : ℝ) : ‖dirichletPhase x v‖ = 1

declarations.statement: theorem norm_oscillatoryKernel (v r z : ℝ) : ‖oscillatoryKernel v r z‖ = |z|⁻¹

declarations.name: mellin_cpow_eq
declarations.statement:
theorem mellin_cpow_eq {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (r : ℝ) :
    (x : ℂ) ^ (-((1 : ℂ) + r * I)) = (x : ℂ)⁻¹ * dirichletPhase x (-r)

declarations.name: cutoff_mellin_inversion_phase
declarations.statement:
theorem cutoff_mellin_inversion_phase {w : ℝ → ℂ} (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w)
    (hws : tsupport w ⊆ Icc (1/2 : ℝ) 5) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    w x = ((1 / (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ∫ r : ℝ,
      (x : ℂ)⁻¹ * dirichletPhase x (-r) * mellinLine w r

declarations.name: scaled_mellin_phase
declarations.statement:
theorem scaled_mellin_phase {k z : ℝ} (hk : 0 < k) (hz : 0 < z) (v r : ℝ) :
    (k : ℂ)⁻¹ * (((z/k : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ * dirichletPhase (z/k) (-r)) *
        Complex.exp (I * ((v * Real.log (z/k) - 2*Real.pi*z : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
      dirichletPhase k (r-v) * oscillatoryKernel v r z

declarations.name: integrable_mellin_kernel
declarations.statement:
theorem integrable_mellin_kernel {w : ℝ → ℂ} (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w)
    (hws : tsupport w ⊆ Icc (1/2 : ℝ) 5) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (k v : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => mellinLine w p.2 *
      (dirichletPhase k (p.2-v) * oscillatoryKernel v p.2 p.1))
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc a b)).prod volume)

declarations.name: integrable_mellin_kernel_slice
declarations.statement:
theorem integrable_mellin_kernel_slice {w : ℝ → ℂ} (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w)
    (hws : tsupport w ⊆ Icc (1/2 : ℝ) 5) (k v z : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun r : ℝ => mellinLine w r *
      (dirichletPhase k (r-v) * oscillatoryKernel v r z))

declarations.name: mellin_kernel_integral_swap
declarations.statement:
theorem mellin_kernel_integral_swap {w : ℝ → ℂ} (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w)
    (hws : tsupport w ⊆ Icc (1/2 : ℝ) 5) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (k v : ℝ) :
    (∫ z in a..b, ∫ r : ℝ, mellinLine w r *
      (dirichletPhase k (r-v) * oscillatoryKernel v r z)) =
    ∫ r : ℝ, mellinLine w r * dirichletPhase k (r-v) *
      (∫ z in a..b, oscillatoryKernel v r z)

declarations.name: modeIntegral_scaled
scaled_cutoff_mellin
declarations.statement:
theorem scaled_cutoff_mellin {w : ℝ → ℂ} (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w)
    (hws : tsupport w ⊆ Icc (1/2 : ℝ) 5) {k z : ℝ} (hk : 0 < k) (hz : 0 < z)
    (v : ℝ) :
    (k : ℂ)⁻¹ * w (z/k) *
        Complex.exp (I * ((v * Real.log (z/k) - 2*Real.pi*z : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
      ((1/(2*Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ∫ r : ℝ,
        mellinLine w r * (dirichletPhase k (r-v) * oscillatoryKernel v r z)

declarations.name: modeIntegral_mellin_common
declarations.statement:
theorem modeIntegral_mellin_common {w : ℝ → ℂ} (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w)
    (hws : tsupport w ⊆ Icc (1/2 : ℝ) 5) {k a b : ℝ}
    (hk : 0 < k) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hlo : a ≤ k/2) (hhi : 5*k ≤ b)
    (v : ℝ) :
    modeIntegral w v k = ((1/(2*Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ∫ r : ℝ,
      mellinLine w r * dirichletPhase k (r-v) *
        (∫ z in a..b, oscillatoryKernel v r z)

declarations.name: band_modeIntegral_mellin
declarations.statement:
theorem band_modeIntegral_mellin {w : ℝ → ℂ} (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w)
    (hws : tsupport w ⊆ Icc (1/2 : ℝ) 5) {L H : ℝ}
    (hL : 0 < L) (hH : 0 < H) {m : ℤ} (hm : inReflectionBand L H m) (v : ℝ) :
    modeIntegral w v ((m : ℝ)*L) = ((1/(2*Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ∫ r : ℝ,

declarations.statement:

declarations.statement: def bandPhaseSum (L H v r : ℝ) : ℂ

declarations.name: mellinMass_nonneg
declarations.statement: theorem mellinMass_nonneg (w : ReflectionCutoff) : 0 ≤ mellinMass w

declarations.name: measurable_bandPhaseSum
declarations.statement: theorem measurable_bandPhaseSum (L H v : ℝ) : Measurable (bandPhaseSum L H v)

declarations.name: norm_bandPhaseSum_le
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_bandPhaseSum_le (L H v r : ℝ) :
    ‖bandPhaseSum L H v r‖ ≤ (reflectionBand L H).card

declarations.name: bandContribution_mellin
declarations.statement:
theorem bandContribution_mellin (w : ReflectionCutoff) {L H : ℝ}
    (hL : 0 < L) (hH : 0 < H) (v : ℝ) :
    bandContribution w L H v = ((L/(2*Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ∫ r : ℝ,
      mellinLine (fun x => (w x : ℂ)) r *
        (reflectionKernel H v r * bandPhaseSum L H v r)

declarations.name: norm_bandContribution_sq_le
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_bandContribution_sq_le (w : ReflectionCutoff) {L H : ℝ}
    (hL : 0 < L) (hH : 0 < H) (v : ℝ) :
    ‖bandContribution w L H v‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (500 / Real.pi^2) * mellinMass w * (L^2/H) *
        ∫ r, ‖mellinLine (fun x => (w x : ℂ)) r‖ * ‖bandPhaseSum L H v r‖ ^ 2

declarations.name: complete_pair_expansion
declarations.statement:
theorem complete_pair_expansion {ι κ : Type*} (Q : Finset ι) (U : Finset κ)
    (a : ι → κ → ℂ) (c : ι → ℂ) :
    ((∑ t ∈ U, ∑ u ∈ U,
      ‖∑ q ∈ Q, c q * (a q t * conj (a q u))‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) =
    ∑ q ∈ Q, ∑ r ∈ Q, c q * conj (c r) *
      ((‖∑ t ∈ U, a q t * conj (a r t)‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)

declarations.name: complete_pair_coefficient_domination
declarations.statement:
theorem complete_pair_coefficient_domination {ι κ : Type*} (Q : Finset ι) (U : Finset κ)
    (a : ι → κ → ℂ) (c : ι → ℂ) (hc : ∀ q ∈ Q, ‖c q‖ ≤ 1) :
    (∑ t ∈ U, ∑ u ∈ U, ‖∑ q ∈ Q, c q * (a q t * conj (a q u))‖ ^ 2) ≤
      ∑ t ∈ U, ∑ u ∈ U, ‖∑ q ∈ Q, a q t * conj (a q u)‖ ^ 2

declarations.name: dirichletPhase_sub
declarations.statement:
theorem dirichletPhase_sub (x t u : ℝ) :
    dirichletPhase x (t-u) = dirichletPhase x t * conj (dirichletPhase x u)

declarations.name: completePairEnergy_coefficient_domination
declarations.statement:
theorem completePairEnergy_coefficient_domination (M : ℕ) (U : Finset ℝ)
    (c : ℕ → ℂ) (hc : ∀ q ∈ Finset.Ico M (2*M), ‖c q‖ ≤ 1) :
    (∑ t ∈ U, ∑ u ∈ U, ‖∑ q ∈ Finset.Ico M (2*M),
      c q * dirichletPhase ((q : ℝ) / M) (t-u)‖ ^ 2) ≤ completePairEnergy M U

declarations.name: reflectionNatBand
declarations.statement: def reflectionNatBand (L H : ℝ) : Finset ℕ

declarations.name: mem_reflectionNatBand
declarations.statement:
theorem mem_reflectionNatBand (L H : ℝ) (m : ℕ) :
    m ∈ reflectionNatBand L H ↔ inReflectionBand L H (m : ℤ)

declarations.name: sum_reflectionBand_eq_nat
declarations.statement:
theorem sum_reflectionBand_eq_nat {E : Type*} [AddCommMonoid E]
    (L H : ℝ) (f : ℤ → E) :
    (∑ m ∈ reflectionBand L H, f m) = ∑ m ∈ reflectionNatBand L H, f (m : ℤ)

declarations.name: dyadicExponents
declarations.statement: def dyadicExponents (L H : ℝ) : Finset ℕ

declarations.name: reflectionBlocks
declarations.statement: def reflectionBlocks (L H : ℝ) : Finset ℕ

declarations.name: log2_block_bounds
declarations.statement: theorem log2_block_bounds {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) : 2^m.log2 ≤ m ∧ m < 2*(2^m.log2)

declarations.name: mem_dyadicExponents
declarations.statement:
theorem mem_dyadicExponents (L H : ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    j ∈ dyadicExponents L H ↔ ∃ m ∈ reflectionNatBand L H, m.log2 = j

declarations.name: dyadicExponent_scale_bounds
declarations.statement:
theorem dyadicExponent_scale_bounds {L H : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (_hH : 0 < H)
    {j : ℕ} (hj : j ∈ dyadicExponents L H) :
    H/(40*Real.pi*L) ≤ (2 : ℝ)^j ∧ (2 : ℝ)^j ≤ 4*H/(Real.pi*L)

declarations.name: dyadicExponents_card_le
declarations.statement:
theorem dyadicExponents_card_le {L H : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (hH : 0 < H) :
    (dyadicExponents L H).card ≤ 10

declarations.name: reflectionBlocks_card_le
declarations.statement:
theorem reflectionBlocks_card_le {L H : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (hH : 0 < H) :
    (reflectionBlocks L H).card ≤ 10

declarations.name: reflectionBlock_scale_bounds
declarations.statement:
theorem reflectionBlock_scale_bounds {L H : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (hH : 0 < H)
    {M : ℕ} (hM : M ∈ reflectionBlocks L H) :
    0 < M ∧ H/(40*Real.pi*L) ≤ (M : ℝ) ∧ (M : ℝ) ≤ 4*H/(Real.pi*L)

declarations.name: log2_eq_iff_block
declarations.statement:
theorem log2_eq_iff_block {m j : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) :
    m.log2 = j ↔ 2^j ≤ m ∧ m < 2*(2^j)

declarations.name: natBand_filter_log2
declarations.statement:
theorem natBand_filter_log2 (L H : ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    (reflectionNatBand L H).filter (fun m => m.log2 = j) =
      (Finset.Ico (2^j) (2*(2^j))).filter (fun m => m ∈ reflectionNatBand L H)

declarations.name: dirichletPhase_add
declarations.statement:
theorem dirichletPhase_add (x a b : ℝ) :
    dirichletPhase x (a+b) = dirichletPhase x a * dirichletPhase x b

declarations.name: dirichletPhase_mul
declarations.statement:
theorem dirichletPhase_mul {x y : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (v : ℝ) :
    dirichletPhase (x*y) v = dirichletPhase x v * dirichletPhase y v

declarations.name: blockCoefficient
declarations.statement: def blockCoefficient (L H r : ℝ) (q : ℕ) : ℂ

declarations.name: blockPolynomial
declarations.statement: def blockPolynomial (L H : ℝ) (M : ℕ) (r v : ℝ) : ℂ

declarations.name: norm_blockCoefficient_le
declarations.statement: theorem norm_blockCoefficient_le (L H r : ℝ) (q : ℕ) : ‖blockCoefficient L H r q‖ ≤ 1

declarations.name: fiber_phaseSum_eq
declarations.statement:
theorem fiber_phaseSum_eq {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (H v r : ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    (∑ q ∈ (reflectionNatBand L H).filter (fun q => q.log2 = j),
      dirichletPhase ((q : ℝ)*L) (r-v)) =
      dirichletPhase (((2^j : ℕ) : ℝ)*L) (-v) * blockPolynomial L H (2^j) r v

declarations.name: sum_reflectionBlocks
declarations.statement:
theorem sum_reflectionBlocks {E : Type*} [AddCommMonoid E] (L H : ℝ) (f : ℕ → E) :
    (∑ M ∈ reflectionBlocks L H, f M) = ∑ j ∈ dyadicExponents L H, f (2^j)

declarations.name: mem_reflectionBlocks_iff
declarations.statement:
theorem mem_reflectionBlocks_iff (L H : ℝ) (M : ℕ) :
    M ∈ reflectionBlocks L H ↔ ∃ j : ℕ, M = 2^j ∧
      ∃ m ∈ reflectionNatBand L H, M ≤ m ∧ m < 2*M

declarations.name: localIndices
declarations.statement: def localIndices (U : Finset ℝ) (H : ℝ) : Finset ℤ

declarations.name: mem_localSet_iff_floor
declarations.statement:
theorem mem_localSet_iff_floor {U : Finset ℝ} {H t : ℝ} (hH : 0 < H) (j : ℤ) :
    t ∈ localSet U H j ↔ t ∈ U ∧ ⌊t/H⌋-2 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ ⌊t/H⌋

declarations.name: mem_localIndices_iff
declarations.statement:
theorem mem_localIndices_iff {U : Finset ℝ} {H : ℝ} (hH : 0 < H) (j : ℤ) :
    j ∈ localIndices U H ↔ ∃ t ∈ U, t ∈ localSet U H j

declarations.name: localSet_eq_empty_of_notMem
declarations.statement:
theorem localSet_eq_empty_of_notMem {U : Finset ℝ} {H : ℝ} (hH : 0 < H)
    {j : ℤ} (hj : j ∉ localIndices U H) : localSet U H j = ∅

declarations.name: pair_mem_localSet
declarations.statement:
theorem pair_mem_localSet {U : Finset ℝ} {H t u : ℝ} (hH : 0 < H)
    (ht : t ∈ U) (hu : u ∈ U) (hclose : |t-u| < 2*H) :
    ∃ j ∈ localIndices U H, t ∈ localSet U H j ∧ u ∈ localSet U H j

declarations.name: sum_pairs_indicator
declarations.statement:
theorem sum_pairs_indicator {E : Type*} [AddCommMonoid E] {U V : Finset ℝ}
    (hVU : V ⊆ U) (F : ℝ → ℝ → E) :
    (∑ t ∈ U, ∑ u ∈ U, if t ∈ V ∧ u ∈ V then F t u else 0) =
      ∑ t ∈ V, ∑ u ∈ V, F t u

declarations.name: close_pairs_le_local_pairs
declarations.statement:
theorem close_pairs_le_local_pairs {U : Finset ℝ} {H : ℝ} (hH : 0 < H)
    (F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (hF : ∀ t u, 0 ≤ F t u) :
    (∑ t ∈ U, ∑ u ∈ U, if |t-u| < 2*H then F t u else 0) ≤
      ∑ j ∈ localIndices U H, ∑ t ∈ localSet U H j, ∑ u ∈ localSet U H j, F t u

declarations.name: tsum_completePairEnergy_localSet
declarations.statement:
theorem tsum_completePairEnergy_localSet {U : Finset ℝ} {H : ℝ} (hH : 0 < H) (M : ℕ) :
    (∑' j : ℤ, completePairEnergy M (localSet U H j)) =
      ∑ j ∈ localIndices U H, completePairEnergy M (localSet U H j)

declarations.name: localIndices_filter_point
declarations.statement:
theorem localIndices_filter_point {U : Finset ℝ} {H t : ℝ} (hH : 0 < H) (ht : t ∈ U) :
    (localIndices U H).filter (fun j => t ∈ localSet U H j) =
      Finset.Icc (⌊t/H⌋-2) ⌊t/H⌋

declarations.name: sum_card_localSet
declarations.statement:
theorem sum_card_localSet {U : Finset ℝ} {H : ℝ} (hH : 0 < H) :
    (∑ j ∈ localIndices U H, (localSet U H j).card) = 3*U.card

declarations.name: tsum_card_localSet
declarations.statement:
theorem tsum_card_localSet {U : Finset ℝ} {H : ℝ} (hH : 0 < H) :
    (∑' j : ℤ, ((localSet U H j).card : ℝ)) = 3*(U.card : ℝ)

declarations.name: localSet_pair_distance
declarations.statement:
theorem localSet_pair_distance {U : Finset ℝ} {H : ℝ} {j : ℤ} {t u : ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ localSet U H j) (hu : u ∈ localSet U H j) : |t-u| < 3*H

declarations.name: norm_bandPhaseSum_sq_le_blocks
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_bandPhaseSum_sq_le_blocks {L H : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (hH : 0 < H) (v r : ℝ) :
    ‖bandPhaseSum L H v r‖ ^ 2 ≤
      10 * ∑ M ∈ reflectionBlocks L H, ‖blockPolynomial L H M r v‖ ^ 2

declarations.name: complete_pairs_block_le
declarations.statement:
theorem complete_pairs_block_le (L H : ℝ) (M : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (U : Finset ℝ) :
    (∑ t ∈ U, ∑ u ∈ U, ‖blockPolynomial L H M r (t-u)‖ ^ 2) ≤ completePairEnergy M U

declarations.name: close_pairs_block_le_local
declarations.statement:
theorem close_pairs_block_le_local (L : ℝ) {H : ℝ} (hH : 0 < H)
    (M : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (U : Finset ℝ) :
    (∑ t ∈ U, ∑ u ∈ U, if |t-u| < 2*H then
      ‖blockPolynomial L H M r (t-u)‖ ^ 2 else 0) ≤
      ∑' j : ℤ, completePairEnergy M (localSet U H j)

declarations.name: localReflectionEnergy
declarations.statement: def localReflectionEnergy (L H : ℝ) (U : Finset ℝ) : ℝ

declarations.name: positiveShell
declarations.statement: def positiveShell (H : ℝ) (U : Finset ℝ) (F : ℝ → ℝ) : ℝ

declarations.name: localReflectionEnergy_nonneg
declarations.statement:
theorem localReflectionEnergy_nonneg (L H : ℝ) (U : Finset ℝ) :
    0 ≤ localReflectionEnergy L H U

declarations.name: positiveShell_bandPhaseSum_le
declarations.statement:
theorem positiveShell_bandPhaseSum_le {L H : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (hH : 0 < H)
    (r : ℝ) (U : Finset ℝ) :
    positiveShell H U (fun v => ‖bandPhaseSum L H v r‖ ^ 2) ≤
      10 * localReflectionEnergy L H U

declarations.name: positiveShell_integral
declarations.statement:
theorem positiveShell_integral {H : ℝ} (U : Finset ℝ) (F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hi : ∀ v, Integrable (F v)) :
    positiveShell H U (fun v => ∫ r, F v r) = ∫ r, positiveShell H U (fun v => F v r)

declarations.name: integrable_positiveShell
declarations.statement:
theorem integrable_positiveShell {H : ℝ} (U : Finset ℝ) (F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hi : ∀ v, Integrable (F v)) :
    Integrable (fun r => positiveShell H U (fun v => F v r))

declarations.name: positiveShell_const_mul
declarations.statement:
theorem positiveShell_const_mul (H : ℝ) (U : Finset ℝ) (c : ℝ) (F : ℝ → ℝ) :
    positiveShell H U (fun v => c * F v) = c * positiveShell H U F

declarations.name: positiveShell_mono
positiveShell_bandContribution_le
declarations.statement:
theorem positiveShell_bandContribution_le (w : ReflectionCutoff) {L H : ℝ}
    (hL : 0 < L) (hH : 0 < H) (U : Finset ℝ) :
    positiveShell H U (fun v => ‖bandContribution w L H v‖ ^ 2) ≤
      (5000/Real.pi^2) * (mellinMass w)^2 * (L^2/H) * localReflectionEnergy L H U

declarations.name: dirichletPhase_neg
declarations.statement: theorem dirichletPhase_neg (x v : ℝ) : dirichletPhase x (-v) = conj (dirichletPhase x v)

declarations.name: hKernel_neg
declarations.statement:
theorem hKernel_neg (w : ReflectionCutoff) (L v : ℝ) :
    hKernel w L (-v) = conj (hKernel w L v)

declarations.name: norm_hKernel_neg
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_hKernel_neg (w : ReflectionCutoff) (L v : ℝ) :
    ‖hKernel w L (-v)‖ = ‖hKernel w L v‖

declarations.name: shellEnergy_eq_twice_positive
declarations.statement:
theorem shellEnergy_eq_twice_positive (w : ReflectionCutoff) (L : ℝ)
    {H : ℝ} (hH : 0 < H) (U : Finset ℝ) :
    shellEnergy w L H U = 2 * positiveShell H U (fun v => ‖hKernel w L v‖ ^ 2)

declarations.name: positiveShell_add
declarations.statement:
theorem positiveShell_add (H : ℝ) (U : Finset ℝ) (F G : ℝ → ℝ) :
    positiveShell H U (fun v => F v + G v) = positiveShell H U F + positiveShell H U G

declarations.name: positiveShell_const_le
declarations.statement:
theorem positiveShell_const_le (H : ℝ) (U : Finset ℝ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) :
    positiveShell H U (fun _ => c) ≤ (U.card : ℝ)^2 * c

declarations.name: error_power_eq
declarations.statement:
theorem error_power_eq {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (A : ℕ) :
    (L/L^A)^2 = L ^ (2 - 2*(A : ℝ))

declarations.name: hKernel_sq_le_band_error
declarations.statement:
theorem hKernel_sq_le_band_error (w : ReflectionCutoff) (L H v E : ℝ)
    (he : ‖hKernel w L v - bandContribution w L H v‖ ≤ E) :
    ‖hKernel w L v‖^2 ≤ 2*‖bandContribution w L H v‖^2 + 2*E^2

declarations.name: uniform_reflection
declarations.statement:
theorem uniform_reflection (w : ReflectionCutoff) {A : ℕ} (hA : 1 < A) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (L H : ℝ) (U : Finset ℝ), 0 < L → 0 < H →
      shellEnergy w L H U ≤
        (20000/Real.pi^2) * (mellinMass w)^2 * (L^2/H) * localReflectionEnergy L H U +
          4*K^2*(U.card : ℝ)^2 * L ^ (2-2*(A : ℝ)) ∧
      (∑ _t ∈ U, ‖hKernel w L 0‖ ^ 2) ≤ K^2*(U.card : ℝ) * L ^ (2-2*(A : ℝ))

declarations.name: detectingPolynomial
declarations.statement: def detectingPolynomial (N : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) (t : ℝ) : ℂ

declarations.name: kernelEnergy
declarations.statement: def kernelEnergy (w : ReflectionCutoff) (L : ℝ) (U : Finset ℝ) : ℝ

declarations.name: oneSeparated
declarations.statement: def oneSeparated (U : Finset ℝ) : Prop

declarations.name: intervalSpan
declarations.statement: def intervalSpan (U : Finset ℝ) : ℝ

declarations.name: localDiameter
declarations.statement: def localDiameter (U : Finset ℝ) : ℝ

declarations.statement: def divisorMaximum (T : ℝ) : ℕ

declarations.name: bootstrapScalar
declarations.statement: def bootstrapScalar (T : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (V : ℝ) : ℝ

declarations.name: LargeValueData
declarations.statement:
structure LargeValueData (κ : ℝ) where
  T : ℝ
  N : ℕ
  V : ℝ
  a : ℕ → ℂ
  W : Finset ℝ
  t₀ : ℝ
  T_ge_two : 2 ≤ T
  N_pos : 0 < N
  V_pos : 0 < V
  scale_lower : T ^ (1/3 : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ)
  scale_upper : (N : ℝ) ≤ T
  height : (N : ℝ) ^ (3/4+κ) ≤ V
  coefficients : ∀ n ∈ Finset.Ioc N (2*N), ‖a n‖ ≤ 1
  location : ∀ t ∈ W, t₀ ≤ t ∧ t ≤ t₀+T
  separated : oneSeparated W
  large : ∀ t ∈ W, V ≤ ‖detectingPolynomial N a t‖

declarations.name: detectingPolynomial_norm_le
LargeValueData.height_le_length
declarations.statement:
theorem LargeValueData.height_le_length {κ : ℝ} (d : LargeValueData κ) (hW : d.W.Nonempty) :
    d.V ≤ d.N

declarations.name: kernelEnergy_nonneg
declarations.statement:
theorem kernelEnergy_nonneg (w : ReflectionCutoff) (L : ℝ) (U : Finset ℝ) :
    0 ≤ kernelEnergy w L U

declarations.name: oneSeparated_subset
declarations.statement: theorem oneSeparated_subset {U W : Finset ℝ} (hW : oneSeparated W) (hU : U ⊆ W) : oneSeparated U

declarations.name: ComparisonCutoff
declarations.statement:
structure ComparisonCutoff extends ReflectionCutoff where
  nonneg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ toFun x
  one_on : ∀ x ∈ Icc (1 : ℝ) 4, toFun x = 1

instance : CoeFun ComparisonCutoff (fun _ => ℝ → ℝ)

declarations.name: comparisonCutoff
declarations.statement: def comparisonCutoff : ComparisonCutoff

declarations.name: cutoffIntegral_quadratic_decay
declarations.statement:
theorem cutoffIntegral_quadratic_decay (w : ReflectionCutoff) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ v : ℝ, ‖cutoffIntegral w v‖ ≤ C/(1+|v|)^2

declarations.name: productPairs
declarations.statement: def productPairs (N M : ℕ) : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)

declarations.name: productMultiplicity
declarations.statement: def productMultiplicity (N M m : ℕ) : ℕ

declarations.name: productMultiplicity_le_divisors
declarations.statement:
theorem productMultiplicity_le_divisors {N M m : ℕ} (hm : m ≠ 0) :
    productMultiplicity N M m ≤ m.divisors.card

declarations.name: product_range
declarations.statement:
theorem product_range {N M : ℕ} (_hN : 0 < N) (hM : 0 < M)
    {p : ℕ × ℕ} (hp : p ∈ productPairs N M) :
    0 < p.1*p.2 ∧ N*M < p.1*p.2 ∧ p.1*p.2 < 4*(N*M)

declarations.name: divisorMaximum_ge_one
declarations.statement: theorem divisorMaximum_ge_one {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 ≤ T) : 1 ≤ divisorMaximum T

declarations.name: original_product_divisors_le
declarations.statement:
theorem original_product_divisors_le {T : ℝ} {N M : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hscale : (N : ℝ)*M ≤ 8*(T+1)) {p : ℕ × ℕ} (hp : p ∈ productPairs N M) :
    (p.1*p.2).divisors.card ≤ divisorMaximum T

declarations.name: product_cutoff_one
declarations.statement:
theorem product_cutoff_one (w : ComparisonCutoff) {N M : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (hM : 0 < M)
    {p : ℕ × ℕ} (hp : p ∈ productPairs N M) :
    w (((p.1*p.2 : ℕ) : ℝ)/((N : ℝ)*M)) = 1

declarations.name: product_grouping_cutoff
declarations.statement:
theorem product_grouping_cutoff (w : ComparisonCutoff) {T : ℝ} {N M : ℕ}
    (hN : 0 < N) (hM : 0 < M) (hscale : (N : ℝ)*M ≤ 8*(T+1))
    (F : ℕ → ℝ) (hF : ∀ m, 0 ≤ F m) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc N (2*N), ∑ q ∈ Finset.Ico M (2*M), F (n*q)) ≤
      (divisorMaximum T : ℝ) *
        ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (⌈5*((N : ℝ)*M)⌉₊+1), w (m/((N : ℝ)*M))*F m

declarations.name: exponent_linear_le_geometric
declarations.statement:
theorem exponent_linear_le_geometric {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ ∀ e : ℕ, (e : ℝ)+1 ≤ C*((2 : ℝ)^η)^e

declarations.name: exponent_linear_le_two_pow
declarations.statement: theorem exponent_linear_le_two_pow (e : ℕ) : (e : ℝ)+1 ≤ (2 : ℝ)^e

declarations.name: divisor_card_subpower
declarations.statement:
theorem divisor_card_subpower {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → (n.divisors.card : ℝ) ≤ C*(n : ℝ)^η

declarations.name: poleShift_sub_one_identity

    (afeCriticalPoint (-t) + w) * (1 - (afeCriticalPoint (-t) + w)) /

      Real.exp (100*c^2-100*u^2) *
        ‖hughesYoungAuxiliaryZero ((c:ℂ)+(u:ℂ)*I)‖ *
        ‖zetaSquarePoleShift t ((c:ℂ)+(u:ℂ)*I)‖ *
        ‖(Complex.Gammaℝ (afeCriticalPoint (-t)+((c:ℂ)+(u:ℂ)*I)) /
          Complex.Gammaℝ (afeCriticalPoint (-t)))^2‖ /
        ‖(c:ℂ)+(u:ℂ)*I‖

        LSeries (fun n : ℕ => (n.divisors.card:ℂ))
          (afeCriticalPoint (-t)+(1+(u:ℂ)*I))

declarations.name: amplitude_derivative_norm_le

theorem amplitude_derivative_norm_le {t : ℝ} (ht : 4 ≤ t)

    {H x : ℝ} (hH : 1 ≤ H) (hx : |x| ≤ 1) :
    ‖zetaDivisorWeightKernel q ((x : ℂ) + (H : ℂ) * I)‖ ≤
      (625 * Real.exp (100 + |q.re| + q.im ^ 2 / 2)) *
        Real.exp (-99 * H ^ 2) * (2 + H) ^ 8

declarations.name: tendsto_zetaDivisorWeight_horizontal_zero
declarations.statement:
theorem tendsto_zetaDivisorWeight_horizontal_zero (q : ℂ) :
    Tendsto (fun H : ℝ => HIntegral' (zetaDivisorWeightKernel q) (-1) 1 H) atTop (𝓝 0)

declarations.name: hIntegral_zetaDivisorWeight_bottom
declarations.statement:
theorem hIntegral_zetaDivisorWeight_bottom (q : ℂ) (H : ℝ) :
    HIntegral (zetaDivisorWeightKernel q) (-1) 1 (-H) =
      -HIntegral (zetaDivisorWeightKernel (-q)) (-1) 1 H

declarations.name: vIntegral_zetaDivisorWeight_left
declarations.statement:
theorem vIntegral_zetaDivisorWeight_left (q : ℂ) (H : ℝ) :
    VIntegral (zetaDivisorWeightKernel q) (-1) (-H) H =
      -VIntegral (zetaDivisorWeightKernel (-q)) 1 (-H) H

declarations.name: zetaDivisorWeight_truncated_reflection
declarations.statement:
theorem zetaDivisorWeight_truncated_reflection (q : ℂ) {H : ℝ} (hH : 0 < H) :
    VIntegral' (zetaDivisorWeightKernel q) 1 (-H) H +
      VIntegral' (zetaDivisorWeightKernel (-q)) 1 (-H) H -
      HIntegral' (zetaDivisorWeightKernel q) (-1) 1 H -
      HIntegral' (zetaDivisorWeightKernel (-q)) (-1) 1 H = 1

declarations.name: tendsto_zetaDivisorWeight_vertical
declarations.statement:
theorem tendsto_zetaDivisorWeight_vertical (q : ℂ) :
    Tendsto (fun H : ℝ => VIntegral' (zetaDivisorWeightKernel q) 1 (-H) H)
      atTop (𝓝 (zetaDivisorWeight q))

declarations.name: zetaDivisorWeight_add_neg
declarations.statement: theorem zetaDivisorWeight_add_neg (q : ℂ) : zetaDivisorWeight q + zetaDivisorWeight (-q) = 1

declarations.name: zetaDivisorWeight_zero
declarations.statement: theorem zetaDivisorWeight_zero : zetaDivisorWeight 0 = 1 / 2

declarations.name: exists_norm_zetaDivisorWeight_min_le
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_norm_zetaDivisorWeight_min_le {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ q : ℂ, |q.im| ≤ B →
      ‖zetaDivisorWeight q‖ ≤ C * min 1 (Real.exp (-q.re))

declarations.name: zetaDivisorWeightArgument
declarations.statement: def zetaDivisorWeightArgument (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℂ

declarations.name: zetaDivisorWeightArgument_re
declarations.statement:
theorem zetaDivisorWeightArgument_re (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (zetaDivisorWeightArgument t n).re = Real.log (n : ℝ) - Real.log (t / (2 * Real.pi))

declarations.name: zetaDivisorWeightArgument_im
declarations.statement:
theorem zetaDivisorWeightArgument_im (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (zetaDivisorWeightArgument t n).im = Real.pi / 2

declarations.name: divisorDirichletTerm_add_eq_mul_exp
declarations.statement:
theorem divisorDirichletTerm_add_eq_mul_exp (s w : ℂ) (n : ℕ) :
    divisorDirichletTerm (s + w) n =
      divisorDirichletTerm s n * Complex.exp (-((Real.log (n : ℝ) : ℂ)) * w)

declarations.name: zetaSquareLeadingDivisorTerm_eq_weightKernel
declarations.statement:
theorem zetaSquareLeadingDivisorTerm_eq_weightKernel (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (u : ℝ) :
    zetaSquareLeadingDivisorTerm t n u =
      (divisorDirichletTerm (afeCriticalPoint (-t)) n * zetaSquareReflectedGammaPhase t) *
        zetaDivisorWeightKernel (zetaDivisorWeightArgument t n) (1 + (u : ℂ) * I)

declarations.name: zetaSquareLeadingDivisorContribution_eq_weight
declarations.statement:
theorem zetaSquareLeadingDivisorContribution_eq_weight (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    zetaSquareLeadingDivisorContribution t n =
      divisorDirichletTerm (afeCriticalPoint (-t)) n * zetaSquareReflectedGammaPhase t *
        zetaDivisorWeight (zetaDivisorWeightArgument t n)

declarations.name: hasSum_zetaSquareLeadingDivisor_weighted
declarations.statement:
theorem hasSum_zetaSquareLeadingDivisor_weighted {t : ℝ} (ht : 4 ≤ t) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => divisorDirichletTerm (afeCriticalPoint (-t)) n *
      zetaSquareReflectedGammaPhase t * zetaDivisorWeight (zetaDivisorWeightArgument t n))
      (zetaSquareLeadingDivisorIntegral t)

declarations.name: exp_neg_zetaDivisorWeightArgument_re
declarations.statement:
theorem exp_neg_zetaDivisorWeightArgument_re {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    Real.exp (-(zetaDivisorWeightArgument t n).re) = t / (2 * Real.pi * (n : ℝ))

declarations.name: exists_norm_source_zetaDivisorWeight_min_le
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_norm_source_zetaDivisorWeight_min_le :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n →
      ‖zetaDivisorWeight (zetaDivisorWeightArgument t n)‖ ≤
        C * min 1 (t / (2 * Real.pi * (n : ℝ)))

declarations.name: zetaGaussianQuadraticCoefficient
declarations.statement: def zetaGaussianQuadraticCoefficient (T G : ℝ) : ℂ

declarations.name: zetaGaussianQuadraticIntegral
declarations.statement: def zetaGaussianQuadraticIntegral (T G v : ℝ) : ℂ

declarations.name: zetaGaussianQuadraticCoefficient_re
declarations.statement:
theorem zetaGaussianQuadraticCoefficient_re (T G : ℝ) :
    (zetaGaussianQuadraticCoefficient T G).re = 1 / G ^ 2

declarations.name: zetaGaussianQuadraticCoefficient_im
declarations.statement:
theorem zetaGaussianQuadraticCoefficient_im (T G : ℝ) :
    (zetaGaussianQuadraticCoefficient T G).im = 1 / (2 * T)

declarations.name: zetaGaussianQuadraticCoefficient_re_pos
declarations.statement:
theorem zetaGaussianQuadraticCoefficient_re_pos (T : ℝ) {G : ℝ} (hG : G ≠ 0) :
    0 < (zetaGaussianQuadraticCoefficient T G).re

declarations.name: zetaGaussianQuadraticIntegral_eq
declarations.statement:
theorem zetaGaussianQuadraticIntegral_eq (T v : ℝ) {G : ℝ} (hG : G ≠ 0) :
    zetaGaussianQuadraticIntegral T G v =
      ((Real.pi : ℂ) / zetaGaussianQuadraticCoefficient T G) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) *
        Complex.exp (-(v : ℂ) ^ 2 / (4 * zetaGaussianQuadraticCoefficient T G))

declarations.name: integrable_zetaGaussianQuadraticIntegrand
declarations.statement:
theorem integrable_zetaGaussianQuadraticIntegrand (T v : ℝ) {G : ℝ} (hG : G ≠ 0) :
    Integrable (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (I * (v : ℂ) * x) *
      Complex.exp (-zetaGaussianQuadraticCoefficient T G * x ^ 2))

declarations.name: inverse_re_lower_of_im_le_re
declarations.statement:
theorem inverse_re_lower_of_im_le_re {a : ℂ} (ha : 0 < a.re) (hi : |a.im| ≤ a.re) :
    1 / (2 * a.re) ≤ a⁻¹.re

declarations.name: norm_fourierGaussian_le_of_im_le_re
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_fourierGaussian_le_of_im_le_re {a : ℂ} (ha : 0 < a.re)
    (hi : |a.im| ≤ a.re) (v : ℝ) :
    ‖((Real.pi : ℂ) / a) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-(v : ℂ) ^ 2 / (4 * a))‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt (Real.pi / a.re) * Real.exp (-v ^ 2 / (8 * a.re))

declarations.name: norm_zetaGaussianQuadraticIntegral_le
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_zetaGaussianQuadraticIntegral_le {T G : ℝ}
    (hT : 0 < T) (hG : 0 < G) (hscale : G ^ 2 ≤ 2 * T) (v : ℝ) :
    ‖zetaGaussianQuadraticIntegral T G v‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt Real.pi * G * Real.exp (-(G * v) ^ 2 / 8)

declarations.name: norm_zetaGaussianQuadraticIntegral_tail
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_zetaGaussianQuadraticIntegral_tail {T G L v : ℝ}
    (hT : 0 < T) (hG : 0 < G) (hscale : G ^ 2 ≤ 2 * T)
    (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hfrequency : L ≤ G * |v|) :
    ‖zetaGaussianQuadraticIntegral T G v‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt Real.pi * G * Real.exp (-L ^ 2 / 8)

declarations.name: hasDerivAt_zetaGaussianQuadraticIntegral
declarations.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_zetaGaussianQuadraticIntegral (T : ℝ) {G : ℝ} (hG : G ≠ 0) (v : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (zetaGaussianQuadraticIntegral T G)
      (-(v : ℂ) / (2 * zetaGaussianQuadraticCoefficient T G) *
        zetaGaussianQuadraticIntegral T G v) v

declarations.name: inverse_norm_zetaGaussianQuadraticCoefficient_le
declarations.statement:
theorem inverse_norm_zetaGaussianQuadraticCoefficient_le (T : ℝ) {G : ℝ} (hG : G ≠ 0) :
    1 / ‖zetaGaussianQuadraticCoefficient T G‖ ≤ G ^ 2

declarations.name: norm_deriv_zetaGaussianQuadraticIntegral_le
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_deriv_zetaGaussianQuadraticIntegral_le {T G : ℝ}
    (hT : 0 < T) (hG : 0 < G) (hGT : G ^ 2 ≤ 2 * T) (v : ℝ) :
    ‖deriv (zetaGaussianQuadraticIntegral T G) v‖ ≤
      (Real.sqrt Real.pi * G ^ 3 / 2) * |v| * Real.exp (-(G * v) ^ 2 / 8)

declarations.name: abs_log_shift_sub_linear_le
declarations.statement:
theorem abs_log_shift_sub_linear_le {T x : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (hx : |x| ≤ T / 2) :
    |Real.log (T + x) - Real.log T - x / T| ≤ 2 * x ^ 2 / T ^ 2

declarations.name: zetaSquareGammaQuadraticAngle
declarations.statement: def zetaSquareGammaQuadraticAngle (T x : ℝ) : ℝ

declarations.name: hasDerivAt_zetaSquareGammaQuadraticAngle
declarations.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_zetaSquareGammaQuadraticAngle {T : ℝ} (hT : T ≠ 0) (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (zetaSquareGammaQuadraticAngle T)
      (Real.log (T / (2 * Real.pi)) + x / T) x

declarations.name: abs_zetaSquareGammaFrequency_linear_error_le
declarations.statement:
theorem abs_zetaSquareGammaFrequency_linear_error_le {T r x : ℝ}
    (hT : 4 ≤ T) (hr : r ≤ T / 2) (hx : |x| ≤ r) :
    |zetaSquareGammaFrequency (T + x) + Real.log (T / (2 * Real.pi)) + x / T| ≤
      18 / T + 2 * r ^ 2 / T ^ 2

declarations.name: demodulatedGammaPhase
declarations.statement: private def demodulatedGammaPhase (T x : ℝ) : ℂ

declarations.name: hasDerivAt_demodulatedGammaPhase
declarations.statement:
private theorem hasDerivAt_demodulatedGammaPhase {T : ℝ} (hT : T ≠ 0) (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (demodulatedGammaPhase T)
      (I * ((zetaSquareGammaFrequency (T + x) + Real.log (T / (2 * Real.pi)) + x / T : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        demodulatedGammaPhase T x) x

declarations.name: norm_zetaSquareReflectedGammaPhase_sub_quadratic_le
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_zetaSquareReflectedGammaPhase_sub_quadratic_le {T r x : ℝ}
    (hT : 4 ≤ T) (hr : r ≤ T / 2) (hx : |x| ≤ r) :
    ‖zetaSquareReflectedGammaPhase (T + x) -
      zetaSquareReflectedGammaPhase T *
        Complex.exp (-I * (zetaSquareGammaQuadraticAngle T x : ℂ))‖ ≤
      (18 / T + 2 * r ^ 2 / T ^ 2) * |x|

declarations.name: zetaSquareGammaQuadratic_gaussian_identity
declarations.statement:
theorem zetaSquareGammaQuadratic_gaussian_identity (T G v x : ℝ) :
    Complex.exp (-I * (zetaSquareGammaQuadraticAngle T x : ℂ)) *
      Complex.exp (I * (v : ℂ) * x) * ((Real.exp (-(x / G) ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      Complex.exp (I * ((v - Real.log (T / (2 * Real.pi)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * x) *
        Complex.exp (-zetaGaussianQuadraticCoefficient T G * (x : ℂ) ^ 2)

declarations.name: norm_integral_zetaSquareGammaPhase_sub_quadratic_le
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_integral_zetaSquareGammaPhase_sub_quadratic_le {T r G : ℝ}
    (hT : 4 ≤ T) (hr0 : 0 ≤ r) (hr : r ≤ T / 2) (v : ℝ) :
    ‖(∫ x in -r..r, zetaSquareReflectedGammaPhase (T + x) *
        Complex.exp (I * (v : ℂ) * x) * ((Real.exp (-(x / G) ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)) -
      zetaSquareReflectedGammaPhase T *
        ∫ x in -r..r, Complex.exp (I * ((v - Real.log (T / (2 * Real.pi)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * x) *
          Complex.exp (-zetaGaussianQuadraticCoefficient T G * (x : ℂ) ^ 2)‖ ≤
      2 * r ^ 2 * (18 / T + 2 * r ^ 2 / T ^ 2)

declarations.name: hasDerivAt_zetaDivisorWeightKernel_real
declarations.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_zetaDivisorWeightKernel_real (q : ℂ) {w : ℂ} (hw : w ≠ 0) (v : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => zetaDivisorWeightKernel (q + (x : ℂ)) w)
      (-zetaDivisorWeightNumerator (q + (v : ℂ)) w) v

declarations.name: norm_zetaDivisorWeightKernel_real_sub_le
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_zetaDivisorWeightKernel_real_sub_le {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    {q : ℂ} (hq : |q.im| ≤ B) (h u : ℝ) :
    ‖zetaDivisorWeightKernel (q + (h : ℂ)) (1 + (u : ℂ) * I) -
      zetaDivisorWeightKernel q (1 + (u : ℂ) * I)‖ ≤
      (625 * Real.exp (100 + B ^ 2 / 2)) * Real.exp (-q.re + |h|) *
        zetaDivisorWeightEnvelope u * |h|

declarations.name: exists_norm_zetaDivisorWeight_real_sub_le
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_norm_zetaDivisorWeight_real_sub_le {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ q : ℂ, |q.im| ≤ B → ∀ h : ℝ,
      ‖zetaDivisorWeight (q + (h : ℂ)) - zetaDivisorWeight q‖ ≤
        C * |h| * Real.exp |h| * Real.exp (-q.re)

declarations.name: exists_norm_zetaDivisorWeight_real_sub_min_le
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_norm_zetaDivisorWeight_real_sub_min_le {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ q : ℂ, |q.im| ≤ B → ∀ h : ℝ,
      ‖zetaDivisorWeight (q + (h : ℂ)) - zetaDivisorWeight q‖ ≤
        (C * |h| * Real.exp |h|) * min (Real.exp (-q.re)) (Real.exp q.re)

declarations.name: abs_log_height_shift_le
declarations.statement:
theorem abs_log_height_shift_le {T x : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (hx : |x| ≤ T / 2) :
    |Real.log (T + x) - Real.log T| ≤ 2 * |x| / T

declarations.name: zetaDivisorWeightArgument_height_shift
declarations.statement:
theorem zetaDivisorWeightArgument_height_shift {T x : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T)
    (hx : 0 < T + x) (n : ℕ) :
    zetaDivisorWeightArgument (T + x) n = zetaDivisorWeightArgument T n +
      ((Real.log T - Real.log (T + x) : ℝ) : ℂ)

declarations.name: exp_zetaDivisorWeightArgument_re
declarations.statement:
theorem exp_zetaDivisorWeightArgument_re {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    Real.exp (zetaDivisorWeightArgument T n).re = (2 * Real.pi * (n : ℝ)) / T

declarations.name: exists_norm_source_zetaDivisorWeight_height_sub_le
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_norm_source_zetaDivisorWeight_height_sub_le :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ T : ℝ, 0 < T → ∀ x : ℝ, |x| ≤ T / 2 → ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n →
      ‖zetaDivisorWeight (zetaDivisorWeightArgument (T + x) n) -
        zetaDivisorWeight (zetaDivisorWeightArgument T n)‖ ≤
      C * (|x| / T) * min (T / (2 * Real.pi * (n : ℝ))) ((2 * Real.pi * (n : ℝ)) / T)

declarations.name: min_one_le_rpow
declarations.statement:
theorem min_one_le_rpow {a θ : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (hθ1 : θ ≤ 1) :
    min 1 a ≤ a ^ θ

declarations.name: norm_divisorCritical_mul_ratio_rpow
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_divisorCritical_mul_ratio_rpow {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A)
    (t θ : ℝ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    ‖divisorDirichletTerm (afeCriticalPoint t) n‖ * (A / (n : ℝ)) ^ θ =
      A ^ θ * ‖divisorDirichletTerm ((1 / 2 + θ : ℝ) : ℂ) n‖

declarations.name: norm_divisorCritical_mul_min_le
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_divisorCritical_mul_min_le {A θ : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A)
    (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (hθ1 : θ ≤ 1) (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖divisorDirichletTerm (afeCriticalPoint t) n‖ * min 1 (A / (n : ℝ)) ≤
      A ^ θ * ‖divisorDirichletTerm ((1 / 2 + θ : ℝ) : ℂ) n‖

declarations.name: summable_divisorCritical_min
declarations.statement:
theorem summable_divisorCritical_min {A θ : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A)
    (hθ : 1 / 2 < θ) (hθ1 : θ ≤ 1) (t : ℝ) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => ‖divisorDirichletTerm (afeCriticalPoint t) n‖ * min 1 (A / (n : ℝ)))

declarations.name: tsum_divisorCritical_min_le
declarations.statement:
theorem tsum_divisorCritical_min_le {A θ : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A)
    (hθ : 1 / 2 < θ) (hθ1 : θ ≤ 1) (t : ℝ) :
    (∑' n : ℕ, ‖divisorDirichletTerm (afeCriticalPoint t) n‖ * min 1 (A / (n : ℝ))) ≤
      A ^ θ * ∑' n : ℕ, ‖divisorDirichletTerm ((1 / 2 + θ : ℝ) : ℂ) n‖

declarations.name: summable_norm_source_divisor_weight
declarations.statement:
theorem summable_norm_source_divisor_weight {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (t : ℝ) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => ‖divisorDirichletTerm (afeCriticalPoint t) n‖ *
      ‖zetaDivisorWeight (zetaDivisorWeightArgument T n)‖)

declarations.name: exists_tsum_norm_source_divisor_weight_le
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_tsum_norm_source_divisor_weight_le (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ T : ℝ, 1 ≤ T → ∀ t : ℝ,
      (∑' n : ℕ, ‖divisorDirichletTerm (afeCriticalPoint t) n‖ *
        ‖zetaDivisorWeight (zetaDivisorWeightArgument T n)‖) ≤ C * T ^ (1 / 2 + ε)

declarations.name: exists_tsum_divisorCritical_min_height_le
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_tsum_divisorCritical_min_height_le (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ T : ℝ, 1 ≤ T → ∀ t : ℝ,
      (∑' n : ℕ, ‖divisorDirichletTerm (afeCriticalPoint t) n‖ *
        min 1 (T / (2 * Real.pi * (n : ℝ)))) ≤ C * T ^ (1 / 2 + ε)

declarations.name: zetaSquareFrozenDivisorContribution
declarations.statement: def zetaSquareFrozenDivisorContribution (T x : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℂ

declarations.name: zetaSquareFrozenDivisorIntegral
declarations.statement: def zetaSquareFrozenDivisorIntegral (T x : ℝ) : ℂ

declarations.name: summable_zetaSquareFrozenDivisorContribution
declarations.statement:
theorem summable_zetaSquareFrozenDivisorContribution {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    Summable (zetaSquareFrozenDivisorContribution T x)

declarations.name: norm_zetaSquareDivisor_freezing_error
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_zetaSquareDivisor_freezing_error (T x : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖zetaSquareLeadingDivisorContribution (T + x) n - zetaSquareFrozenDivisorContribution T x n‖ =
      ‖divisorDirichletTerm (afeCriticalPoint (-(T + x))) n‖ *
        ‖zetaDivisorWeight (zetaDivisorWeightArgument (T + x) n) -
          zetaDivisorWeight (zetaDivisorWeightArgument T n)‖

declarations.name: min_self_inv_le_min_one
declarations.statement: theorem min_self_inv_le_min_one (a : ℝ) : min a a⁻¹ ≤ min 1 a

declarations.name: exists_norm_zetaSquareDivisor_freezing_error_le
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_norm_zetaSquareDivisor_freezing_error_le :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ T : ℝ, 0 < T → ∀ x : ℝ, |x| ≤ T / 2 → ∀ n : ℕ,
      ‖zetaSquareLeadingDivisorContribution (T + x) n - zetaSquareFrozenDivisorContribution T x n‖ ≤
        (C * (|x| / T)) * (‖divisorDirichletTerm (afeCriticalPoint (-(T + x))) n‖ *
          min 1 (T / (2 * Real.pi * (n : ℝ))))

declarations.name: exists_norm_zetaSquareLeadingDivisor_sub_frozen_le
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_norm_zetaSquareLeadingDivisor_sub_frozen_le (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ T : ℝ, 8 ≤ T → ∀ x : ℝ, |x| ≤ T / 2 →
      ‖zetaSquareLeadingDivisorIntegral (T + x) - zetaSquareFrozenDivisorIntegral T x‖ ≤
        C * |x| * T ^ (-1 / 2 + ε)

declarations.name: exists_norm_zetaSquareSource_sub_frozen_le
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_norm_zetaSquareSource_sub_frozen_le (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ T : ℝ, 8 ≤ T → ∀ x : ℝ, |x| ≤ T / 2 →
      ‖zetaSquareDivisorIntegral (-(T + x)) / zetaSquareGammaNormalization (T + x) -
        zetaSquareFrozenDivisorIntegral T x‖ ≤ C * (1 + |x| * T ^ (-1 / 2 + ε))

declarations.name: integrable_physical_gaussian
declarations.statement:
theorem integrable_physical_gaussian {G : ℝ} (hG : G ≠ 0) :
    Integrable (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (-(x / G) ^ 2))

declarations.name: physical_gaussian_tail_le
declarations.statement:
theorem physical_gaussian_tail_le {G r : ℝ} (hG : 0 < G) (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    (∫ x in (Ioc (-r) r)ᶜ, Real.exp (-(x / G) ^ 2)) ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * G * Real.exp (-(r / G) ^ 2 / 2)

declarations.name: norm_integral_sub_window_le
declarations.statement:
private theorem norm_integral_sub_window_le {f : ℝ → ℂ} {G r : ℝ}
    (hG : 0 < G) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hf : Integrable f)
    (hfn : ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ Real.exp (-(x / G) ^ 2)) :
    ‖(∫ x : ℝ, f x) - ∫ x in -r..r, f x‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * G * Real.exp (-(r / G) ^ 2 / 2)

theorem norm_zetaSquareGammaGaussianIntegrand (T G v x : ℝ) :

declarations.name: norm_quadratic_gaussian_integrand
declarations.statement:
private theorem norm_quadratic_gaussian_integrand (T v x : ℝ) {G : ℝ} (hG : G ≠ 0) :
    ‖Complex.exp (I * (v : ℂ) * x) *
      Complex.exp (-zetaGaussianQuadraticCoefficient T G * (x : ℂ) ^ 2)‖ =
      Real.exp (-(x / G) ^ 2)

declarations.name: norm_zetaSquareGammaGaussianTransform_sub_quadratic_le
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_zetaSquareGammaGaussianTransform_sub_quadratic_le {T G r : ℝ}
    (hT : 4 ≤ T) (hG : 0 < G) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrT : r ≤ T / 2) (v : ℝ) :
    ‖zetaSquareGammaGaussianTransform T G v - zetaSquareReflectedGammaPhase T *
      zetaGaussianQuadraticIntegral T G (v - Real.log (T / (2 * Real.pi)))‖ ≤
      2 * r ^ 2 * (18 / T + 2 * r ^ 2 / T ^ 2) +
        2 * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * G * Real.exp (-(r / G) ^ 2 / 2)

declarations.name: norm_zetaSquareGammaGaussianTransform_le
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_zetaSquareGammaGaussianTransform_le {T G r : ℝ}
    (hT : 4 ≤ T) (hG : 0 < G) (hGT : G ^ 2 ≤ 2 * T)
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrT : r ≤ T / 2) (v : ℝ) :
    ‖zetaSquareGammaGaussianTransform T G v‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt Real.pi * G * Real.exp (-(G * (v - Real.log (T / (2 * Real.pi)))) ^ 2 / 8) +
      2 * r ^ 2 * (18 / T + 2 * r ^ 2 / T ^ 2) +
        2 * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * G * Real.exp (-(r / G) ^ 2 / 2)

declarations.name: norm_zetaFrozenDivisorGaussianMean_sub_quadratic_le
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_zetaFrozenDivisorGaussianMean_sub_quadratic_le {T G r : ℝ}
    (hT : 4 ≤ T) (hG : 0 < G) (hGT : G ^ 2 ≤ 2 * T) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrT : r ≤ T / 2) :
    ‖zetaFrozenDivisorGaussianMean T G - zetaFrozenDivisorQuadraticSum T G‖ ≤
      (∑' n : ℕ, ‖zetaFrozenDivisorCoefficient T n‖) *
        (2 * r ^ 2 * (18 / T + 2 * r ^ 2 / T ^ 2) +

declarations.name: exists_norm_zetaFrozenDivisorGaussianMean_sub_quadratic_le

theorem exists_norm_zetaFrozenDivisorGaussianMean_sub_quadratic_le (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ T G r : ℝ, 4 ≤ T → 0 < G → G ^ 2 ≤ 2 * T →
      0 ≤ r → r ≤ T / 2 →
      ‖zetaFrozenDivisorGaussianMean T G - zetaFrozenDivisorQuadraticSum T G‖ ≤
        C * T ^ (1 / 2 + ε) *
          (2 * r ^ 2 * (18 / T + 2 * r ^ 2 / T ^ 2) +
            2 * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * G * Real.exp (-(r / G) ^ 2 / 2))

    zetaSquareGaussianWindow T G (r / G) =

declarations.name: exists_abs_zetaSquareGaussianWindow_sub_frozen_window_le
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_abs_zetaSquareGaussianWindow_sub_frozen_window_le (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ T G r : ℝ, 8 ≤ T → 0 < G → 0 ≤ r → r ≤ T / 2 →
      |zetaSquareGaussianWindow T G (r / G) - 2 *
        (∫ x in -r..r, zetaSquareFrozenDivisorIntegral T x * (Real.exp (-(x / G) ^ 2) : ℂ)).re| ≤
        C * r * (1 + r * T ^ (-1 / 2 + ε))

declarations.name: exists_abs_zetaSquareGaussianWindow_sub_quadratic_le
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_abs_zetaSquareGaussianWindow_sub_quadratic_le (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ T G r : ℝ, 8 ≤ T → 0 < G → G ^ 2 ≤ 2 * T →
      0 ≤ r → r ≤ T / 2 →
      |zetaSquareGaussianWindow T G (r / G) - 2 * (zetaFrozenDivisorQuadraticSum T G).re| ≤
        C * r * (1 + r * T ^ (-1 / 2 + ε)) +
          (∑' n : ℕ, ‖zetaFrozenDivisorCoefficient T n‖) *
            (4 * r ^ 2 * (18 / T + 2 * r ^ 2 / T ^ 2) +
              6 * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * G * Real.exp (-(r / G) ^ 2 / 2))

declarations.name: norm_zetaFrozenDivisorQuadraticSum_sub_short_le
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_zetaFrozenDivisorQuadraticSum_sub_short_le {T G L : ℝ}

    ‖zetaFrozenDivisorQuadraticSum T G - zetaShortQuadraticDivisorSum T G L‖ ≤
      (∑' n : ℕ, ‖zetaFrozenDivisorCoefficient T n‖) *
        (Real.sqrt Real.pi * G * Real.exp (-L ^ 2 / 8))

      ‖zetaFrozenDivisorQuadraticSum T G - zetaShortQuadraticDivisorSum T G L‖ ≤
        C * T ^ (1 / 2 + ε) * G * Real.exp (-L ^ 2 / 8)

declarations.statement:
theorem exists_abs_zetaSquareGaussianWindow_sub_short_le (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ T G r L : ℝ, 8 ≤ T → 0 < G → G ^ 2 ≤ 2 * T →
      0 ≤ r → r ≤ T / 2 → 0 ≤ L →
      |zetaSquareGaussianWindow T G (r / G) - 2 * (zetaShortQuadraticDivisorSum T G L).re| ≤

private theorem hIntegral_const_div_sq (C p : ℂ) (x₁ x₂ y : ℝ)
    (hy : y ≠ p.im) :
    HIntegral (fun s : ℂ => C / (s - p) ^ 2) x₁ x₂ y =
      -C / ((x₂ : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * I - p) -
        (-C / ((x₁ : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * I - p))

      -C / ((x : ℂ) + (y₂ : ℂ) * I - p) -
        (-C / ((x : ℂ) + (y₁ : ℂ) * I - p))

    (f : ℂ → ℂ) (a b R : ℝ) :

        (((1 / (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          ∫ u in (-R)..R, f ((b : ℂ) + (u : ℂ) * I)) -

    (hTop : Tendsto (fun R : ℝ => HIntegral' f a b R) atTop (nhds 0))
    (hIntA : Integrable (fun u : ℝ => f ((a : ℂ) + (u : ℂ) * I)))
    (hIntB : Integrable (fun u : ℝ => f ((b : ℂ) + (u : ℂ) * I))) :
    Tendsto (fun R : ℝ =>
      RectangleIntegral' f

    (hTop : Tendsto (fun R : ℝ => HIntegral' f a b R) atTop (nhds 0))
    (hIntA : Integrable (fun u : ℝ => f ((a : ℂ) + (u : ℂ) * I)))

    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hBottom : Tendsto (fun R : ℝ => HIntegral' f a b (-R)) atTop (nhds 0))
    (hTop : Tendsto (fun R : ℝ => HIntegral' f a b R) atTop (nhds 0))
    (hIntA : Integrable (fun u : ℝ => f ((a : ℂ) + (u : ℂ) * I)))
    (hIntB : Integrable (fun u : ℝ => f ((b : ℂ) + (u : ℂ) * I))) :
    Tendsto (fun R : ℝ =>
      RectangleIntegral' f
        ((a : ℂ) - (R : ℂ) * I) ((b : ℂ) + (R : ℂ) * I)) atTop
      (nhds (VerticalIntegral' f b - VerticalIntegral' f a))

    (hTop : Tendsto (fun R : ℝ => HIntegral' f a b R) atTop (nhds 0))
    (hIntA : Integrable (fun u : ℝ => f ((a : ℂ) + (u : ℂ) * I)))
    (hIntB : Integrable (fun u : ℝ => f ((b : ℂ) + (u : ℂ) * I)))
    (hFinite : ∀ᶠ R : ℝ in atTop,
      RectangleIntegral' f

declarations.name: norm_zetaSmoothDivisorSum_sub_short_le

theorem norm_zetaSmoothDivisorSum_sub_short_le {T G L : ℝ}

      (∑' n : ℕ, ‖zetaFrozenDivisorCoefficient T n‖) *

declarations.name: exists_norm_zetaSmoothDivisorSum_sub_short_le

      ‖zetaSmoothDivisorSum T G L - zetaShortQuadraticDivisorSum T G L‖ ≤
        C * T ^ (1 / 2 + ε) * G * Real.exp (-L ^ 2 / 8)

theorem exists_zetaSquareGaussianMean_smooth_approximation {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :

      T₀ ≤ T → 0 < G → G ≤ T ^ (1 / 2 - δ) →

declarations.name: exists_zetaSquareLocalMean_le_smooth_divisor

theorem exists_zetaSquareLocalMean_le_smooth_divisor {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :

      T₀ ≤ T → 0 < G → G ≤ T ^ (1 / 2 - δ) →
      (∫ t in T - G..T + G, zetaMomentCriticalNorm t ^ 2) ≤

theorem exists_zetaSquarePhysicalGaussian_smooth_approximation {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :

declarations.name: ordinaryDivisorVoronoi_bessel

theorem ordinaryDivisorVoronoi_bessel {g : ℝ → ℂ} (hg : DFIVoronoiTestFunction g) :
    (∑' n : ℕ, divisorWeight n * g n) =
      (∫ x : ℝ in Ioi 0, ((Real.log x : ℂ) + 2 * Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) * g x) +
        (∑' n : ℕ, divisorWeight n * (-(2 * Real.pi) : ℂ) *
          ∫ x : ℝ in Ioi 0, g x * (dfiBesselY0 (4 * Real.pi * Real.sqrt (x * n)) : ℂ)) +
        ∑' n : ℕ, divisorWeight n * 4 *
          ∫ x : ℝ in Ioi 0, g x * (dfiBesselK0 (4 * Real.pi * Real.sqrt (x * n)) : ℂ)

theorem exists_zetaSquarePhysicalGaussian_atkinson_approximation {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :

      T₀ ≤ T → 0 < G → G ≤ T ^ (1 / 2 - δ) →

        2 * (zetaAtkinsonVoronoiMain T G (Real.log T) +
          zetaAtkinsonBesselMinus T G (Real.log T) +

declarations.name: lemma_IBP_bound_C1
declarations.statement:
private theorem lemma_IBP_bound_C1 {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b) (g : ℝ → ℝ) (F : ℝ → ℂ)
    (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 g (Icc a b)) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 F (Icc a b)) :
    ‖(∫ t in Icc a b, (g t : ℂ) * deriv F t) - (g b * F b - g a * F a)‖ ≤

    (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 F (Icc a b)) :
    ‖(∫ t in Icc a b, (g t : ℂ) * deriv F t) - (g b * F b - g a * F a)‖ ≤

declarations.name: norm_phaseIntegral_le_of_negative_slope
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_phaseIntegral_le_of_negative_slope {φ : ℝ → ℝ} {a b lam : ℝ}
    (hab : a ≤ b) (hlam : 0 < lam)
    (hφ : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 φ x)

      (((4 * Real.pi * Real.sqrt (x * n)) ^ (-2 * α) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        Complex.exp (((s * (4 * Real.pi * Real.sqrt (x * n)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) =
      (atkinsonBesselScale α n : ℂ) *
        atkinsonPowerIntegrand T G L α (s * Real.sqrt n) x

      (Real.sqrt Real.pi / Real.pi : ℂ) *
        ((atkinsonBesselScale (1 / 4) n : ℂ) *
          (neumannLeadingPlus * atkinsonPowerIntegrand T G L (1 / 4) (Real.sqrt n) x +
           neumannLeadingMinus * atkinsonPowerIntegrand T G L (1 / 4) (-Real.sqrt n) x) -
         (atkinsonBesselScale (3 / 4) n : ℂ) / 8 *
          (neumannCorrectionPlus * atkinsonPowerIntegrand T G L (3 / 4) (Real.sqrt n) x +
           neumannCorrectionMinus * atkinsonPowerIntegrand T G L (3 / 4) (-Real.sqrt n) x))

declarations.name: log_atkinsonSaddleRoot_sq_sub_log
declarations.statement:
theorem log_atkinsonSaddleRoot_sq_sub_log {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) (b : ℝ) :

      2 * Real.arsinh (b / (2 * Real.sqrt A))

declarations.name: zetaAtkinsonSaddle_log_argument

declarations.statement:
theorem atkinson_sqrt_frequency_normalized {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (n : ℕ) :
    Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) / (2 * Real.sqrt (T / (2 * Real.pi))) =
      Real.sqrt (Real.pi * (n : ℝ) / (2 * T))

declarations.name: atkinson_sqrt_frequency_radical
declarations.statement:
theorem atkinson_sqrt_frequency_radical {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (n : ℕ) :
    Real.pi * Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) * Real.sqrt ((Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)) ^ 2 +
      4 * (T / (2 * Real.pi))) =
      Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi * (n : ℝ) * T + Real.pi ^ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2)

declarations.name: atkinsonDualPhase_sqrt
declarations.statement:
theorem atkinsonDualPhase_sqrt {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (n : ℕ) :
    atkinsonDualPhase T (Real.sqrt n) = atkinsonSourcePhase T n + Real.pi / 4

declarations.name: zetaAtkinsonPhase_saddle_sqrt
declarations.statement:
theorem zetaAtkinsonPhase_saddle_sqrt {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (n : ℕ) :
    zetaAtkinsonPhase T (Real.sqrt n) (zetaAtkinsonSaddle T (Real.sqrt n)) =
      atkinsonCentralPhase T + Real.pi * n + atkinsonSourcePhase T n + Real.pi / 4

declarations.name: zetaAtkinsonPhase_saddle_neg_sqrt
declarations.statement:
theorem zetaAtkinsonPhase_saddle_neg_sqrt {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (n : ℕ) :
    zetaAtkinsonPhase T (-Real.sqrt n) (zetaAtkinsonSaddle T (-Real.sqrt n)) =
      atkinsonCentralPhase T + Real.pi * n - atkinsonSourcePhase T n - Real.pi / 4

declarations.name: exp_atkinson_natural_pi
declarations.statement:
theorem exp_atkinson_natural_pi (n : ℕ) :
    Complex.exp (((Real.pi * (n : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) = (-1 : ℂ) ^ n

declarations.name: exp_zetaAtkinsonPhase_saddle_sqrt
declarations.statement:
theorem exp_zetaAtkinsonPhase_saddle_sqrt {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (n : ℕ) :
    Complex.exp ((zetaAtkinsonPhase T (Real.sqrt n)
      (zetaAtkinsonSaddle T (Real.sqrt n)) : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
      Complex.exp ((atkinsonCentralPhase T : ℂ) * Complex.I) * (-1 : ℂ) ^ n *
        Complex.exp (((atkinsonSourcePhase T n + Real.pi / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)

declarations.name: exp_zetaAtkinsonPhase_saddle_neg_sqrt
declarations.statement:
theorem exp_zetaAtkinsonPhase_saddle_neg_sqrt {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (n : ℕ) :
    Complex.exp ((zetaAtkinsonPhase T (-Real.sqrt n)
      (zetaAtkinsonSaddle T (-Real.sqrt n)) : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
      Complex.exp ((atkinsonCentralPhase T : ℂ) * Complex.I) * (-1 : ℂ) ^ n *
        Complex.exp (((-atkinsonSourcePhase T n - Real.pi / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)

declarations.name: zetaGaussianQuadraticIntegral_neg
declarations.statement:
theorem zetaGaussianQuadraticIntegral_neg (T : ℝ) {G : ℝ} (hG : G ≠ 0) (v : ℝ) :

declarations.name: zetaGaussianQuadraticIntegral_at_saddle
declarations.statement:
theorem zetaGaussianQuadraticIntegral_at_saddle {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (G : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    zetaGaussianQuadraticIntegral T G
      (Real.log (zetaAtkinsonSaddle T (Real.sqrt n)) - Real.log (T / (2 * Real.pi))) =
        atkinsonSaddleGaussian T G n

declarations.name: zetaGaussianQuadraticIntegral_at_neg_saddle
declarations.statement:
theorem zetaGaussianQuadraticIntegral_at_neg_saddle {T G : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (hG : G ≠ 0)
    (n : ℕ) :
    zetaGaussianQuadraticIntegral T G
      (Real.log (zetaAtkinsonSaddle T (-Real.sqrt n)) - Real.log (T / (2 * Real.pi))) =
        atkinsonSaddleGaussian T G n

declarations.name: atkinsonSaddleGaussian_eq
declarations.statement:
theorem atkinsonSaddleGaussian_eq (T : ℝ) {G : ℝ} (hG : G ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    atkinsonSaddleGaussian T G n =
      ((Real.pi : ℂ) / zetaGaussianQuadraticCoefficient T G) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) *
        Complex.exp (-((Real.arsinh (Real.sqrt (Real.pi * (n : ℝ) / (2 * T))) : ℂ) ^ 2) /
          zetaGaussianQuadraticCoefficient T G)

declarations.name: abs_log_one_add_sub_quadratic_le
declarations.statement:
theorem abs_log_one_add_sub_quadratic_le {z : ℝ} (hz : |z| ≤ 1 / 2) :
    |Real.log (1 + z) - z + z ^ 2 / 2| ≤ 2 * |z| ^ 3

declarations.name: atkinsonRootQuadratic
declarations.statement: def atkinsonRootQuadratic (T b y : ℝ) : ℝ

declarations.name: atkinsonRootPhase_sub_quadratic
declarations.statement:
theorem atkinsonRootPhase_sub_quadratic {T y : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (hy : 0 < y) (b : ℝ) :
    atkinsonRootPhase T b y - atkinsonRootQuadratic T b y =
      (T / Real.pi) * (Real.log (1 + (y - atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b) /
        atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b) -
          (y - atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b) /
            atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b +
              ((y - atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b) /
                atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b) ^ 2 / 2)

declarations.name: abs_atkinsonRootPhase_sub_quadratic_le
declarations.statement:
theorem abs_atkinsonRootPhase_sub_quadratic_le {T y : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (b : ℝ)
    (hy : |y - atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b| ≤
      atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b / 2) :
    |atkinsonRootPhase T b y - atkinsonRootQuadratic T b y| ≤
      2 * T * |y - atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b| ^ 3 /
        (Real.pi * (atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b) ^ 3)

declarations.name: norm_exp_real_phase_sub_le
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_exp_real_phase_sub_le (a b : ℝ) :
    ‖Complex.exp ((a : ℂ) * I) - Complex.exp ((b : ℂ) * I)‖ ≤ |a - b|

declarations.name: norm_atkinsonRootKernel_sub_quadratic_le
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_atkinsonRootKernel_sub_quadratic_le {T y : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (b : ℝ)
    (hy : |y - atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b| ≤
      atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b / 2) :
    ‖atkinsonRootKernel T b y - Complex.exp
      (((2 * Real.pi * atkinsonRootQuadratic T b y : ℝ) : ℂ) * I)‖ ≤
      4 * T * |y - atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b| ^ 3 /
        (atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b) ^ 3

declarations.statement:
theorem atkinsonSaddleCurvature_mul_root {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (b : ℝ) :
    atkinsonSaddleCurvature T b * atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b =
      Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 + 4 * (T / (2 * Real.pi)))

declarations.name: atkinsonSaddle_squareRoot_normalization
declarations.statement:
theorem atkinsonSaddle_squareRoot_normalization {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (b : ℝ) :
    Real.sqrt (atkinsonSaddleCurvature T b) *
      Real.sqrt (atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b) =
        Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 + 4 * (T / (2 * Real.pi))))

declarations.name: atkinsonRootQuadraticKernel_translate
declarations.statement:
theorem atkinsonRootQuadraticKernel_translate (T b z : ℝ) :
    atkinsonRootQuadraticKernel T b (z + atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b) =
      atkinsonRootKernel T b (atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b) *
        Complex.exp (((-2 * Real.pi * atkinsonSaddleCurvature T b * z ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * I)

declarations.name: integral_atkinsonRootQuadraticKernel
declarations.statement:
theorem integral_atkinsonRootQuadraticKernel (T b H : ℝ) :
    (∫ y in (atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b - H)..
      (atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b + H), atkinsonRootQuadraticKernel T b y) =
      atkinsonRootKernel T b (atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b) *
        atkinsonQuadraticWindow (atkinsonSaddleCurvature T b) H

declarations.name: norm_integral_atkinsonRootQuadraticKernel_sub_fresnel_le
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_integral_atkinsonRootQuadraticKernel_sub_fresnel_le {T H : ℝ}
    (hT : 0 < T) (hH : 0 < H) (b : ℝ) :
    ‖(∫ y in (atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b - H)..
      (atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b + H), atkinsonRootQuadraticKernel T b y) -
      atkinsonRootKernel T b (atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b) *
        (Complex.exp (((-Real.pi / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) /
          (Real.sqrt (2 * atkinsonSaddleCurvature T b) : ℂ))‖ ≤
        2 / (atkinsonSaddleCurvature T b * H * Real.pi)

declarations.name: IntervalC1Bound.atkinsonRoot_right_window
declarations.statement:
theorem IntervalC1Bound.atkinsonRoot_right_window {f : ℝ → ℂ} {a c M T H : ℝ}
    (hf : IntervalC1Bound f a c M) (hT : 0 < T) (b : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hac : a ≤ c) (hH : 0 < H)
    (hr : atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b + H ≤ a) :

declarations.name: IntervalC1Bound.atkinsonRoot_left_window
declarations.statement:
theorem IntervalC1Bound.atkinsonRoot_left_window {f : ℝ → ℂ} {a c M T H : ℝ}

    (hr : c ≤ atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b - H) :

declarations.name: IntervalC1Bound.atkinsonRoot_sub_local
declarations.statement:
theorem IntervalC1Bound.atkinsonRoot_sub_local {f : ℝ → ℂ} {a c M T H : ℝ}
    (hf : IntervalC1Bound f a c M) (hT : 0 < T) (b : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hH : 0 < H)
    (hleft : a ≤ atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b - H)
    (hright : atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b + H ≤ c) :
    ‖(∫ y in a..c, f y * atkinsonRootKernel T b y) -
      ∫ y in (atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b - H)..
        (atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b + H), f y * atkinsonRootKernel T b y‖ ≤
      2 * M / (H * Real.pi)

declarations.name: IntervalC2Bound.atkinsonLocalQuadratic
declarations.statement:
theorem IntervalC2Bound.atkinsonLocalQuadratic {f : ℝ → ℂ} {a c M R T H : ℝ}
    (hf : IntervalC2Bound f a c M R) (hT : 0 < T) (b : ℝ) (hH : 0 ≤ H)
    (hleft : a ≤ atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b - H)
    (hright : atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b + H ≤ c)
    (hwindow : H ≤ atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b / 2) :
    ‖(∫ y in (atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b - H)..
        (atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b + H), f y * atkinsonRootKernel T b y) -
      f (atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b) *
        ∫ y in (atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b - H)..
          (atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b + H), atkinsonRootQuadraticKernel T b y‖ ≤
      M * (2 * R * H ^ 2 + 8 * T * H ^ 4 /
        (atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b) ^ 3)

declarations.name: IntervalC2Bound.atkinsonQuadraticApproximation
declarations.statement:
theorem IntervalC2Bound.atkinsonQuadraticApproximation {f : ℝ → ℂ}
    {a c M R T H : ℝ} (hf : IntervalC2Bound f a c M R)
    (hv : IntervalC1Bound f a c M) (hT : 0 < T) (b : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hH : 0 < H)
    (hleft : a ≤ atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b - H)
    (hright : atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b + H ≤ c)
    (hwindow : H ≤ atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b / 2) :
    ‖(∫ y in a..c, f y * atkinsonRootKernel T b y) -
      f (atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b) *
        ∫ y in (atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b - H)..
          (atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b + H), atkinsonRootQuadraticKernel T b y‖ ≤
      M * (2 / (H * Real.pi) + 2 * R * H ^ 2 + 8 * T * H ^ 4 /
        (atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b) ^ 3)

declarations.name: exists_atkinsonPowerIntegral_local_quadratic_approximation
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_atkinsonPowerIntegral_local_quadratic_approximation (α : ℝ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ T G L b H : ℝ, 0 < T → 1 ≤ G → G ^ 2 ≤ 2 * T →
      1 ≤ L → 8 * L ≤ G → 0 ≤ H →
      Real.sqrt T / 4 ≤ atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b - H →
      atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b + H ≤ Real.sqrt T →
      H ≤ atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b / 2 →
      ‖2 * (∫ y in (atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b - H)..
          (atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b + H),
            atkinsonPowerWeight T G L α (y ^ 2) * atkinsonRootKernel T b y) -
        2 * atkinsonPowerWeight T G L α ((atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b) ^ 2) *
          ∫ y in (atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b - H)..
            (atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b + H), atkinsonRootQuadraticKernel T b y‖ ≤
        C * G * T ^ (-α) * (4 * (G / Real.sqrt T) * H ^ 2 +
          16 * T * H ^ 4 / (atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b) ^ 3)

theorem exists_atkinsonPowerIntegral_quadratic_approximation (α : ℝ) :

      Real.sqrt T / 4 ≤ atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b - H →
      atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b + H ≤ Real.sqrt T →

          ∫ y in (atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b - H)..
            (atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b + H), atkinsonRootQuadraticKernel T b y‖ ≤

theorem exists_atkinsonPowerIntegral_stationary_approximation (α : ℝ) :

theorem atkinsonIndexCurvatureDerivative_box_bounds

    atkinsonIndexBoxCurvatureLower u A B ≤

declarations.name: atkinsonIndexCurvatureDerivative_bounds
declarations.statement:
theorem atkinsonIndexCurvatureDerivative_bounds
    {u c x : ℝ} (hu : 0 < u) (hx : 0 < x) (hxu : x ≤ u)
    (huc : u ≤ c) (hcu : c ≤ 2 * u) :
    atkinsonIndexCurvatureDerivativeLower u x ≤
        Real.pi / x ^ (2 : ℕ) *
          (Real.pi * c / x + Real.pi ^ (2 : ℕ)) /
          (atkinsonIndexRealSlope c x) ^ (3 : ℕ) ∧
      Real.pi / x ^ (2 : ℕ) *
          (Real.pi * c / x + Real.pi ^ (2 : ℕ)) /
          (atkinsonIndexRealSlope c x) ^ (3 : ℕ) ≤
        atkinsonIndexCurvatureDerivativeUpper u x

declarations.name: atkinsonIndexCurvatureDifference_bounds
declarations.statement:
theorem atkinsonIndexCurvatureDifference_bounds

    (hxu : x ≤ u) (htuUpper : t ≤ 2 * u) :
    atkinsonIndexCurvatureDerivativeLower u x * (t - u) ≤
        -(atkinsonIndexRealCurvature t x -
          atkinsonIndexRealCurvature u x) ∧
      -(atkinsonIndexRealCurvature t x -
          atkinsonIndexRealCurvature u x) ≤
        atkinsonIndexCurvatureDerivativeUpper u x * (t - u)

declarations.name: finite_resolvent_telescoping
declarations.statement:
theorem finite_resolvent_telescoping (z q : ℕ → ℂ) (N : ℕ)

    ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), z n =
      q 0 * z 0 - q N * z (N + 1) +
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (q (n + 1) - q n) * z (n + 1)

declarations.statement:
theorem kusminLandau_one_period (f : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ) (δ : ℝ)

    (hmono : ∀ n < N, f (n + 1) - f n ≤ f (n + 2) - f (n + 1)) :
    ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), unitaryPhase (f n)‖ ≤
      2 * Real.pi / δ

      f (A + n + 1) - f (A + n) - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi))

declarations.name: finite_weyl_differencing
declarations.statement:
theorem finite_weyl_differencing
    {ι κ : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ]
    (s : Finset ι) (r : Finset κ) (b : ι → κ → ℂ) (S : ℂ) (A B : ℝ)
    (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hshift : ∀ h ∈ r, ∑ n ∈ s, b n h = S)
    (hdiag : ∀ h ∈ r, ∑ n ∈ s, ‖b n h‖ ^ 2 ≤ A)
    (hcorr : ∀ h ∈ r, ∀ k ∈ r, h ≠ k →
      abs (∑ n ∈ s, ⟪b n h, b n k⟫_ℝ) ≤ B) :
    (r.card : ℝ) ^ 2 * ‖S‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (s.card : ℝ) * ((r.card : ℝ) * A + (r.card : ℝ) ^ 2 * B)

declarations.statement:
theorem sum_paddedShift_eq (a : ℤ → ℂ) (N H h : ℕ) (hh : h < H) :
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico (-(H : ℤ)) N, paddedShift a N n h =
      ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico (0 : ℤ) N, a m

declarations.name: sum_norm_sq_paddedShift_eq

      ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico (0 : ℤ) N, ‖a m‖ ^ 2

declarations.name: interval_weyl_differencing
declarations.statement:
theorem interval_weyl_differencing
    (a : ℤ → ℂ) (N H : ℕ) (C : ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ n ∈ Finset.Ico (0 : ℤ) N, ‖a n‖ ≤ 1)
    (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hcorr : ∀ h ∈ Finset.range H, ∀ k ∈ Finset.range H, h ≠ k →
      abs (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico (-(H : ℤ)) N,
        ⟪paddedShift a N n h, paddedShift a N n k⟫_ℝ) ≤ C) :
    (H : ℝ) ^ 2 * ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico (0 : ℤ) N, a n‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ((N + H : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((H : ℝ) * N + (H : ℝ) ^ 2 * C)

declarations.name: filter_card_bound

    (hstep : forall n, n < N -> lambda <= theta (n + 1) - theta n) :
    (((Finset.range (N + 1)).filter fun n => a <= theta n ∧ theta n <= b).card : Real)

declarations.name: kusminLandau_good_fiber
declarations.statement:
theorem kusminLandau_good_fiber (f : Nat -> Real) (N : Nat) (k : Int)
    (delta : Real) (hdelta : 0 < delta)
    (hmono : forall n, n < N ->
      f (n + 1) - f n <= f (n + 2) - f (n + 1)) :
    ‖∑ n ∈ (Finset.range (N + 1)).filter (fun n =>
        delta <= f (n + 1) - f n - (k : Real) * (2 * Real.pi) ∧
        f (n + 1) - f n - (k : Real) * (2 * Real.pi) <= 2 * Real.pi - delta),
      unitaryPhase (f n)‖ <= 2 * Real.pi / delta

declarations.name: vanDerCorput_second_derivative
declarations.statement:
theorem vanDerCorput_second_derivative
    (f : Nat -> Real) (N : Nat) (lambda Lambda delta : Real)
    (hlambda : 0 < lambda) (hdelta : 0 < delta)
    (hlower : forall n, n < N ->
      lambda <= (f (n + 2) - f (n + 1)) - (f (n + 1) - f n))
    (hupper : forall n, n < N ->
      (f (n + 2) - f (n + 1)) - (f (n + 1) - f n) <= Lambda) :
    ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), unitaryPhase (f n)‖ <=
      ((N : Real) * Lambda / (2 * Real.pi) + 2) *
        (2 * Real.pi / delta + 2 * (delta / lambda + 1))

declarations.name: vanDerCorput_B_process
declarations.statement:
theorem vanDerCorput_B_process
    (f : Nat -> Real) (N : Nat) (lambda Lambda : Real)
    (hlambda : 0 < lambda)
    (hlower : forall n, n < N ->
      lambda <= (f (n + 2) - f (n + 1)) - (f (n + 1) - f n))
    (hupper : forall n, n < N ->
      (f (n + 2) - f (n + 1)) - (f (n + 1) - f n) <= Lambda) :
    ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), unitaryPhase (f n)‖ <=
      ((N : Real) * Lambda / (2 * Real.pi) + 2) *
        (2 * Real.pi / Real.sqrt lambda +
          2 * (Real.sqrt lambda / lambda + 1))

declarations.name: second_order_mean_value
declarations.statement:
theorem second_order_mean_value
    (F F' F'' : Real -> Real) (x : Real)
    (hF : forall y, y ∈ Set.Icc x (x + 2) -> HasDerivAt F (F' y) y)
    (hF' : forall y, y ∈ Set.Icc x (x + 2) -> HasDerivAt F' (F'' y) y) :
    exists xi, xi ∈ Set.Ioo x (x + 2) ∧
      F'' xi = F (x + 2) - 2 * F (x + 1) + F x

declarations.name: exists_atkinsonIndexPositiveDifference_secondDifference

    {t u x : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (hu : 0 < u) (hx : 0 < x) :
    ∃ xi ∈ Set.Ioo x (x + 2),
      atkinsonIndexRealCurvature u xi -
          atkinsonIndexRealCurvature t xi =
        (atkinsonIndexPositiveDifference t u (x + 2) -
          atkinsonIndexPositiveDifference t u (x + 1)) -
        (atkinsonIndexPositiveDifference t u (x + 1) -
          atkinsonIndexPositiveDifference t u x)

declarations.name: atkinsonIndexPositiveDifferenceNat_secondDifference_bounds
declarations.statement:
theorem atkinsonIndexPositiveDifferenceNat_secondDifference_bounds
    {t u : ℝ} {K N : ℕ}
    (hu : 0 < u) (htu : u < t) (hK : 0 < K)
    (hblock : ((K + N + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ u)
    (htUpper : t ≤ 2 * u) :
    ∀ n, n < N →
      atkinsonIndexBProcessLambda t u K N ≤
          (atkinsonIndexPositiveDifferenceNat t u K (n + 2) -
            atkinsonIndexPositiveDifferenceNat t u K (n + 1)) -
          (atkinsonIndexPositiveDifferenceNat t u K (n + 1) -
            atkinsonIndexPositiveDifferenceNat t u K n) ∧
        (atkinsonIndexPositiveDifferenceNat t u K (n + 2) -
            atkinsonIndexPositiveDifferenceNat t u K (n + 1)) -
          (atkinsonIndexPositiveDifferenceNat t u K (n + 1) -
            atkinsonIndexPositiveDifferenceNat t u K n) ≤
        atkinsonIndexBProcessLambdaUpper t u K N

declarations.name: atkinsonIndexPositiveDifference_B_process
declarations.statement:
theorem atkinsonIndexPositiveDifference_B_process
    {t u : ℝ} {K N : ℕ}
    (hu : 0 < u) (htu : u < t) (hK : 0 < K)
    (hblock : ((K + N + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ u)
    (htUpper : t ≤ 2 * u) :
    ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
        unitaryPhase (atkinsonIndexPositiveDifferenceNat t u K n)‖ ≤
      ((N : ℝ) * atkinsonIndexBProcessLambdaUpper t u K N /
          (2 * Real.pi) + 2) *
        (2 * Real.pi /
            Real.sqrt (atkinsonIndexBProcessLambda t u K N) +
          2 * (Real.sqrt (atkinsonIndexBProcessLambda t u K N) /
            atkinsonIndexBProcessLambda t u K N + 1))

declarations.name: exists_atkinsonIndexIncreasingDifferenceNat_increment
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_atkinsonIndexIncreasingDifferenceNat_increment
    {t u : ℝ} {K n : ℕ}
    (hu : 0 < u) (htu : u < t) (hK : 0 < K) :
    ∃ xi ∈ Set.Ioo ((K + n : ℕ) : ℝ) ((K + n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ),
      atkinsonIndexRealSlope t xi -
          atkinsonIndexRealSlope u xi =
        atkinsonIndexIncreasingDifferenceNat t u K (n + 1) -
          atkinsonIndexIncreasingDifferenceNat t u K n

declarations.name: atkinsonIndexIncreasingDifferenceNat_increment_bounds
declarations.statement:
theorem atkinsonIndexIncreasingDifferenceNat_increment_bounds
    {t u : ℝ} {K N : ℕ}
    (hu : 0 < u) (htu : u < t) (hK : 0 < K)
    (hblock : (((K + N + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ u)
    (htUpper : t ≤ 2 * u) :
    ∀ n ≤ N,
      atkinsonIndexFirstDerivativeLower u t K (K + N + 1) ≤
          atkinsonIndexIncreasingDifferenceNat t u K (n + 1) -
            atkinsonIndexIncreasingDifferenceNat t u K n ∧
        atkinsonIndexIncreasingDifferenceNat t u K (n + 1) -
            atkinsonIndexIncreasingDifferenceNat t u K n ≤
          atkinsonIndexFirstDerivativeUpper u t K (K + N + 1)

    (htUpper : t ≤ 2 * u) :
    ∀ n < N,
      atkinsonIndexIncreasingDifferenceNat t u K (n + 2) -
          atkinsonIndexIncreasingDifferenceNat t u K (n + 1) ≤
        atkinsonIndexIncreasingDifferenceNat t u K (n + 1) -
          atkinsonIndexIncreasingDifferenceNat t u K n

declarations.name: atkinsonIndexIncreasingDifference_KL
declarations.statement:
theorem atkinsonIndexIncreasingDifference_KL
    {t u : ℝ} {K N : ℕ}
    (hu : 0 < u) (htu : u < t) (hK : 0 < K)
    (hblock : (((K + N + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ u)
    (htUpper : t ≤ 2 * u)
    (hsmall :
      atkinsonIndexFirstDerivativeUpper u t K (K + N + 1) ≤
        Real.pi) :

    (hy : |y - atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b| ≤
      atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b / 2) :
    ‖atkinsonRootKernel T b y - atkinsonRootQuadraticKernel T b y *
      (1 + (atkinsonRootCubicCorrection T b y : ℂ) * I)‖ ≤
      4*T*|y-atkinsonSaddleRoot (T/(2*Real.pi)) b|^4 /
        (atkinsonSaddleRoot (T/(2*Real.pi)) b)^4 +
      4*T^2*|y-atkinsonSaddleRoot (T/(2*Real.pi)) b|^6 /
        (atkinsonSaddleRoot (T/(2*Real.pi)) b)^6

declarations.name: atkinsonRootQuadraticKernel_reflect
declarations.statement:
theorem atkinsonRootQuadraticKernel_reflect (T b y : ℝ) :
    atkinsonRootQuadraticKernel T b
      (2 * atkinsonSaddleRoot (T / (2 * Real.pi)) b - y) =
        atkinsonRootQuadraticKernel T b y

declarations.name: integral_atkinsonRootQuadratic_odd
declarations.statement:
theorem integral_atkinsonRootQuadratic_odd (T b H : ℝ) {k : ℕ} (hk : Odd k) :
