      (atkinsonSaddleRoot (T/(2*Real.pi)) b+H),
        (((y-atkinsonSaddleRoot (T/(2*Real.pi)) b)^k : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          atkinsonRootQuadraticKernel T b y) = 0

declarations.name: IntervalC2Bound.atkinsonLocalSymmetric
declarations.statement:
theorem IntervalC2Bound.atkinsonLocalSymmetric {f : ℝ → ℂ} {a c M R T H : ℝ}
    (hf : IntervalC2Bound f a c M R) (hT : 0 < T) (b : ℝ) (hH : 0 ≤ H)
    (hleft : a ≤ atkinsonSaddleRoot (T/(2*Real.pi)) b-H)
    (hright : atkinsonSaddleRoot (T/(2*Real.pi)) b+H ≤ c)
    (hwindow : H ≤ atkinsonSaddleRoot (T/(2*Real.pi)) b/2) :
    ‖(∫ y in (atkinsonSaddleRoot (T/(2*Real.pi)) b-H)..
        (atkinsonSaddleRoot (T/(2*Real.pi)) b+H), f y * atkinsonRootKernel T b y) -
      f (atkinsonSaddleRoot (T/(2*Real.pi)) b) *
        ∫ y in (atkinsonSaddleRoot (T/(2*Real.pi)) b-H)..
          (atkinsonSaddleRoot (T/(2*Real.pi)) b+H), atkinsonRootQuadraticKernel T b y‖ ≤
      M*(2*R^2*H^3 + 4*R*T*H^5/(atkinsonSaddleRoot (T/(2*Real.pi)) b)^3 +
        8*T*H^5/(atkinsonSaddleRoot (T/(2*Real.pi)) b)^4 +
        8*T^2*H^7/(atkinsonSaddleRoot (T/(2*Real.pi)) b)^6)

declarations.statement: def atkinsonSymmetricError (T b R H : ℝ) : ℝ

theorem atkinsonSymmetricError_tail_le {T R H : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T)

declarations.name: IntervalC2Bound.atkinsonSymmetricApproximation
declarations.statement:
theorem IntervalC2Bound.atkinsonSymmetricApproximation {f : ℝ → ℂ}
    {a c M R T H : ℝ} (hf : IntervalC2Bound f a c M R)
    (hv : IntervalC1Bound f a c M) (hT : 0 < T) (b : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hH : 0 < H)
    (hleft : a ≤ atkinsonSaddleRoot (T/(2*Real.pi)) b-H)
    (hright : atkinsonSaddleRoot (T/(2*Real.pi)) b+H ≤ c)
    (hwindow : H ≤ atkinsonSaddleRoot (T/(2*Real.pi)) b/2) :
    ‖(∫ y in a..c, f y*atkinsonRootKernel T b y) -
      f (atkinsonSaddleRoot (T/(2*Real.pi)) b) *
        ∫ y in (atkinsonSaddleRoot (T/(2*Real.pi)) b-H)..
          (atkinsonSaddleRoot (T/(2*Real.pi)) b+H), atkinsonRootQuadraticKernel T b y‖ ≤
      (M/2)*atkinsonSymmetricError T b R H

declarations.name: exists_atkinsonPowerIntegral_finite_symmetric_approximation
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_atkinsonPowerIntegral_finite_symmetric_approximation (α : ℝ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ T G L b H : ℝ, 0 < T → 1 ≤ G → G^2 ≤ 2*T →
      1 ≤ L → 8*L ≤ G → 0 < H →
      Real.sqrt T/4 ≤ atkinsonSaddleRoot (T/(2*Real.pi)) b-H →
      atkinsonSaddleRoot (T/(2*Real.pi)) b+H ≤ Real.sqrt T →
      H ≤ atkinsonSaddleRoot (T/(2*Real.pi)) b/2 →
      ‖atkinsonPowerIntegral T G L α b-atkinsonFiniteStationaryMain T G L α b H‖ ≤
        C*G*T^(-α)*atkinsonSymmetricError T b (G/Real.sqrt T) H

declarations.name: exists_atkinsonPowerIntegral_symmetric_approximation
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_atkinsonPowerIntegral_symmetric_approximation (α : ℝ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ T G L b H : ℝ, 0 < T → 1 ≤ G → G^2 ≤ 2*T →
      1 ≤ L → 8*L ≤ G → 0 < H →
      Real.sqrt T/4 ≤ atkinsonSaddleRoot (T/(2*Real.pi)) b-H →
      atkinsonSaddleRoot (T/(2*Real.pi)) b+H ≤ Real.sqrt T →
      H ≤ atkinsonSaddleRoot (T/(2*Real.pi)) b/2 →
      ‖atkinsonPowerIntegral T G L α b-atkinsonStationaryMain T G L α b‖ ≤
        C*G*T^(-α)*atkinsonSymmetricError T b (G/Real.sqrt T) H

declarations.statement:

      Complex.exp (((-Real.pi / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) = Complex.exp ((f : ℂ) * I)

    (G L α : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    atkinsonStationaryMain T G L α (Real.sqrt n) =
      (2 * atkinsonSaddleProfile T G L α (Real.sqrt n) * atkinsonSaddleGaussian T G n *
        Complex.exp ((atkinsonCentralPhase T : ℂ) * I) * (-1 : ℂ) ^ n *
          Complex.exp ((atkinsonSourcePhase T n : ℂ) * I)) /
            (Real.sqrt (2 * atkinsonSaddleCurvature T (Real.sqrt n)) : ℂ)

    atkinsonStationaryMain T G L α (-Real.sqrt n) =
      ((-I) * 2 * atkinsonSaddleProfile T G L α (-Real.sqrt n) * atkinsonSaddleGaussian T G n *
        Complex.exp ((atkinsonCentralPhase T : ℂ) * I) * (-1 : ℂ) ^ n *
          Complex.exp ((-atkinsonSourcePhase T n : ℂ) * I)) /
            (Real.sqrt (2 * atkinsonSaddleCurvature T (-Real.sqrt n)) : ℂ)

      10000*((m+N:ℕ):ℝ) ≤ T →
      FiniteVariationBound (fun i => zetaMainMellinProfile
        (zetaAtkinsonSaddle T (Real.sqrt ((m+i:ℕ):ℝ))/T)) N C ∧
      FiniteVariationBound (fun i => zetaMainMellinProfile
        (zetaAtkinsonSaddle T (-Real.sqrt ((m+i:ℕ):ℝ))/T)) N C

declarations.name: finiteVariationBound_saddleCutoff
declarations.statement:
theorem finiteVariationBound_saddleCutoff {T G L : ℝ}
    (hT : 0 < T) (hG : 0 < G) (hL : 0 < L) (m N : ℕ) :
    FiniteVariationBound (fun i => (zetaDivisorBandCutoff T G L
      (zetaAtkinsonSaddle T (Real.sqrt ((m+i:ℕ):ℝ))) : ℂ)) N 2 ∧
    FiniteVariationBound (fun i => (zetaDivisorBandCutoff T G L
      (zetaAtkinsonSaddle T (-Real.sqrt ((m+i:ℕ):ℝ))) : ℂ)) N 2

    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ T G L : ℝ, 0 < T → 0 < G → 0 < L →
      ∀ m N : ℕ, 10000*((m+N:ℕ):ℝ) ≤ T →
      FiniteVariationBound (fun i => atkinsonSaddleResidual T G L (Real.sqrt ((m+i:ℕ):ℝ))) N C ∧
      FiniteVariationBound (fun i => atkinsonSaddleResidual T G L (-Real.sqrt ((m+i:ℕ):ℝ))) N C

declarations.name: atkinsonSaddle_quarter_power_curvature
declarations.statement:
theorem atkinsonSaddle_quarter_power_curvature {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (b : ℝ) :
    T^(-(1/4 : ℝ)) * (zetaAtkinsonSaddle T b/T)^(-(1/4 : ℝ)) /
      Real.sqrt (2*atkinsonSaddleCurvature T b) = atkinsonCommonSaddleFactor T b

declarations.name: atkinsonSaddleProfile_div_curvature
declarations.statement:
theorem atkinsonSaddleProfile_div_curvature {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (G L b : ℝ) :
    atkinsonSaddleProfile T G L (1/4) b /
      (Real.sqrt (2*atkinsonSaddleCurvature T b) : ℂ) =
        (atkinsonCommonSaddleFactor T b : ℂ) *
          atkinsonSaddleResidual T G L b * zetaSquareReflectedGammaPhase T

declarations.name: atkinsonStationaryMain_sqrt_normalized
declarations.statement:
theorem atkinsonStationaryMain_sqrt_normalized {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T)
    (G L : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    atkinsonStationaryMain T G L (1/4) (Real.sqrt n) =
      2*(atkinsonCommonSaddleFactor T (Real.sqrt n) : ℂ) *
        atkinsonSaddleResidual T G L (Real.sqrt n) * zetaSquareReflectedGammaPhase T *
        atkinsonSaddleGaussian T G n * Complex.exp ((atkinsonCentralPhase T : ℂ)*I) *
        (-1:ℂ)^n * Complex.exp ((atkinsonSourcePhase T n : ℂ)*I)

declarations.name: atkinsonStationaryMain_neg_sqrt_normalized
declarations.statement:
theorem atkinsonStationaryMain_neg_sqrt_normalized {T G : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T)
    (hG : G ≠ 0) (L : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    atkinsonStationaryMain T G L (1/4) (-Real.sqrt n) =
      (-I)*2*(atkinsonCommonSaddleFactor T (Real.sqrt n) : ℂ) *
        atkinsonSaddleResidual T G L (-Real.sqrt n) * zetaSquareReflectedGammaPhase T *
        atkinsonSaddleGaussian T G n * Complex.exp ((atkinsonCentralPhase T : ℂ)*I) *
        (-1:ℂ)^n * Complex.exp ((-atkinsonSourcePhase T n : ℂ)*I)

theorem exists_finiteVariationBound_atkinsonMainWeights :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ T G L : ℝ, 0 < T → 0 < G → G^2 ≤ 2*T → 0 < L →
      ∀ m N : ℕ, 0 < m → 10000*((m+N:ℕ):ℝ) ≤ T →

        (C*G*T^(-(1/4:ℝ))*(m:ℝ)^(-(1/4:ℝ))*Real.exp (-(G^2*(m:ℝ))/(12*T))) ∧
      FiniteVariationBound (fun i => atkinsonNegativeMainWeight T G L (m+i)) N

theorem atkinsonStationaryLeadingSum_eq_signed {T G L : ℝ}

declarations.name: sum_range_min_pow_eq_truncatedDyadic
declarations.statement:
theorem sum_range_min_pow_eq_truncatedDyadic {α : Type*} [AddCommMonoid α]
    (f : ℕ → α) {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (J : ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (min N (2^J)), f i) =
      f 0+∑ j ∈ Finset.range J, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (truncatedDyadicLength N j), f (2^j+i)

theorem sum_range_eq_truncatedDyadic {α : Type*} [AddCommMonoid α]

    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, f i) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (Nat.clog 2 N),
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (truncatedDyadicLength N j), f (2^j+i)

declarations.statement:
theorem norm_sum_mul_sq_le {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (s : Finset ι) (a b : ι → ℂ) :
    ‖∑ i ∈ s, a i * b i‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, ‖a i‖ ^ 2) * (∑ i ∈ s, ‖b i‖ ^ 2)

declarations.name: sum_norm_sq_sum_le_gram
declarations.statement:
theorem sum_norm_sq_sum_le_gram {ι κ : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ]
    (s : Finset ι) (W : Finset κ) (c : κ → ℂ) (y : κ → ι → ℂ)
    (hc : ∀ t ∈ W, ‖c t‖ ≤ 1) :
    (∑ n ∈ s, ‖∑ t ∈ W, c t * y t n‖ ^ 2) ≤
      ∑ t ∈ W, ∑ u ∈ W, ‖∑ n ∈ s, conj (y t n) * y u n‖

declarations.name: sum_norm_coefficient_vector_sq_le_gram
declarations.statement:
theorem sum_norm_coefficient_vector_sq_le_gram
    {ι κ : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ]
    (s : Finset ι) (W : Finset κ) (d : ι → ℂ) (e : κ → ι → ℂ) :
    (∑ t ∈ W, ‖∑ n ∈ s, d n*e t n‖)^2 ≤
      (∑ n ∈ s, ‖d n‖^2)*
        ∑ t ∈ W, ∑ u ∈ W, ‖∑ n ∈ s, conj (e t n)*e u n‖

declarations.name: card_mul_lower_sq_le_coefficient_gram
declarations.statement:
theorem card_mul_lower_sq_le_coefficient_gram
    {ι κ : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ]
    (s : Finset ι) (W : Finset κ) (d : ι → ℂ) (e : κ → ι → ℂ)
    {V : ℝ} (hV : 0 ≤ V)
    (hlarge : ∀ t ∈ W, V ≤ ‖∑ n ∈ s, d n*e t n‖) :
    ((W.card:ℝ)*V)^2 ≤ (∑ n ∈ s, ‖d n‖^2)*
      ∑ t ∈ W, ∑ u ∈ W, ‖∑ n ∈ s, conj (e t n)*e u n‖

theorem atkinson_mul_sqrt_div {H M : ℝ} (hM : 0 < M) :

declarations.name: atkinsonOrderedPrefixGapMajorant_le_near

theorem atkinsonOrderedPrefixGapMajorant_le_near {H t u : ℝ} {M : ℕ}
    (hH : 0 < H) (hHu : H ≤ u) (huH : u ≤ 2*H) (htu : u < t) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hgap : t-u ≤ Real.sqrt (H*(M:ℝ))) :

declarations.name: atkinsonPrefixGapMajorant_le_near
declarations.statement:
theorem atkinsonPrefixGapMajorant_le_near {H t u : ℝ} {M : ℕ}
    (hH : 0 < H) (htH : H ≤ t) (hHt : t ≤ 2*H)

    (hgap : |t-u| ≤ Real.sqrt (H*(M:ℝ))) :
    atkinsonPrefixGapMajorant M M t u ≤ 60*Real.sqrt (H*(M:ℝ))/|t-u|

declarations.name: IsSeparated
declarations.statement: def IsSeparated (G : ℝ) (W : Finset ℝ) : Prop

declarations.name: separated_subset_card_le_one_of_diameter
declarations.statement:
theorem separated_subset_card_le_one_of_diameter
    (W S : Finset ℝ) (hSep : IsSeparated 1 W) (hSW : S ⊆ W)
    (hdiam : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, |x - y| < 1) :
    S.card ≤ 1

declarations.name: separated_annulus_card_le_two
declarations.statement:
theorem separated_annulus_card_le_two
    (W : Finset ℝ) (t : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hSep : IsSeparated 1 W) :
    ({u ∈ W | u ≠ t ∧ (k : ℝ) ≤ |u - t| ∧ |u - t| < (k : ℝ) + 1}).card ≤ 2

declarations.name: sum_inv_distance_near_le_harmonic
declarations.statement:
theorem sum_inv_distance_near_le_harmonic
    (N : ℕ) (W : Finset ℝ) (t : ℝ) (hSep : IsSeparated 1 W) (ht : t ∈ W) :
    (∑ u ∈ {u ∈ W | u ≠ t ∧ |u - t| ≤ (N : ℝ)}, 1 / |u - t|) ≤
      2 * (((harmonic N : ℚ) : ℝ))

declarations.name: atkinson_isSeparated_div
atkinson_sum_inv_gap_le_harmonic
declarations.statement:
theorem atkinson_sum_inv_gap_le_harmonic {G : ℝ} {W S : Finset ℝ} {t : ℝ}
    (N : ℕ) (hG : 0 < G) (hSep : IsSeparated G W) (ht : t ∈ W)
    (hSW : S ⊆ W) (hnear : ∀ u ∈ S, u ≠ t ∧ |u-t| ≤ G*(N:ℝ)) :
    (∑ u ∈ S, 1/|u-t|) ≤ (2/G)*(harmonic N:ℝ)

declarations.name: atkinson_sum_inv_gap_le_harmonic_ceil
declarations.statement:
theorem atkinson_sum_inv_gap_le_harmonic_ceil {G L : ℝ} {W S : Finset ℝ} {t : ℝ}
    (hG : 0 < G) (hSep : IsSeparated G W) (ht : t ∈ W)
    (hSW : S ⊆ W) (hnear : ∀ u ∈ S, u ≠ t ∧ |u-t| ≤ L) :
    (∑ u ∈ S, 1/|u-t|) ≤ (2/G)*(harmonic (Nat.ceil (L/G)):ℝ)

declarations.statement: def atkinsonDyadicGapBudget (N : ℕ) (W : Finset ℝ) : ℝ

declarations.name: atkinsonDyadicGramBudget_le_gapBudget
declarations.statement:
theorem atkinsonDyadicGramBudget_le_gapBudget (N : ℕ) (W : Finset ℝ)
    (hgap : ∀ j < Nat.clog 2 N, ∀ t ∈ W, ∀ u ∈ W,
      atkinsonPrefixGramMax (2^j) (2^j) t u ≤ atkinsonPrefixGapMajorant (2^j) (2^j) t u) :
    atkinsonDyadicGramBudget N W ≤ atkinsonDyadicGapBudget N W

declarations.name: atkinsonDyadicGapBudget_empty

theorem atkinsonDyadicGapBudget_empty (N : ℕ) :

declarations.statement:
theorem atkinsonDyadicGapBudget_zero (W : Finset ℝ) :
    atkinsonDyadicGapBudget 0 W = 0

declarations.name: exists_atkinsonPhysicalGramBudget_le_gapBudget
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_atkinsonPhysicalGramBudget_le_gapBudget {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∃ H₀ : ℝ, 40000 ≤ H₀ ∧ ∀ H G : ℝ, ∀ W : Finset ℝ, H₀ ≤ H →
      (∀ t ∈ W, H ≤ t ∧ t ≤ 2*H ∧ t^δ ≤ G) →
      atkinsonDyadicGramBudget (atkinsonSourceCutoff (2*H) G (Real.log (2*H))) W ≤
        atkinsonDyadicGapBudget (atkinsonSourceCutoff (2*H) G (Real.log (2*H))) W

declarations.name: atkinson_quarter_energy_power
declarations.statement:
theorem atkinson_quarter_energy_power {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (η : ℝ) :
    (x^(-(1/4:ℝ)))^2*x^(1+η) = x^(1/2+η)

declarations.name: exists_atkinsonGapBudget_le_arithmetic
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_atkinsonGapBudget_le_arithmetic {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ N : ℕ, ∀ W : Finset ℝ,
      (∀ j < Nat.clog 2 N, ∀ t ∈ W, ∀ u ∈ W,
        0 ≤ atkinsonPrefixGapMajorant (2^j) (2^j) t u) →
      atkinsonDyadicGapBudget N W ≤ C*atkinsonArithmeticGapBudget η N W

declarations.name: exists_atkinsonPhysicalGapBudget_le_arithmetic
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_atkinsonPhysicalGapBudget_le_arithmetic {δ η : ℝ}
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ H₀ : ℝ, 40000 ≤ H₀ ∧ ∀ H G : ℝ, ∀ W : Finset ℝ,
      H₀ ≤ H → (∀ t ∈ W, H ≤ t ∧ t ≤ 2*H ∧ t^δ ≤ G) →
      atkinsonDyadicGapBudget (atkinsonSourceCutoff (2*H) G (Real.log (2*H))) W ≤
        C*atkinsonArithmeticGapBudget η (atkinsonSourceCutoff (2*H) G (Real.log (2*H))) W

declarations.name: atkinsonFarGapRow
declarations.statement: def atkinsonFarGapRow (H : ℝ) (M : ℕ) (W : Finset ℝ) (t : ℝ) : ℝ

declarations.name: atkinsonNearRowBound
declarations.statement: def atkinsonNearRowBound (H G : ℝ) (M : ℕ) : ℝ

declarations.name: atkinson_near_gap_row_le
declarations.statement:
theorem atkinson_near_gap_row_le {H G : ℝ} {M : ℕ} {W : Finset ℝ} {t : ℝ}
    (hH : 0 < H) (hG : 0 < G) (hM : 0 < M) (hSep : IsSeparated G W)
    (ht : t ∈ W) (hrange : ∀ u ∈ W, H ≤ u ∧ u ≤ 2*H) :
    (∑ u ∈ W with u ≠ t ∧ |u-t| ≤ Real.sqrt (H*(M:ℝ)),
      atkinsonPrefixGapMajorant M M t u) ≤
      120*Real.sqrt (H*(M:ℝ))/G*
        (harmonic (Nat.ceil (Real.sqrt (H*(M:ℝ))/G)):ℝ)

declarations.name: atkinson_gap_row_le_near_add_far
declarations.statement:
theorem atkinson_gap_row_le_near_add_far {H G : ℝ} {M : ℕ} {W : Finset ℝ} {t : ℝ}
    (hH : 0 < H) (hG : 0 < G) (hM : 0 < M) (hSep : IsSeparated G W)
    (ht : t ∈ W) (hrange : ∀ u ∈ W, H ≤ u ∧ u ≤ 2*H) :
    (∑ u ∈ W, atkinsonPrefixGapMajorant M M t u) ≤
      atkinsonNearRowBound H G M+atkinsonFarGapRow H M W t

declarations.name: atkinson_gap_double_sum_le_near_add_far
declarations.statement:
theorem atkinson_gap_double_sum_le_near_add_far {H G : ℝ} {M : ℕ} {W : Finset ℝ}
    (hH : 0 < H) (hG : 0 < G) (hM : 0 < M) (hSep : IsSeparated G W)
    (hrange : ∀ u ∈ W, H ≤ u ∧ u ≤ 2*H) :
    (∑ t ∈ W, ∑ u ∈ W, atkinsonPrefixGapMajorant M M t u) ≤
      (W.card:ℝ)*atkinsonNearRowBound H G M+∑ t ∈ W, atkinsonFarGapRow H M W t

declarations.statement:
theorem atkinsonArithmeticGapBudget_le_separated {H G η : ℝ} {N : ℕ} {W : Finset ℝ}

declarations.name: atkinson_far_slope_lower
atkinson_far_box_curvature_bounds
declarations.statement:
theorem atkinson_far_box_curvature_bounds {H u M B : ℝ}
    (hH : 0 < H) (hHu : H ≤ u) (huH : u ≤ 2*H)
    (hM : 0 < M) (hB : 0 < B) (hBM : B ≤ 4*M) :
    1/(320*(M*Real.sqrt (H*M))) ≤ atkinsonIndexBoxCurvatureLower u M B ∧
      atkinsonIndexBoxCurvatureUpper u M B ≤ 4/(M*Real.sqrt (H*M))

declarations.name: atkinson_far_lambda_bounds
declarations.statement:
theorem atkinson_far_lambda_bounds {H t u : ℝ} {M : ℕ}
    (hH : 0 < H) (hHu : H ≤ u) (huH : u ≤ 2*H) (htu : u < t) (hM : 0 < M) :
    (t-u)/(320*((M:ℝ)*Real.sqrt (H*(M:ℝ)))) ≤ atkinsonIndexBProcessLambda t u M M ∧
      atkinsonIndexBProcessLambdaUpper t u M M ≤ 4*(t-u)/((M:ℝ)*Real.sqrt (H*(M:ℝ)))

declarations.name: atkinson_far_inverse_sqrt
atkinson_far_second_factor
declarations.statement:
theorem atkinson_far_second_factor {Q d lam : ℝ}
    (hQ : 0 < Q) (hd : 0 < d) (hdQ : d ≤ Q) (hlam : d/(320*Q) ≤ lam) :
    2*Real.pi/Real.sqrt lam+2*(Real.sqrt lam/lam+1) ≤
      202*Real.sqrt (Q/d)

declarations.name: atkinson_far_radical_identity
atkinson_far_min_bProcess
declarations.statement:
theorem atkinson_far_min_bProcess {M R d lam upper : ℝ}
    (hM : 0 < M) (hR : 0 < R) (hRd : R ≤ d)
    (hlam : d/(320*(M*R)) ≤ lam) (hupper0 : 0 ≤ upper)
    (hupper : upper ≤ 4*d/(M*R)) :
    min M ((M*upper/(2*Real.pi)+2)*
      (2*Real.pi/Real.sqrt lam+2*(Real.sqrt lam/lam+1))) ≤
      2000*Real.sqrt (M*d/R)

declarations.name: atkinsonOrderedPrefixGapMajorant_le_min_bProcess
declarations.statement:
theorem atkinsonOrderedPrefixGapMajorant_le_min_bProcess (M N : ℕ) (t u : ℝ) :

declarations.name: atkinsonOrderedPrefixGapMajorant_le_far
declarations.statement:
theorem atkinsonOrderedPrefixGapMajorant_le_far {H t u : ℝ} {M : ℕ}
    (hH : 0 < H) (hHu : H ≤ u) (huH : u ≤ 2*H) (htu : u < t) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hfar : Real.sqrt (H*(M:ℝ)) ≤ t-u) :
    atkinsonOrderedPrefixGapMajorant M M t u ≤
      2000*Real.sqrt ((M:ℝ)*(t-u)/Real.sqrt (H*(M:ℝ)))

declarations.name: atkinsonPrefixGapMajorant_le_far
declarations.statement:
theorem atkinsonPrefixGapMajorant_le_far {H t u : ℝ} {M : ℕ}
    (hH : 0 < H) (htH : H ≤ t) (hHt : t ≤ 2*H)
    (huH : H ≤ u) (hHu : u ≤ 2*H) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hfar : Real.sqrt (H*(M:ℝ)) ≤ |t-u|) :
    atkinsonPrefixGapMajorant M M t u ≤
      2000*Real.sqrt ((M:ℝ)*|t-u|/Real.sqrt (H*(M:ℝ)))

declarations.name: atkinson_far_gap_row_le
declarations.statement:
theorem atkinson_far_gap_row_le {H L : ℝ} {M : ℕ} {W : Finset ℝ} {t : ℝ}
    (hH : 0 < H) (hM : 0 < M) (ht : t ∈ W)
    (hrange : ∀ u ∈ W, H ≤ u ∧ u ≤ 2*H)
    (hdiam : ∀ u ∈ W, |u-t| ≤ L) :
    atkinsonFarGapRow H M W t ≤
      (W.card:ℝ)*(2000*Real.sqrt ((M:ℝ)*L/Real.sqrt (H*(M:ℝ))))

declarations.name: atkinson_far_gap_double_sum_le
declarations.statement:
theorem atkinson_far_gap_double_sum_le {H L : ℝ} {M : ℕ} {W : Finset ℝ}
    (hH : 0 < H) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hrange : ∀ u ∈ W, H ≤ u ∧ u ≤ 2*H)
    (hdiam : ∀ t ∈ W, ∀ u ∈ W, |u-t| ≤ L) :
    (∑ t ∈ W, atkinsonFarGapRow H M W t) ≤
      (W.card:ℝ)^2*(2000*Real.sqrt ((M:ℝ)*L/Real.sqrt (H*(M:ℝ))))

theorem atkinsonSeparatedGapBudget_le_localized {H G L η : ℝ} {N : ℕ} {W : Finset ℝ}

theorem atkinson_weighted_diagonal_power {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 < M) (η : ℝ) :

theorem atkinson_weighted_near_power {H M : ℝ} (hH : 0 < H) (hM : 0 < M) (η : ℝ) :

theorem atkinson_localized_gap_term_eq {H : ℝ} {M : ℕ}

    (M:ℝ)^(1/2+η)*((R:ℝ)*atkinsonNearRowBound H G M+
      (R:ℝ)^2*(2000*Real.sqrt ((M:ℝ)*L/Real.sqrt (H*(M:ℝ))))) =
        atkinsonPowerGapTerm η H G L M R

declarations.name: exists_atkinsonPhysicalGramBudget_le_power
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_atkinsonPhysicalGramBudget_le_power {δ η : ℝ}
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ H₀ : ℝ, 40000 ≤ H₀ ∧
      ∀ H G A L : ℝ, ∀ W : Finset ℝ, H₀ ≤ H → H^δ ≤ G → IsSeparated G W →
      (∀ t ∈ W, H ≤ t ∧ t ≤ 2*H) →
      (∀ t ∈ W, A ≤ t ∧ t ≤ A+L) →
      atkinsonDyadicGramBudget (atkinsonSourceCutoff (2*H) G (Real.log (2*H))) W ≤
        C*atkinsonPowerGapBudget η H G L
          (atkinsonSourceCutoff (2*H) G (Real.log (2*H))) W.card

declarations.name: exists_sum_atkinsonUndampedDyadicPhaseBound_sq_le_power
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_sum_atkinsonUndampedDyadicPhaseBound_sq_le_power {δ η : ℝ}
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ H₀ : ℝ, 40000 ≤ H₀ ∧
      ∀ H G A L : ℝ, ∀ W : Finset ℝ, H₀ ≤ H → H^δ ≤ G → IsSeparated G W →
      (∀ t ∈ W, H ≤ t ∧ t ≤ 2*H) →
      (∀ t ∈ W, A ≤ t ∧ t ≤ A+L) →
      (∑ t ∈ W, atkinsonUndampedDyadicPhaseBound t
        (atkinsonSourceCutoff (2*H) G (Real.log (2*H))))^2 ≤
        C*atkinsonPowerGapBudget η H G L
          (atkinsonSourceCutoff (2*H) G (Real.log (2*H))) W.card

atkinson_harmonic_le_height_log
declarations.statement:
theorem atkinson_harmonic_le_height_log {H G : ℝ} {N : ℕ}

    (hN : (N:ℝ) ≤ H) :

declarations.name: eventually_atkinson_height_log_pow_le_rpow
declarations.statement:
theorem eventually_atkinson_height_log_pow_le_rpow (k : ℕ) {ν : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν) :

declarations.name: atkinsonPhysicalCutoff_le_natural
declarations.statement:
theorem atkinsonPhysicalCutoff_le_natural {H G : ℝ}
    (hH : 1 ≤ H) (hG : 0 < G) (hupper : G ≤ Real.sqrt (2*H))
    (hlog : 1 ≤ Real.log (2*H)) :
    (atkinsonSourceCutoff (2*H) G (Real.log (2*H)):ℝ) ≤
      74*H*(Real.log (2*H))^2/G^2

declarations.name: atkinsonPhysical_cutoff_scale_identity
declarations.statement:
theorem atkinsonPhysical_cutoff_scale_identity {H G ℓ : ℝ}
    (hH : 0 < H) (hG : 0 < G) (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (q : ℝ) :
    G^2*H^(-(1/2:ℝ))*(74*H*ℓ^2/G^2)^q =
      (74:ℝ)^q*H^(q-1/2)*ℓ^(2*q)*G^(2-2*q)

declarations.name: atkinsonPhysical_diagonal_scale
declarations.statement:
theorem atkinsonPhysical_diagonal_scale {H G ℓ : ℝ}
    (hH : 0 < H) (hG : 0 < G) (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) :
    G^2*H^(-(1/2:ℝ))*(74*H*ℓ^2/G^2)^(3/2:ℝ) ≤
      5476*(H/G)*ℓ^3

declarations.name: atkinsonPhysical_near_scale
declarations.statement:
theorem atkinsonPhysical_near_scale {H G ℓ : ℝ}
    (hH : 0 < H) (hG : 0 < G) (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) :
    (Real.sqrt H/G)*(G^2*H^(-(1/2:ℝ))*(74*H*ℓ^2/G^2)^(1:ℝ)) =
      74*(H/G)*ℓ^2

declarations.name: atkinsonPhysical_far_scale
declarations.statement:
theorem atkinsonPhysical_far_scale {H G ℓ L : ℝ}
    (hH : 0 < H) (hG : 0 < G) (hℓ : 1 ≤ ℓ) :
    (H^(-(1/4:ℝ))*Real.sqrt L)*(G^2*H^(-(1/2:ℝ))*(74*H*ℓ^2/G^2)^(3/4:ℝ)) ≤
      74*Real.sqrt (G*L)*ℓ^3

      (N:ℝ)^η*atkinsonPowerGapTerm 0 H G L N R

    (hH : 1 ≤ H) (hG : 1 ≤ G) (hlog : 1 ≤ Real.log (2*H))
    (hN : (N:ℝ) ≤ H) (hcut : (N:ℝ) ≤ 74*H*(Real.log (2*H))^2/G^2) :
    G^2*H^(-(1/2:ℝ))*atkinsonPowerGapTerm 0 H G L N R ≤
      148000*(Real.log (2*H))^3*((R:ℝ)*H/G+(R:ℝ)^2*Real.sqrt (G*L))

declarations.name: atkinsonPhysical_gap_budget_log_le

    (hlog : 1 ≤ Real.log (2*H)) (hN : (N:ℝ) ≤ H)
    (hcut : (N:ℝ) ≤ 74*H*(Real.log (2*H))^2/G^2) :
    G^2*H^(-(1/2:ℝ))*atkinsonPowerGapBudget η H G L N R ≤
      (148000*(1/Real.log 2+1)^2)*H^η*(Real.log (2*H))^5*
        ((R:ℝ)*H/G+(R:ℝ)^2*Real.sqrt (G*L))

declarations.statement:
theorem exists_atkinsonPhysicalGapBudget_le_twoTerm {δ ν : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hν : 0 < ν) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ H₀ : ℝ, 40000 ≤ H₀ ∧
      ∀ H G L : ℝ, ∀ R : ℕ, H₀ ≤ H → H^δ ≤ G → G ≤ Real.sqrt (2*H) →
        G^2*H^(-(1/2:ℝ))*
          atkinsonPowerGapBudget (ν/2) H G L

          C*H^ν*((R:ℝ)*H/G+(R:ℝ)^2*Real.sqrt (G*L))

        (20000/Real.pi^2)*(mellinMass w)^2*(L^2/H)*localReflectionEnergy L H U +
          E*T^(-100 : ℝ) ∧
      (∑ _t ∈ U, ‖hKernel w L 0‖^2) ≤ E*T^(-100 : ℝ)

declarations.name: LargeValueData.scalar_lower
declarations.statement:
theorem LargeValueData.scalar_lower {κ : ℝ} (d : LargeValueData κ) (hW : d.W.Nonempty) :
    1/(d.N : ℝ) ≤ bootstrapScalar d.T d.N d.V

declarations.name: LargeValueData.scalar_pos
declarations.statement:
theorem LargeValueData.scalar_pos {κ : ℝ} (d : LargeValueData κ) (hW : d.W.Nonempty) :
    0 < bootstrapScalar d.T d.N d.V

declarations.name: bootstrapFamily
declarations.statement: def bootstrapFamily (W : Finset ℝ) : Finset (Finset ℝ)

declarations.name: mem_bootstrapFamily
declarations.statement:
theorem mem_bootstrapFamily {W U : Finset ℝ} :
    U ∈ bootstrapFamily W ↔ U ⊆ W ∧ U.Nonempty

declarations.name: bootstrapFamily_nonempty
declarations.statement:
theorem bootstrapFamily_nonempty {W : Finset ℝ} (hW : W.Nonempty) :
    (bootstrapFamily W).Nonempty

declarations.name: localSet_subset_original
declarations.statement:
theorem localSet_subset_original {W U : Finset ℝ} (hU : U ⊆ W) (H : ℝ) (j : ℤ) :
    localSet U H j ⊆ W

declarations.name: bootstrapFamily_local_closed
declarations.statement:
theorem bootstrapFamily_local_closed {W U : Finset ℝ} (hU : U ∈ bootstrapFamily W)
    (H : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (hne : (localSet U H j).Nonempty) :
    localSet U H j ∈ bootstrapFamily W

declarations.name: LargeValueData.normalization_lower
declarations.statement:
theorem LargeValueData.normalization_lower {κ : ℝ} (d : LargeValueData κ)
    {U : Finset ℝ} (hU : U ∈ bootstrapFamily d.W) {L : ℝ} (hNL : (d.N : ℝ) ≤ L) :
    (d.N : ℝ) ≤ bootstrapScalar d.T d.N d.V * U.card * (L^2+(d.N : ℝ)*localDiameter U)

declarations.name: completePairEnergy_gram
declarations.statement:
theorem completePairEnergy_gram (M : ℕ) (U : Finset ℝ) :
    completePairEnergy M U =
      ∑ q ∈ Finset.Ico M (2*M), ∑ r ∈ Finset.Ico M (2*M),
        ‖∑ t ∈ U, dirichletPhase ((q : ℝ)/M) t *
          conj (dirichletPhase ((r : ℝ)/M) t)‖^2

declarations.name: completePairEnergy_diagonal_lower
declarations.statement:
theorem completePairEnergy_diagonal_lower (M : ℕ) (U : Finset ℝ) :
    (M : ℝ)*(U.card : ℝ)^2 ≤ completePairEnergy M U

declarations.name: norm_sum_mul_sq_le
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_sum_mul_sq_le {ι : Type*} (S : Finset ι) (a f : ι → ℂ)
    (ha : ∀ n ∈ S, ‖a n‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖∑ n ∈ S, a n*f n‖^2 ≤ (S.card : ℝ)*∑ n ∈ S, ‖f n‖^2

declarations.name: detecting_insertion_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem detecting_insertion_bound {N : ℕ} {a : ℕ → ℂ} (U : Finset ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ n ∈ Finset.Ioc N (2*N), ‖a n‖ ≤ 1)
    (hD : ∀ t ∈ U, detectingPolynomial N a t ≠ 0) (g : ℝ → ℂ) :
    ‖∑ t ∈ U, g t‖^2 ≤ (N : ℝ)*
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc N (2*N),
        ‖∑ t ∈ U, dirichletPhase ((n : ℝ)/N) t * g t / detectingPolynomial N a t‖^2

declarations.name: normalized_product_phase
declarations.statement:
theorem normalized_product_phase {N M n q : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hn : 0 < n) (hq : 0 < q) (t : ℝ) :
    dirichletPhase ((n : ℝ)/N) t * dirichletPhase ((q : ℝ)/M) t =
      dirichletPhase (((n*q : ℕ) : ℝ)/((N : ℝ)*M)) t

declarations.name: weighted_mode_expansion
declarations.statement:
theorem weighted_mode_expansion {ι κ τ : Type*} (Q : Finset ι) (R : Finset κ) (U : Finset τ)
    (w : κ → ℝ) (f : κ → τ → ℂ) (g : ι → τ → ℂ) (D : τ → ℂ) :
    ((∑ q ∈ Q, ∑ m ∈ R, w m * ‖∑ t ∈ U, f m t * conj (g q t) / D t‖^2 : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      ∑ t ∈ U, ∑ u ∈ U,
        (∑ m ∈ R, (w m : ℂ) * (f m t * conj (f m u))) *
          (∑ q ∈ Q, conj (g q t) * g q u) / (D t * conj (D u))

declarations.name: cutoff_finite_sum
declarations.statement:
theorem cutoff_finite_sum (w : ReflectionCutoff) {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (v : ℝ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (⌈5*L⌉₊+1), (w ((n : ℝ)/L) : ℂ)*dirichletPhase ((n : ℝ)/L) v) =
      (L : ℂ)*cutoffIntegral w v + hKernel w L v

declarations.name: comparisonExtension
declarations.statement: def comparisonExtension (w : ComparisonCutoff) (N M : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) (U : Finset ℝ) : ℝ

declarations.name: comparisonExtension_nonneg
declarations.statement:
theorem comparisonExtension_nonneg (w : ComparisonCutoff) (N M : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) (U : Finset ℝ) :
    0 ≤ comparisonExtension w N M a U

declarations.name: comparisonExtension_identity
declarations.statement:
theorem comparisonExtension_identity (w : ComparisonCutoff) {N M : ℕ}
    (hN : 0 < N) (hM : 0 < M) (a : ℕ → ℂ) (U : Finset ℝ) :
    (comparisonExtension w N M a U : ℂ) =
      ∑ t ∈ U, ∑ u ∈ U,
        ((((N : ℝ)*M : ℝ) : ℂ)*cutoffIntegral w.toReflectionCutoff (t-u) *
          conj (dyadicPolynomial M (t-u)) /
          (detectingPolynomial N a t * conj (detectingPolynomial N a u)) +
        hKernel w.toReflectionCutoff ((N : ℝ)*M) (t-u) *
          conj (dyadicPolynomial M (t-u)) /
          (detectingPolynomial N a t * conj (detectingPolynomial N a u)))

declarations.name: crude_kernel_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem crude_kernel_bound (w : ReflectionCutoff) {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 < B) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ L : ℝ, 0 < L → L ≤ B → ∀ v : ℝ, ‖hKernel w L v‖ ≤ K

declarations.name: bootstrapValues
declarations.statement: def bootstrapValues (w : ReflectionCutoff) {κ : ℝ} (d : LargeValueData κ) : Set ℝ

declarations.name: bootstrapBound
declarations.statement: def bootstrapBound (w : ReflectionCutoff) {κ : ℝ} (d : LargeValueData κ) : ℝ

declarations.name: bootstrapValues_nonempty
declarations.statement:
theorem bootstrapValues_nonempty (w : ReflectionCutoff) {κ : ℝ} (d : LargeValueData κ)
    (hW : d.W.Nonempty) : (bootstrapValues w d).Nonempty

declarations.name: bootstrapValues_bddAbove
declarations.statement:
theorem bootstrapValues_bddAbove (w : ReflectionCutoff) {κ : ℝ} (d : LargeValueData κ) :
    BddAbove (bootstrapValues w d)

declarations.name: bootstrapBound_nonneg
declarations.statement:
theorem bootstrapBound_nonneg (w : ReflectionCutoff) {κ : ℝ} (d : LargeValueData κ)
    (hW : d.W.Nonempty) : 0 ≤ bootstrapBound w d

declarations.name: kernelEnergy_le_bootstrapBound
declarations.statement:
theorem kernelEnergy_le_bootstrapBound (w : ReflectionCutoff) {κ : ℝ} (d : LargeValueData κ)
    {U : Finset ℝ} (hU : U ∈ bootstrapFamily d.W) {L : ℝ}
    (hL : L ∈ Icc (d.N : ℝ) (8*(d.T+1))) :
    kernelEnergy w L U ≤ bootstrapBound w d * bootstrapScalar d.T d.N d.V * U.card *
      (L^2+(d.N : ℝ)*localDiameter U)

declarations.name: comparison_extension_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem comparison_extension_bound (w : ComparisonCutoff) {T : ℝ} {N M : ℕ}
    (hN : 0 < N) (hM : 0 < M) (hscale : (N : ℝ)*M ≤ 8*(T+1))
    (a : ℕ → ℂ) (U : Finset ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ n ∈ Finset.Ioc N (2*N), ‖a n‖ ≤ 1)
    (hD : ∀ t ∈ U, detectingPolynomial N a t ≠ 0) :
    completePairEnergy M U ≤ (N : ℝ)*(divisorMaximum T : ℝ)*comparisonExtension w N M a U

declarations.name: dyadicPolynomial_norm_le
declarations.statement: theorem dyadicPolynomial_norm_le (M : ℕ) (v : ℝ) : ‖dyadicPolynomial M v‖ ≤ M

declarations.name: detecting_pair_division_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem detecting_pair_division_bound {T V : ℝ} {N : ℕ} {a : ℕ → ℂ}
    (hV : 0 < V) {t u : ℝ} (ht : V ≤ ‖detectingPolynomial N a t‖)
    (hu : V ≤ ‖detectingPolynomial N a u‖) (z : ℂ) :
    (N : ℝ)*(divisorMaximum T : ℝ)*
        ‖z/(detectingPolynomial N a t * conj (detectingPolynomial N a u))‖ ≤
      bootstrapScalar T N V * ‖z‖

declarations.name: bootstrapScalar_nonneg
declarations.statement: theorem bootstrapScalar_nonneg (T V : ℝ) (N : ℕ) : 0 ≤ bootstrapScalar T N V

declarations.name: comparison_continuous_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem comparison_continuous_bound (w : ComparisonCutoff) {C T V : ℝ} {N M : ℕ}
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hdecay : ∀ v : ℝ, ‖cutoffIntegral w.toReflectionCutoff v‖ ≤ C/(1+|v|)^2)
    (hV : 0 < V) (a : ℕ → ℂ) (U : Finset ℝ) (hsep : oneSeparated U)
    (hlarge : ∀ t ∈ U, V ≤ ‖detectingPolynomial N a t‖) :
    (N : ℝ)*(divisorMaximum T : ℝ)*
      (∑ t ∈ U, ∑ u ∈ U,
        ‖(((N : ℝ)*M : ℝ) : ℂ)*cutoffIntegral w.toReflectionCutoff (t-u) *
          conj (dyadicPolynomial M (t-u)) /
          (detectingPolynomial N a t * conj (detectingPolynomial N a u))‖) ≤
      (C*separationMass)*bootstrapScalar T N V*(N : ℝ)*(M : ℝ)^2*U.card

declarations.name: comparison_remainder_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem comparison_remainder_bound (w : ComparisonCutoff) {T V : ℝ} {N M : ℕ}
    (hV : 0 < V) (a : ℕ → ℂ) (U : Finset ℝ)
    (hlarge : ∀ t ∈ U, V ≤ ‖detectingPolynomial N a t‖) :
    (N : ℝ)*(divisorMaximum T : ℝ)*
      (∑ t ∈ U, ∑ u ∈ U,
        ‖hKernel w.toReflectionCutoff ((N : ℝ)*M) (t-u) *
          conj (dyadicPolynomial M (t-u)) /
          (detectingPolynomial N a t * conj (detectingPolynomial N a u))‖) ≤
      (bootstrapScalar T N V)^2/2 * kernelEnergy w.toReflectionCutoff ((N : ℝ)*M) U +
        completePairEnergy M U / 2

declarations.name: uniform_comparison
declarations.statement:
theorem uniform_comparison (w : ComparisonCutoff) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (T V : ℝ) (N M : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) (U : Finset ℝ),
      0 < N → 0 < M → (N : ℝ)*M ≤ 8*(T+1) → 0 < V → oneSeparated U →
      (∀ n ∈ Finset.Ioc N (2*N), ‖a n‖ ≤ 1) →
      (∀ t ∈ U, V ≤ ‖detectingPolynomial N a t‖) →
      completePairEnergy M U ≤ C*bootstrapScalar T N V*(N : ℝ)*(M : ℝ)^2*U.card +
        (bootstrapScalar T N V)^2*kernelEnergy w.toReflectionCutoff ((N : ℝ)*M) U

declarations.name: comparisonConstant
declarations.statement: def comparisonConstant (w : ComparisonCutoff) : ℝ

declarations.name: comparisonConstant_nonneg
declarations.statement: theorem comparisonConstant_nonneg (w : ComparisonCutoff) : 0 ≤ comparisonConstant w

declarations.name: local_comparison_from_supremum
declarations.statement:
theorem local_comparison_from_supremum (w : ComparisonCutoff) {κ : ℝ} (d : LargeValueData κ)
    (hW : d.W.Nonempty) {U : Finset ℝ} (hU : U ⊆ d.W) {L H : ℝ}
    (hL : (d.N : ℝ) ≤ L) (hH : 1 ≤ H) (hHT : H ≤ d.T)
    {M : ℕ} (hM : M ∈ reflectionBlocks L H) (j : ℤ) :
    completePairEnergy M (localSet U H j) ≤
      comparisonConstant w * bootstrapScalar d.T d.N d.V * (d.N : ℝ)*(M : ℝ)^2*(localSet U H j).card +
      bootstrapBound w.toReflectionCutoff d * (bootstrapScalar d.T d.N d.V)^3 *
        (localSet U H j).card * ((d.N : ℝ)^2*(M : ℝ)^2+4*(d.N : ℝ)*H)

declarations.name: reflectionBlock_scaled_square
declarations.statement:
theorem reflectionBlock_scaled_square {L H : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (hH : 0 < H)
    {M : ℕ} (hM : M ∈ reflectionBlocks L H) : (L^2/H)*(M : ℝ)^2 ≤ 16*H

declarations.name: localReflectionEnergy_from_supremum
declarations.statement:
theorem localReflectionEnergy_from_supremum (w : ComparisonCutoff) {κ : ℝ} (d : LargeValueData κ)
    (hW : d.W.Nonempty) {U : Finset ℝ} (hU : U ⊆ d.W) {L H : ℝ}
    (hL : (d.N : ℝ) ≤ L) (hH : 1 ≤ H) (hHT : H ≤ d.T) :
    (L^2/H)*localReflectionEnergy L H U ≤
      30*(U.card : ℝ)*(16*comparisonConstant w*bootstrapScalar d.T d.N d.V*(d.N : ℝ)*H +
        bootstrapBound w.toReflectionCutoff d*(bootstrapScalar d.T d.N d.V)^3*
          (16*(d.N : ℝ)^2*H+4*(d.N : ℝ)*L^2))

declarations.name: bootstrap_one_shell
declarations.statement:
theorem bootstrap_one_shell (w : ComparisonCutoff) :
    ∃ C E : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ 0 ≤ E ∧ ∀ {κ : ℝ} (d : LargeValueData κ), d.W.Nonempty →
      ∀ (U : Finset ℝ) (L H : ℝ), U ⊆ d.W → (d.N : ℝ) ≤ L → 1 ≤ H → H ≤ d.T →
      shellEnergy w.toReflectionCutoff L H U ≤
        C*bootstrapScalar d.T d.N d.V*(d.N : ℝ)*H*U.card +
        C*bootstrapBound w.toReflectionCutoff d*(bootstrapScalar d.T d.N d.V)^3*U.card*
          ((d.N : ℝ)^2*H+(d.N : ℝ)*L^2) + E*d.T^(-100 : ℝ)

declarations.name: shellIndices
declarations.statement: def shellIndices (U : Finset ℝ) : Finset ℕ

declarations.name: shellIndex_bounds
declarations.statement:
theorem shellIndex_bounds {U : Finset ℝ} {k : ℕ} (hk : k ∈ shellIndices U) :
    1 ≤ (2 : ℝ)^k ∧ (2 : ℝ)^k ≤ intervalSpan U

declarations.name: exists_shellIndex
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_shellIndex {U : Finset ℝ} {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hxU : x ≤ intervalSpan U) :
    ∃ k ∈ shellIndices U, (2 : ℝ)^k ≤ x ∧ x < 2*(2 : ℝ)^k

declarations.name: shellIndices_sum_le
declarations.statement:
theorem shellIndices_sum_le (U : Finset ℝ) :
    (∑ k ∈ shellIndices U, (2 : ℝ)^k) ≤ 2*localDiameter U

declarations.name: shellIndices_card_le_log
declarations.statement:
theorem shellIndices_card_le_log {U : Finset ℝ} {T : ℝ} (hT : 2 ≤ T)
    (hD : intervalSpan U ≤ T) :
    ((shellIndices U).card : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (2*T)/Real.log 2

declarations.name: shellIndices_card_le_diameter
declarations.statement:
theorem shellIndices_card_le_diameter (U : Finset ℝ) :
    ((shellIndices U).card : ℝ) ≤ localDiameter U

declarations.name: shellEnergy_nonneg
declarations.statement:
theorem shellEnergy_nonneg (w : ReflectionCutoff) (L H : ℝ) (U : Finset ℝ) :
    0 ≤ shellEnergy w L H U

declarations.name: kernelEnergy_le_dyadic_shells
declarations.statement:
theorem kernelEnergy_le_dyadic_shells (w : ReflectionCutoff) (L : ℝ)
    {U : Finset ℝ} (hsep : oneSeparated U) :
    kernelEnergy w L U ≤ (∑ _t ∈ U, ‖hKernel w L 0‖^2) +
      ∑ k ∈ shellIndices U, shellEnergy w L ((2 : ℝ)^k) U

declarations.name: bootstrap_preabsorption
declarations.statement:
theorem bootstrap_preabsorption (w : ComparisonCutoff) :
    ∃ C E : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ 0 ≤ E ∧ ∀ {κ : ℝ} (d : LargeValueData κ), d.W.Nonempty →
      ∀ (U : Finset ℝ) (L : ℝ), U ⊆ d.W → (d.N : ℝ) ≤ L →
      kernelEnergy w.toReflectionCutoff L U ≤
        2*C*bootstrapScalar d.T d.N d.V*(d.N : ℝ)*localDiameter U*U.card +
        C*bootstrapBound w.toReflectionCutoff d*(bootstrapScalar d.T d.N d.V)^3*U.card*
          (2*(d.N : ℝ)^2*localDiameter U+(d.N : ℝ)*L^2*(Real.log (2*d.T)/Real.log 2)) +
        E*d.T^(-90 : ℝ)

declarations.name: bootstrap_absorption_inequality
declarations.statement:
theorem bootstrap_absorption_inequality (w : ComparisonCutoff) :
    ∃ C₀ C₁ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C₀ ∧ 0 ≤ C₁ ∧ ∀ {κ : ℝ} (d : LargeValueData κ), d.W.Nonempty →
      bootstrapBound w.toReflectionCutoff d ≤ C₀ +
        C₁*(d.N : ℝ)*(bootstrapScalar d.T d.N d.V)^2*Real.log (2*d.T)*bootstrapBound w.toReflectionCutoff d

declarations.name: bootstrap_absorbed
declarations.statement:
theorem bootstrap_absorbed (w : ComparisonCutoff) :
    ∃ C₀ C₁ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C₀ ∧ 0 ≤ C₁ ∧ ∀ {κ : ℝ} (d : LargeValueData κ), d.W.Nonempty →
      C₁*(d.N : ℝ)*(bootstrapScalar d.T d.N d.V)^2*Real.log (2*d.T) ≤ 1/2 →
      bootstrapBound w.toReflectionCutoff d ≤ 2*C₀

declarations.name: LargeValueData.scalar_square_le
declarations.statement:
theorem LargeValueData.scalar_square_le {κ : ℝ} (d : LargeValueData κ) :
    (d.N : ℝ)*(bootstrapScalar d.T d.N d.V)^2 ≤
      (divisorMaximum d.T : ℝ)^2*(d.N : ℝ)^(-4*κ)

declarations.name: uniform_scalar_decay
declarations.statement:
theorem uniform_scalar_decay {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 < κ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ ∀ d : LargeValueData κ,
      (d.N : ℝ)*(bootstrapScalar d.T d.N d.V)^2 ≤ C*d.T^(-κ)

declarations.name: tendsto_power_log_two_mul
declarations.statement:
theorem tendsto_power_log_two_mul {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 < κ) :
    Tendsto (fun T : ℝ => T^(-κ)*Real.log (2*T)) atTop (𝓝 0)

declarations.name: uniform_absorption_threshold
declarations.statement:
theorem uniform_absorption_threshold {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 < κ) (A : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) :
    ∃ T₀ : ℝ, 2 ≤ T₀ ∧ ∀ d : LargeValueData κ, T₀ ≤ d.T →
      A*(d.N : ℝ)*(bootstrapScalar d.T d.N d.V)^2*Real.log (2*d.T) ≤ 1/2 ∧
      (d.N : ℝ)*(bootstrapScalar d.T d.N d.V)^2 ≤ 1

declarations.name: uniform_absorbed_kernel
declarations.statement:
theorem uniform_absorbed_kernel (w : ComparisonCutoff) {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 < κ) :
    ∃ C T₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ 2 ≤ T₀ ∧ ∀ d : LargeValueData κ, d.W.Nonempty → T₀ ≤ d.T →
      (d.N : ℝ)*(bootstrapScalar d.T d.N d.V)^2 ≤ 1 ∧
      ∀ (U : Finset ℝ) (L : ℝ), U ⊆ d.W → (d.N : ℝ) ≤ L → L ≤ 8*(d.T+1) →
        kernelEnergy w.toReflectionCutoff L U ≤ C*bootstrapScalar d.T d.N d.V*U.card*
          (L^2+(d.N : ℝ)*localDiameter U)

declarations.name: cardinality_at_length
declarations.statement:
theorem cardinality_at_length (w : ComparisonCutoff) {κ : ℝ} (d : LargeValueData κ)
    (hW : d.W.Nonempty) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 ≤ K) {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M)
    (hscale : (d.N : ℝ)*M ≤ 8*(d.T+1))
    (hsmall : (d.N : ℝ)*(bootstrapScalar d.T d.N d.V)^2 ≤ 1)
    (hQ : kernelEnergy w.toReflectionCutoff ((d.N : ℝ)*M) d.W ≤
      K*bootstrapScalar d.T d.N d.V*d.W.card*
        (((d.N : ℝ)*M)^2+(d.N : ℝ)*localDiameter d.W)) :
    (d.W.card : ℝ) ≤ (comparisonConstant w+K)*bootstrapScalar d.T d.N d.V*(d.N : ℝ)*M +
      K*(bootstrapScalar d.T d.N d.V)^3*(d.N : ℝ)*localDiameter d.W/M

declarations.name: optimal_integer_scale
declarations.statement:
theorem optimal_integer_scale {κ : ℝ} (d : LargeValueData κ) (hW : d.W.Nonempty)
    (hsmall : (d.N : ℝ)*(bootstrapScalar d.T d.N d.V)^2 ≤ 1) :
    ∃ M : ℕ, 0 < M ∧ (d.N : ℝ) ≤ (d.N : ℝ)*M ∧ (d.N : ℝ)*M ≤ 8*(d.T+1) ∧
      bootstrapScalar d.T d.N d.V*(d.N : ℝ)*M ≤
        (d.N : ℝ)*bootstrapScalar d.T d.N d.V+(d.N : ℝ)*(bootstrapScalar d.T d.N d.V)^2*Real.sqrt d.T ∧
      (bootstrapScalar d.T d.N d.V)^3*(d.N : ℝ)*localDiameter d.W/M ≤
        2*(d.N : ℝ)*(bootstrapScalar d.T d.N d.V)^2*Real.sqrt d.T

declarations.name: large_values_with_divisors
declarations.statement:
theorem large_values_with_divisors {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 < κ) :
    ∃ C T₀ : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ 2 ≤ T₀ ∧ ∀ d : LargeValueData κ, T₀ ≤ d.T →
      (d.W.card : ℝ) ≤ C*((divisorMaximum d.T : ℝ)*(d.N : ℝ)^2/d.V^2 +
        (divisorMaximum d.T : ℝ)^2*(d.N : ℝ)^3*Real.sqrt d.T/d.V^4)

declarations.name: large_values_data
declarations.statement:
theorem large_values_data {κ ε : ℝ} (hκ : 0 < κ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ d : LargeValueData κ,
      (d.W.card : ℝ) ≤ C*d.T^ε*((d.N : ℝ)^2/d.V^2+
        (d.N : ℝ)^3*Real.sqrt d.T/d.V^4)

declarations.name: large_values
declarations.statement:
theorem large_values {κ ε : ℝ} (hκ : 0 < κ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (T V : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) (W : Finset ℝ),
      2 ≤ T → 0 < N → 0 < V → T^(1/3 : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) → (N : ℝ) ≤ T →
      (N : ℝ)^(3/4+κ) ≤ V →
      (∀ n ∈ Finset.Ioc N (2*N), ‖a n‖ ≤ 1) →
      (∃ t₀ : ℝ, ∀ t ∈ W, t₀ ≤ t ∧ t ≤ t₀+T) →
      (∀ t ∈ W, ∀ u ∈ W, t ≠ u → 1 ≤ |t-u|) →
      (∀ t ∈ W, V ≤ ‖detectingPolynomial N a t‖) →
      (W.card : ℝ) ≤ C*T^ε*((N : ℝ)^2/V^2+(N : ℝ)^3*Real.sqrt T/V^4)

declarations.statement:
theorem zetaSlab_large_values_cover {κ ε : ℝ} (hκ : 0 < κ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (σ lo hi H B : ℝ) (J : Finset ℕ)
      (N : ℕ → ℕ) (V : ℕ → ℝ) (coeff : ℕ → ℕ → ℂ),
      2 ≤ H → 0 ≤ B → hi ≤ lo+H →
      (∀ k : ℤ, (∑ ρ ∈ (zetaZeroFinset σ lo hi).filter
        (fun ρ => ordinateBin ρ = k), (zetaMultiplicity ρ : ℝ)) ≤ B) →
      (∀ j ∈ J, 0 < N j ∧ 0 < V j ∧ H^(1/3 : ℝ) ≤ (N j : ℝ) ∧
        (N j : ℝ) ≤ H ∧ (N j : ℝ)^(3/4+κ) ≤ V j ∧
        ∀ n ∈ Finset.Ioc (N j) (2*N j), ‖coeff j n‖ ≤ 1) →
      (∀ ρ ∈ zetaZeroFinset σ lo hi, ∃ j ∈ J,
        V j ≤ ‖detectingPolynomial (N j) (coeff j) ρ.im‖) →
      (zetaSlabCount σ lo hi : ℝ) ≤ C*B*H^ε*
        ∑ j ∈ J, ((N j : ℝ)^2/(V j)^2+(N j : ℝ)^3*Real.sqrt H/(V j)^4)

declarations.name: detector_shifted_rpow_le
declarations.statement:
theorem detector_shifted_rpow_le {T γ v q : ℝ} (hT : 1 ≤ T)
    (hγ : |γ| ≤ 2*T) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hq' : q ≤ 1) :
    (1+|γ+v|)^q ≤ 3*T^q*(1+|v|)

declarations.name: uniform_detector_integral_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem uniform_detector_integral_bound :
    ∃ A : ℝ, 0 < A ∧ ∀ (q C T X Y : ℝ) (ρ : ℂ),
      0 ≤ q → q ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ C → 1 ≤ T → 0 ≤ X → 0 < Y →
      3/4 ≤ ρ.re → ρ.re ≤ 1 → |ρ.im| ≤ 2*T →
      (∀ t : ℝ, ‖riemannZeta ((1/2 : ℂ)+(t : ℂ)*I)‖ ≤ C*(1+|t|)^q) →
      ‖detectorIntegral ρ X Y‖ ≤ A*C*Real.sqrt X*Y^(1/2-ρ.re)*T^q

declarations.name: norm_detectorResidue_le
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_detectorResidue_le {ρ : ℂ} {X Y : ℝ}
    (hX : 0 ≤ X) (hY : 0 < Y) (hβ : 3/4 ≤ ρ.re) (hβ' : ρ.re ≤ 1)
    (hγ : 1 ≤ |ρ.im|) :
    ‖detectorResidue ρ X Y‖ ≤
      24*Real.sqrt X*Y^(1-ρ.re)*(1+|ρ.im|)*Real.exp (-|ρ.im|)

declarations.name: norm_firstDetector_residue_le
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_firstDetector_residue_le {ρ : ℂ} {T : ℝ}
    (hT : 1 ≤ T) (hβ : 3/4 ≤ ρ.re) (hβ' : ρ.re ≤ 1)
    (hγ : T ≤ |ρ.im|) (hγ' : |ρ.im| ≤ 2*T) :
    ‖detectorResidue ρ (firstDetectorX T) T‖ ≤ 72*T^3*Real.exp (-T)

declarations.name: firstDetector_residue_eventually_small
declarations.statement:
theorem firstDetector_residue_eventually_small {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∀ᶠ T : ℝ in atTop, ∀ ρ : ℂ,
      3/4 ≤ ρ.re → ρ.re ≤ 1 → T ≤ |ρ.im| → |ρ.im| ≤ 2*T →
      ‖detectorResidue ρ (firstDetectorX T) T‖ < δ

declarations.name: firstDetector_eventually_small_of_zeta_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem firstDetector_eventually_small_of_zeta_bound {η C δ : ℝ}
    (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hη' : η < 1/48) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hW : ∀ t : ℝ, ‖riemannZeta ((1/2 : ℂ)+(t : ℂ)*I)‖ ≤ C*(1+|t|)^(1/6+η)) :
    ∀ᶠ T : ℝ in atTop, ∀ ρ : ℂ,
      3/4 ≤ ρ.re → ρ.re < 1 → T ≤ |ρ.im| → |ρ.im| ≤ 2*T →
      riemannZeta ρ = 0 →
      ‖smoothedDetector ρ (firstDetectorX T) (1/T)‖ < δ

declarations.name: detectorTerm
declarations.statement: def detectorTerm (ρ : ℂ) (X T : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℂ

declarations.name: norm_detectorTerm_le
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_detectorTerm_le {ρ : ℂ} (X : ℝ) {T : ℝ} (n : ℕ)
    (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ.re) :
    ‖detectorTerm ρ X T n‖ ≤ (⌊X⌋₊ : ℝ)*Real.exp (-(n : ℝ)/T)

declarations.name: norm_detector_tail_le
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_detector_tail_le {ρ : ℂ} (X : ℝ) {T : ℝ} (K : ℕ)
    (hT : 0 < T) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ.re) :
    ‖∑' n : ℕ, detectorTerm ρ X T (n+K)‖ ≤
      (⌊X⌋₊ : ℝ)*Real.exp (-(K : ℝ)/T)*(1-Real.exp (-1/T))⁻¹

declarations.name: detector_geometric_factor_le
declarations.statement:
theorem detector_geometric_factor_le {T : ℝ} (hT : 1 ≤ T) :
    (1-Real.exp (-1/T))⁻¹ ≤ 2*T

declarations.name: firstDetectorCutoff
declarations.statement: def firstDetectorCutoff (T : ℝ) : ℕ

declarations.name: norm_firstDetector_tail_le
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_firstDetector_tail_le {ρ : ℂ} {T : ℝ}
    (hT : 1 ≤ T) (hlog : 4 ≤ Real.log T) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ.re) :
    ‖∑' n : ℕ, detectorTerm ρ (firstDetectorX T) T (n+firstDetectorCutoff T)‖ ≤
      4*T^(-2 : ℝ)

declarations.name: firstDetector_tail_eventually_small
declarations.statement:
theorem firstDetector_tail_eventually_small {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∀ᶠ T : ℝ in atTop, ∀ ρ : ℂ, 0 ≤ ρ.re →
      ‖∑' n : ℕ, detectorTerm ρ (firstDetectorX T) T (n+firstDetectorCutoff T)‖ < δ

declarations.statement:

lemma sum_inv_natCast_add_one_real (n : ℕ) :

declarations.name: logGammaSeq
declarations.statement: noncomputable def logGammaSeq (z : ℂ) (n : ℕ) : ℂ

declarations.name: logGammaSeq_succ_sub
declarations.statement:
lemma logGammaSeq_succ_sub {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.re) (n : ℕ) :
    logGammaSeq z (n + 1) - logGammaSeq z n
      = z * ((Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1) - Real.log n : ℝ) : ℂ) - log (1 + z / ((n : ℂ) + 1))

declarations.name: cauchySeq_logGammaSeq
declarations.statement: lemma cauchySeq_logGammaSeq {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.re) : CauchySeq (logGammaSeq z)

declarations.name: exp_logGammaSeq
declarations.statement:
lemma exp_logGammaSeq {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.re) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :

declarations.name: hasSum_digamma_of_re_pos
declarations.statement:
lemma hasSum_digamma_of_re_pos {z₀ : ℂ} (hz₀ : 0 < z₀.re) :
    HasSum (fun m : ℕ => ((m : ℂ) + 1)⁻¹ - (z₀ + m)⁻¹)
      (digamma z₀ + Real.eulerMascheroniConstant)

declarations.name: hasSum_digamma
declarations.statement:
theorem hasSum_digamma {z : ℂ} (hz : ∀ n : ℕ, z ≠ -n) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => 1 / ((n : ℂ) + 1) - 1 / ((n : ℂ) + z))
      (digamma z + Real.eulerMascheroniConstant)

declarations.name: digamma_eq_tsum
declarations.statement:
theorem digamma_eq_tsum {z : ℂ} (hz : ∀ n : ℕ, z ≠ -n) :
    digamma z = -(Real.eulerMascheroniConstant : ℂ)
      + ∑' n : ℕ, (1 / ((n : ℂ) + 1) - 1 / ((n : ℂ) + z))

declarations.name: hasSum_real_digamma
declarations.statement:
theorem hasSum_real_digamma {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) - 1 / ((n : ℝ) + x))
      ((Complex.digamma (x : ℂ)).re + Real.eulerMascheroniConstant)

declarations.name: hasSum_digamma_difference
declarations.statement:
theorem hasSum_digamma_difference {x y : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + x) - 1 / ((n : ℝ) + y))
      ((Complex.digamma (y : ℂ)).re - (Complex.digamma (x : ℂ)).re)

declarations.name: tendsto_log_sub_reciprocal_sum
declarations.statement:
theorem tendsto_log_sub_reciprocal_sum {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => Real.log ((N : ℝ) + x) -
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, 1 / ((n : ℝ) + x)) atTop
        (𝓝 (Complex.digamma (x : ℂ)).re)

declarations.name: hasSum_harmonic_tail
declarations.statement:
theorem hasSum_harmonic_tail {N : ℕ} {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y)
    (hNy : y < (N : ℝ) + 1) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => 1 / (((n : ℝ) + N + 1) * ((n : ℝ) + N + 1 - y)))
      (((Complex.digamma ((N : ℝ) + 1 : ℝ)).re -
        (Complex.digamma ((N : ℝ) + 1 - y : ℝ)).re) / y)

declarations.name: reciprocal_le_chord
declarations.statement:
theorem reciprocal_le_chord {u t : ℝ} (hu : 0 < u) (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    1 / (u + t) ≤ (1 - t) / u + t / (u + 1)

declarations.name: log_succ_sub_le
declarations.statement:
theorem log_succ_sub_le {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 < u) :
    Real.log (u + 1) - Real.log u ≤ (1 / u + 1 / (u + 1)) / 2

declarations.name: le_log_succ_sub
declarations.statement:
theorem le_log_succ_sub {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 < u) :
    1 / (u + 1) ≤ Real.log (u + 1) - Real.log u

declarations.name: log_sub_reciprocal_sum_bounds
declarations.statement:
theorem log_sub_reciprocal_sum_bounds {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (N : ℕ) :
    Real.log x - 1 / x + 1 / ((N : ℝ) + x) ≤
        Real.log ((N : ℝ) + x) - ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, 1 / ((n : ℝ) + x) ∧
      Real.log ((N : ℝ) + x) - ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, 1 / ((n : ℝ) + x) ≤
        Real.log x - (1 / x) / 2 + (1 / ((N : ℝ) + x)) / 2

declarations.name: real_digamma_bounds
declarations.statement:
theorem real_digamma_bounds {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    Real.log x - 1 / x ≤ (Complex.digamma (x : ℂ)).re ∧
      (Complex.digamma (x : ℂ)).re ≤ Real.log x - 1 / (2 * x)

declarations.name: harmonic_tail_bounds
declarations.statement:
theorem harmonic_tail_bounds {N : ℕ} {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y)
    (hNy : y < (N : ℝ) + 1) :
    -1 / (y * ((N : ℝ) + 1)) - (Complex.digamma ((N : ℝ) + 1 - y : ℝ)).re / y ≤
        (∑' n : ℕ, 1 / (((n : ℝ) + N + 1) * ((n : ℝ) + N + 1 - y))) -
          Real.log ((N : ℝ) + 1) / y ∧
      (∑' n : ℕ, 1 / (((n : ℝ) + N + 1) * ((n : ℝ) + N + 1 - y))) -
          Real.log ((N : ℝ) + 1) / y ≤
        -1 / (2 * y * ((N : ℝ) + 1)) -
          (Complex.digamma ((N : ℝ) + 1 - y : ℝ)).re / y

declarations.name: hasSum_harmonic_plus
declarations.statement:
theorem hasSum_harmonic_plus {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => 1 / (((n : ℝ) + 1) * ((n : ℝ) + 1 + y)))
      (((Complex.digamma (y + 1 : ℝ)).re + Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) / y)

declarations.name: harmonic_plus_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem harmonic_plus_bound {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) :
    (∑' n : ℕ, 1 / (((n : ℝ) + 1) * ((n : ℝ) + 1 + y))) ≤
      (Real.log (y + 1) + Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) / y - 1 / (2 * y * (y + 1))

declarations.name: sum_bounds_from_differences
declarations.statement:
private theorem sum_bounds_from_differences (f F : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) (hF : Tendsto F atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hlo : ∀ n, F n - F (n + 1) ≤ f n)
    (hhi : ∀ n, f (n + 1) ≤ F n - F (n + 1)) :
    Summable f ∧ F 0 ≤ ∑' n, f n ∧ (∑' n, f n) ≤ f 0 + F 0

declarations.name: reciprocal_square_series_bounds
declarations.statement:
theorem reciprocal_square_series_bounds {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + x) ^ 2) ∧
      1 / x ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, 1 / ((n : ℝ) + x) ^ 2 ∧
      (∑' n : ℕ, 1 / ((n : ℝ) + x) ^ 2) ≤ 1 / x ^ 2 + 1 / x

declarations.name: reciprocal_cube_series_bounds
declarations.statement:
theorem reciprocal_cube_series_bounds {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + x) ^ 3) ∧
      1 / (2 * x ^ 2) ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, 1 / ((n : ℝ) + x) ^ 3 ∧
      (∑' n : ℕ, 1 / ((n : ℝ) + x) ^ 3) ≤ 1 / x ^ 3 + 1 / (2 * x ^ 2)

declarations.name: reciprocal_square_series_sharp
declarations.statement:
theorem reciprocal_square_series_sharp {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    1 / x ^ 2 + 1 / (x + 1) ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, 1 / ((n : ℝ) + x) ^ 2 ∧
      (∑' n : ℕ, 1 / ((n : ℝ) + x) ^ 2) ≤
        1 / x ^ 2 + 1 / (x + 1) ^ 2 + 1 / (x + 1)

declarations.name: hasSum_harmonic_tail_square
declarations.statement:
theorem hasSum_harmonic_tail_square {N : ℕ} {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y)
    (hNy : y < (N : ℝ) + 1) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => 1 / (((n : ℝ) + N + 1) * ((n : ℝ) + N + 1 - y) ^ 2))
      ((∑' n : ℕ, 1 / ((n : ℝ) + ((N : ℝ) + 1 - y)) ^ 2) / y -
        ((Complex.digamma ((N : ℝ) + 1 : ℝ)).re -
          (Complex.digamma ((N : ℝ) + 1 - y : ℝ)).re) / y ^ 2)

declarations.name: hasSum_harmonic_tail_cube
declarations.statement:
theorem hasSum_harmonic_tail_cube {N : ℕ} {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y)
    (hNy : y < (N : ℝ) + 1) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => 1 / (((n : ℝ) + N + 1) * ((n : ℝ) + N + 1 - y) ^ 3))
      ((∑' n : ℕ, 1 / ((n : ℝ) + ((N : ℝ) + 1 - y)) ^ 3) / y -
        (∑' n : ℕ, 1 / ((n : ℝ) + ((N : ℝ) + 1 - y)) ^ 2) / y ^ 2 +
        ((Complex.digamma ((N : ℝ) + 1 : ℝ)).re -
          (Complex.digamma ((N : ℝ) + 1 - y : ℝ)).re) / y ^ 3)

declarations.name: hasSum_harmonic_plus_square
declarations.statement:
theorem hasSum_harmonic_plus_square {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => 1 / (((n : ℝ) + 1) * ((n : ℝ) + 1 + y) ^ 2))

declarations.name: hasSum_harmonic_plus_cube
declarations.statement:
theorem hasSum_harmonic_plus_cube {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => 1 / (((n : ℝ) + 1) * ((n : ℝ) + 1 + y) ^ 3))

declarations.name: harmonic_plus_square_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem harmonic_plus_square_bound {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) :
    (∑' n : ℕ, 1 / (((n : ℝ) + 1) * ((n : ℝ) + 1 + y) ^ 2)) ≤
      (Real.log (y + 1) + Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) / y ^ 2 -

declarations.name: harmonic_plus_cube_bound

theorem harmonic_plus_cube_bound {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) :

declarations.name: source_harmonic_tail_identity
declarations.statement:
theorem source_harmonic_tail_identity {N : ℕ} {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y)
    (hNy : y < (N : ℝ) + 1) :

      ((Complex.digamma ((N : ℝ) + 1 : ℝ)).re -
        (Complex.digamma ((N : ℝ) + 1 - y : ℝ)).re) / y

declarations.name: source_harmonic_tail_power_eq

declarations.name: digamma_two_mul
declarations.statement:
theorem digamma_two_mul {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.re) :
    Complex.digamma (2 * z) = Complex.digamma z / 2 +
      Complex.digamma (z + 1 / 2) / 2 + Complex.log 2

declarations.name: real_digamma_two_mul
declarations.statement:
theorem real_digamma_two_mul {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    (Complex.digamma (2 * x : ℝ)).re = (Complex.digamma (x : ℂ)).re / 2 +
      (Complex.digamma (x + 1 / 2 : ℝ)).re / 2 + Real.log 2

declarations.name: hasSum_paired_reciprocal
declarations.statement:
theorem hasSum_paired_reciprocal {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => 1 / (2 * (n : ℝ) + x) - 1 / (2 * (n : ℝ) + 1 + x))
      (((Complex.digamma ((x + 1) / 2 : ℝ)).re -
        (Complex.digamma (x / 2 : ℝ)).re) / 2)

declarations.name: reciprocal_sub_succ
declarations.statement:
private theorem reciprocal_sub_succ {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 < u) :

declarations.name: hasSum_reciprocal_unit_difference
declarations.statement:
private theorem hasSum_reciprocal_unit_difference {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + x) - 1 / ((↑(n + 1) : ℝ) + x)) (1 / x)

declarations.name: paired_reciprocal_bounds
declarations.statement:
theorem paired_reciprocal_bounds {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    0 ≤ ((Complex.digamma ((x + 1) / 2 : ℝ)).re -
        (Complex.digamma (x / 2 : ℝ)).re) / 2 ∧
      ((Complex.digamma ((x + 1) / 2 : ℝ)).re -
        (Complex.digamma (x / 2 : ℝ)).re) / 2 ≤ 1 / x

declarations.name: paired_reciprocal_source_eq
declarations.statement:
theorem paired_reciprocal_source_eq {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    ((Complex.digamma ((x + 1) / 2 : ℝ)).re -
      (Complex.digamma (x / 2 : ℝ)).re) / 2 =
        Real.log 2 + (Complex.digamma ((x + 1) / 2 : ℝ)).re -

declarations.name: alternating_reciprocal_difference

      ((Complex.digamma ((a + 1) / 2 : ℝ)).re - (Complex.digamma (a / 2 : ℝ)).re) / 2

declarations.name: hasSum_alternating_harmonic_plus
declarations.statement:
theorem hasSum_alternating_harmonic_plus {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) :

declarations.name: alternating_harmonic_plus_bound
declarations.statement:

declarations.name: source_alternating_harmonic_plus_identity
declarations.statement:
theorem source_alternating_harmonic_plus_identity {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) :

declarations.name: norm_finiteS1_le

declarations.name: norm_negativeTail_le_source
declarations.statement:

declarations.name: positiveTail_half_integer

declarations.name: nonstationary_interval_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem nonstationary_interval_bound {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b) (φ h : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hφ : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 φ (Set.Icc a b))
    (hφ' : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, deriv φ x ≠ 0)
    (hc : ContinuousOn (fun x => h x / deriv φ x) (Set.Icc a b))
    (ha : AntitoneOn (fun x => |h x / deriv φ x|) (Set.Icc a b)) :
    ‖∫ x in a..b, (h x : ℂ) * Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * (φ x : ℂ))‖ ≤
      |h a / deriv φ a| / Real.pi

declarations.name: deriv_frequency_shift
frequency_shift_deriv_neg
declarations.statement:
theorem frequency_shift_deriv_neg {a b ν : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, DifferentiableAt ℝ f x)
    (hanti : AntitoneOn (deriv f) (Set.Icc a b)) (hν : deriv f a < ν)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc a b) :
    deriv (fun u => f u - ν * u) x < 0

declarations.name: negative_frequency_quotient_antitone
declarations.statement:
theorem negative_frequency_quotient_antitone {a b ν : ℝ} {f h : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, DifferentiableAt ℝ f x)
    (hfanti : AntitoneOn (deriv f) (Set.Icc a b))
    (hhanti : AntitoneOn (fun x => |h x|) (Set.Icc a b)) (hν : deriv f a < ν) :
    AntitoneOn (fun x => |h x / deriv (fun u => f u - ν * u) x|) (Set.Icc a b)

declarations.name: negative_frequency_integral_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem negative_frequency_integral_bound {a b ν : ℝ} (hab : a < b) (f h : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f (Set.Icc a b))
    (hfd : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, DifferentiableAt ℝ f x)
    (hfc : ContinuousOn (deriv f) (Set.Icc a b))
    (hfa : AntitoneOn (deriv f) (Set.Icc a b))
    (hhc : ContinuousOn h (Set.Icc a b))
    (hha : AntitoneOn (fun x => |h x|) (Set.Icc a b)) (hν : deriv f a < ν) :
    ‖∫ x in a..b, (h x : ℂ) *
      Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * ((f x - ν * x : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ≤
        |h a| / (Real.pi * (ν - deriv f a))

declarations.name: positive_frequency_quotient_antitone

declarations.name: weighted_slope_quotient_antitone

declarations.name: weighted_slope_abs_antitone

declarations.name: positive_frequency_integral_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem positive_frequency_integral_bound {a b ν : ℝ} (hab : a < b) (f h : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f (Set.Icc a b))

      Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * ((f x + ν * x : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ≤

declarations.name: contDiffOn_one_of_continuous_deriv
weighted_wave_hasDerivAt
declarations.statement:
theorem weighted_wave_hasDerivAt {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {x : ℝ}
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f x) (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g x) :
    HasDerivAt (fun u => (g u : ℂ) * Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * (f u : ℂ)))
      ((((deriv g x : ℝ) : ℂ) + 2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * (g x : ℂ) * ((deriv f x : ℝ) : ℂ)) *

declarations.name: norm_integral_two_amplitudes_le
declarations.statement:

declarations.name: negative_derivative_amplitude_integral_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem negative_derivative_amplitude_integral_bound {a b ν : ℝ} (hab : a < b) (f g : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hfd : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, DifferentiableAt ℝ f x)
    (hfc : ContinuousOn (deriv f) (Set.Icc a b))
    (hfp : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, 0 ≤ deriv f x)
    (hfa : AntitoneOn (deriv f) (Set.Icc a b))
    (hgc : ContinuousOn g (Set.Icc a b)) (hgdc : ContinuousOn (deriv g) (Set.Icc a b))
    (hgp : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, 0 ≤ g x) (hga : AntitoneOn g (Set.Icc a b))
    (hgda : AntitoneOn (fun x => |deriv g x|) (Set.Icc a b)) (hν : deriv f a < ν) :
    ‖∫ x in a..b, (((deriv g x : ℝ) : ℂ) + 2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * ((g x * deriv f x : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
      Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * ((f x - ν * x : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ≤
        (|deriv g a| + 2 * Real.pi * g a * deriv f a) / (Real.pi * (ν - deriv f a))

declarations.name: positive_derivative_amplitude_integral_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem positive_derivative_amplitude_integral_bound {a b ν : ℝ} (hab : a < b) (f g : ℝ → ℝ)

    (hgdq : AntitoneOn (fun x => |deriv g x| / (1 + deriv f x)) (Set.Icc a b)) (hν : 1 ≤ ν) :
    ‖∫ x in a..b, (((deriv g x : ℝ) : ℂ) + 2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * ((g x * deriv f x : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
      Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * ((f x + ν * x : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ≤

declarations.name: first_derivative_test_antitone
declarations.statement:
theorem first_derivative_test_antitone {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)

declarations.name: first_derivative_test
declarations.statement:
theorem first_derivative_test {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)

first_derivative_test_sup

declarations.name: oscillatory_integral_parts
declarations.statement:
theorem oscillatory_integral_parts {a b : ℝ} {f p p' h h' : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ u ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt f (p u) u)
    (hp : ∀ u ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt p (p' u) u)
    (hh : ∀ u ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt h (h' u) u)
    (hpc : ContinuousOn p (Set.uIcc a b)) (hppc : ContinuousOn p' (Set.uIcc a b))
    (hhpc : ContinuousOn h' (Set.uIcc a b)) (hn : ∀ u ∈ Set.uIcc a b, p u ≠ 0) :
    (∫ u in a..b, (h u : ℂ) * exp (I * (f u : ℂ))) =
      ((h b / p b : ℝ) * exp (I * (f b : ℂ)) -
        (h a / p a : ℝ) * exp (I * (f a : ℂ))) / I -
      (∫ u in a..b, (((h' u * p u - h u * p' u) / (p u) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        exp (I * (f u : ℂ))) / I

declarations.name: norm_oscillatory_integral_sub_boundary_le
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_oscillatory_integral_sub_boundary_le {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    {f p p' h h' : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc a b, HasDerivAt f (p u) u)
    (hp : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc a b, HasDerivAt p (p' u) u)
    (hh : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc a b, HasDerivAt h (h' u) u)
    (hpc : ContinuousOn p (Set.Icc a b)) (hppc : ContinuousOn p' (Set.Icc a b))
    (hhpc : ContinuousOn h' (Set.Icc a b)) (hn : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc a b, p u ≠ 0)
    (hq1 : AntitoneOn (fun u => |h' u| / (p u) ^ 2) (Set.Icc a b))
    (hq2 : AntitoneOn (fun u => |h u * p' u| / |p u| ^ 3) (Set.Icc a b)) :
    ‖(∫ u in a..b, (h u : ℂ) * exp (I * (f u : ℂ))) -
      ((h b / p b : ℝ) * exp (I * (f b : ℂ)) -
        (h a / p a : ℝ) * exp (I * (f a : ℂ))) / I‖ ≤
      2 * |h' a| / (p a) ^ 2 + 2 * |h a * p' a| / |p a| ^ 3

declarations.name: norm_expMode_integral_sub_boundary_le
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_expMode_integral_sub_boundary_le {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    {f p p' h h' : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc a b, HasDerivAt f (p u) u)
    (hp : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc a b, HasDerivAt p (p' u) u)
    (hh : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc a b, HasDerivAt h (h' u) u)
    (hpc : ContinuousOn p (Set.Icc a b)) (hppc : ContinuousOn p' (Set.Icc a b))
    (hhpc : ContinuousOn h' (Set.Icc a b)) (hn : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc a b, p u ≠ 0)
    (hq1 : AntitoneOn (fun u => |h' u| / (p u) ^ 2) (Set.Icc a b))
    (hq2 : AntitoneOn (fun u => |h u * p' u| / |p u| ^ 3) (Set.Icc a b)) :
    ‖(∫ u in a..b, (h u : ℂ) * exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * I * (f u : ℂ))) -
      ((h b / p b : ℝ) * exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * I * (f b : ℂ)) -
        (h a / p a : ℝ) * exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * I * (f a : ℂ))) /
          (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * I)‖ ≤
      |h' a| / (2 * Real.pi ^ 2 * (p a) ^ 2) +
        |h a * p' a| / (2 * Real.pi ^ 2 * |p a| ^ 3)

declarations.name: negative_second_quotients_antitone
declarations.statement:
theorem negative_second_quotients_antitone {a b ν : ℝ} {p p' h h' : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hab : a ≤ b) (hpa : AntitoneOn p (Set.Icc a b))
    (hha : AntitoneOn (fun u => |h u|) (Set.Icc a b))
    (hhpa : AntitoneOn (fun u => |h' u|) (Set.Icc a b))
    (hppa : AntitoneOn (fun u => |p' u|) (Set.Icc a b)) (hν : p a < ν) :
    AntitoneOn (fun u => |h' u| / (p u - ν) ^ 2) (Set.Icc a b) ∧
    AntitoneOn (fun u => |h u * p' u| / |p u - ν| ^ 3) (Set.Icc a b)

declarations.name: norm_negative_exp_integral_sub_boundary_le
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_negative_exp_integral_sub_boundary_le {a b ν : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    {f p p' h h' : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc a b, HasDerivAt f (p u) u)
    (hp : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc a b, HasDerivAt p (p' u) u)
    (hh : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc a b, HasDerivAt h (h' u) u)
    (hpc : ContinuousOn p (Set.Icc a b)) (hppc : ContinuousOn p' (Set.Icc a b))
    (hhpc : ContinuousOn h' (Set.Icc a b)) (hpa : AntitoneOn p (Set.Icc a b))
    (hha : AntitoneOn (fun u => |h u|) (Set.Icc a b))
    (hhpa : AntitoneOn (fun u => |h' u|) (Set.Icc a b))
    (hppa : AntitoneOn (fun u => |p' u|) (Set.Icc a b)) (hν : p a < ν) :
    ‖(∫ u in a..b, (h u : ℂ) * exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * I * ((f u - ν * u : ℝ) : ℂ))) -
      (((h b / (p b - ν) : ℝ) : ℂ) * exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * I * ((f b - ν * b : ℝ) : ℂ)) -
        ((h a / (p a - ν) : ℝ) : ℂ) * exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * I * ((f a - ν * a : ℝ) : ℂ))) /
          (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * I)‖ ≤
      |h' a| / (2 * Real.pi ^ 2 * (ν - p a) ^ 2) +
        |h a * p' a| / (2 * Real.pi ^ 2 * (ν - p a) ^ 3)

declarations.name: secondModeTerm
declarations.statement: noncomputable def secondModeTerm (f h : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℂ

declarations.name: secondModeEndpoint
declarations.statement: noncomputable def secondModeEndpoint (f p h : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℂ

declarations.name: secondModeEndpoint_eq
declarations.statement:
theorem secondModeEndpoint_eq (f p h : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    secondModeEndpoint f p h x n =
      ((h x : ℂ) * exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * I * (f x : ℂ)) / (4 * (Real.pi : ℂ) ^ 2 * I)) *
        (expMode (-x) (n + 1) / (((n : ℝ) + 1) * ((n : ℝ) + 1 + p x) : ℝ))

declarations.name: summable_secondModeEndpoint
declarations.statement:
theorem summable_secondModeEndpoint (f p h : ℝ → ℝ) {x : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p x) :
    Summable (secondModeEndpoint f p h x)

declarations.name: tsum_secondModeEndpoint
declarations.statement:
theorem tsum_secondModeEndpoint (f p h : ℝ → ℝ) {x : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p x) :
    (∑' n : ℕ, secondModeEndpoint f p h x n) =
      ((h x : ℂ) * exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * I * (f x : ℂ)) / (4 * (Real.pi : ℂ) ^ 2 * I)) *
        positiveTail (-x) (p x)

declarations.name: norm_tsum_secondModeEndpoint
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_tsum_secondModeEndpoint (f p h : ℝ → ℝ) {x : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p x) :
    ‖∑' n : ℕ, secondModeEndpoint f p h x n‖ =
      |h x| / (4 * Real.pi ^ 2) * ‖positiveTail (-x) (p x)‖

declarations.name: secondModeTerm_remainder_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem secondModeTerm_remainder_bound {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    {f p p' h h' : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc a b, HasDerivAt f (p u) u)
    (hp : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc a b, HasDerivAt p (p' u) u)
    (hh : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc a b, HasDerivAt h (h' u) u)
    (hpc : ContinuousOn p (Set.Icc a b)) (hppc : ContinuousOn p' (Set.Icc a b))
    (hhpc : ContinuousOn h' (Set.Icc a b))
    (hpos : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc a b, 0 < p u) (n : ℕ)
    (hq1 : AntitoneOn (fun u => |h' u| / (((n : ℝ) + 1) + p u) ^ 2) (Set.Icc a b))
    (hq2 : AntitoneOn (fun u => |h u * p' u| / (((n : ℝ) + 1) + p u) ^ 3) (Set.Icc a b)) :
    ‖secondModeTerm f h a b n - (secondModeEndpoint f p h b n - secondModeEndpoint f p h a n)‖ ≤
      (|h' a| / (4 * Real.pi ^ 3)) * (1 / (((n : ℝ) + 1) * ((n : ℝ) + 1 + p a) ^ 2)) +
        (|h a * p' a| / (4 * Real.pi ^ 3)) * (1 / (((n : ℝ) + 1) * ((n : ℝ) + 1 + p a) ^ 3))

declarations.name: secondModeTail_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem secondModeTail_bound {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    {f p p' h h' : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc a b, HasDerivAt f (p u) u)
    (hp : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc a b, HasDerivAt p (p' u) u)
    (hh : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc a b, HasDerivAt h (h' u) u)
    (hpc : ContinuousOn p (Set.Icc a b)) (hppc : ContinuousOn p' (Set.Icc a b))
    (hhpc : ContinuousOn h' (Set.Icc a b))
    (hpos : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc a b, 0 < p u)
    (hq1 : ∀ n : ℕ, AntitoneOn (fun u => |h' u| / (((n : ℝ) + 1) + p u) ^ 2) (Set.Icc a b))
    (hq2 : ∀ n : ℕ, AntitoneOn (fun u => |h u * p' u| / (((n : ℝ) + 1) + p u) ^ 3) (Set.Icc a b)) :
    Summable (secondModeTerm f h a b) ∧
    ‖∑' n : ℕ, secondModeTerm f h a b n‖ ≤
      |h b| / (4 * Real.pi ^ 2) * ‖positiveTail (-b) (p b)‖ +
      |h a| / (4 * Real.pi ^ 2) * ‖positiveTail (-a) (p a)‖ +
      (|h' a| / (4 * Real.pi ^ 3)) * (∑' n : ℕ, 1 / (((n : ℝ) + 1) * ((n : ℝ) + 1 + p a) ^ 2)) +
      (|h a * p' a| / (4 * Real.pi ^ 3)) * (∑' n : ℕ, 1 / (((n : ℝ) + 1) * ((n : ℝ) + 1 + p a) ^ 3))

declarations.name: secondModeTail_source_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem secondModeTail_source_bound {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    {f p p' h h' : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc a b, HasDerivAt f (p u) u)
    (hp : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc a b, HasDerivAt p (p' u) u)
    (hh : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc a b, HasDerivAt h (h' u) u)
    (hpc : ContinuousOn p (Set.Icc a b)) (hppc : ContinuousOn p' (Set.Icc a b))
    (hhpc : ContinuousOn h' (Set.Icc a b))
    (hpos : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc a b, 0 < p u)
    (hq1 : ∀ n : ℕ, AntitoneOn (fun u => |h' u| / (((n : ℝ) + 1) + p u) ^ 2) (Set.Icc a b))
    (hq2 : ∀ n : ℕ, AntitoneOn (fun u => |h u * p' u| / (((n : ℝ) + 1) + p u) ^ 3) (Set.Icc a b)) :
    ‖∑' n : ℕ, secondModeTerm f h a b n‖ ≤
      |h b| / (4 * Real.pi ^ 2) * ‖positiveTail (-b) (p b)‖ +
      |h a| / (4 * Real.pi ^ 2) * ‖positiveTail (-a) (p a)‖ +
      (|h' a| / (4 * Real.pi ^ 3)) *
        ((Real.log (p a + 1) + Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) / (p a) ^ 2 -
          (1 + 2 * p a) / (2 * (p a) ^ 2 * (p a + 1))) +
      (|h a * p' a| / (4 * Real.pi ^ 3)) *
        ((Real.log (p a + 1) + Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) / (p a) ^ 3 -
          (1 + 3 * p a + 3 * (p a) ^ 2) / (2 * (p a) ^ 3 * (p a + 1) ^ 2))

declarations.name: upperModeEndpoint_eq
declarations.statement:
theorem upperModeEndpoint_eq (f p h : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) (M n : ℕ) :
    upperModeEndpoint f p h x M n =
      (-((h x : ℂ) * exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * I * (f x : ℂ)) / (4 * (Real.pi : ℂ) ^ 2 * I))) *
        (expMode x (n + M + 1) / (((n : ℝ) + M + 1) * ((n : ℝ) + M + 1 - p x) : ℝ))

declarations.name: summable_upperModeEndpoint
tsum_upperModeEndpoint
declarations.statement:
theorem tsum_upperModeEndpoint (f p h : ℝ → ℝ) {x : ℝ} {M : ℕ}
    (hp : 0 < p x) (hM : p x < (M : ℝ) + 1) :
    (∑' n : ℕ, upperModeEndpoint f p h x M n) =
      (-((h x : ℂ) * exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * I * (f x : ℂ)) / (4 * (Real.pi : ℂ) ^ 2 * I))) *

    ‖∑' n : ℕ, upperModeEndpoint f p h x M n‖ =
      |h x| / (4 * Real.pi ^ 2) * ‖negativeTail M x (p x)‖

declarations.name: upperModeTerm_remainder_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem upperModeTerm_remainder_bound {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    {f p p' h h' : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc a b, HasDerivAt f (p u) u)
    (hp : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc a b, HasDerivAt p (p' u) u)
    (hh : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc a b, HasDerivAt h (h' u) u)
    (hpc : ContinuousOn p (Set.Icc a b)) (hppc : ContinuousOn p' (Set.Icc a b))
    (hhpc : ContinuousOn h' (Set.Icc a b))
    (hpa : AntitoneOn p (Set.Icc a b))
    (hha : AntitoneOn (fun u => |h u|) (Set.Icc a b))
    (hhpa : AntitoneOn (fun u => |h' u|) (Set.Icc a b))
    (hppa : AntitoneOn (fun u => |p' u|) (Set.Icc a b))
    {M : ℕ} (hM : p a < (M : ℝ) + 1) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖upperModeTerm f h a b M n - (upperModeEndpoint f p h b M n - upperModeEndpoint f p h a M n)‖ ≤
      (|h' a| / (4 * Real.pi ^ 3)) * (1 / (((n : ℝ) + M + 1) * ((n : ℝ) + M + 1 - p a) ^ 2)) +
        (|h a * p' a| / (4 * Real.pi ^ 3)) * (1 / (((n : ℝ) + M + 1) * ((n : ℝ) + M + 1 - p a) ^ 3))

declarations.name: upperModeTail_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem upperModeTail_bound {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    {f p p' h h' : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc a b, HasDerivAt f (p u) u)
    (hp : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc a b, HasDerivAt p (p' u) u)
    (hh : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc a b, HasDerivAt h (h' u) u)
    (hpc : ContinuousOn p (Set.Icc a b)) (hppc : ContinuousOn p' (Set.Icc a b))
    (hhpc : ContinuousOn h' (Set.Icc a b))
    (hpa : AntitoneOn p (Set.Icc a b))
    (hha : AntitoneOn (fun u => |h u|) (Set.Icc a b))
    (hhpa : AntitoneOn (fun u => |h' u|) (Set.Icc a b))
    (hppa : AntitoneOn (fun u => |p' u|) (Set.Icc a b))
    (hpos : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc a b, 0 < p u) {M : ℕ} (hM : p a < (M : ℝ) + 1) :
    Summable (upperModeTerm f h a b M) ∧
    ‖∑' n : ℕ, upperModeTerm f h a b M n‖ ≤
      |h b| / (4 * Real.pi ^ 2) * ‖negativeTail M b (p b)‖ +
      |h a| / (4 * Real.pi ^ 2) * ‖negativeTail M a (p a)‖ +
      (|h' a| / (4 * Real.pi ^ 3)) * (∑' n : ℕ, 1 / (((n : ℝ) + M + 1) * ((n : ℝ) + M + 1 - p a) ^ 2)) +
      (|h a * p' a| / (4 * Real.pi ^ 3)) * (∑' n : ℕ, 1 / (((n : ℝ) + M + 1) * ((n : ℝ) + M + 1 - p a) ^ 3))

declarations.statement:
theorem upperModeTail_source_bound {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    {f p p' h h' : ℝ → ℝ}

declarations.statement:
theorem afe_second_derivative_quotient {σ c ν u : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hν : 0 < ν) (hu : 0 < u) :
    |deriv (deriv (afeWeight σ)) u| / (ν + deriv (afePhase c) u) ^ 2 =

declarations.name: afe_derivative_curvature_quotient
declarations.statement:
theorem afe_derivative_curvature_quotient {σ c ν u : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hν : 0 < ν) (hu : 0 < u) :

      σ * c * (u ^ (-σ) / (ν * u + c) ^ 3)

theorem afe_product_derivative_quotient {σ c ν u : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)

declarations.name: afe_product_curvature_quotient

theorem afe_product_curvature_quotient {σ c ν u : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)

    |(afeWeight σ u * deriv (afePhase c) u) * deriv (deriv (afePhase c)) u| /

      c ^ 2 * (u ^ (-σ) / (ν * u + c) ^ 3)

declarations.name: afe_second_quotients_antitone
declarations.statement:
theorem afe_second_quotients_antitone {σ c ν : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hν : 0 < ν) :
    AntitoneOn (fun u => |deriv (deriv (afeWeight σ)) u| /
      (ν + deriv (afePhase c) u) ^ 2) (Set.Ioi 0) ∧
    AntitoneOn (fun u => |deriv (afeWeight σ) u * deriv (deriv (afePhase c)) u| /
      (ν + deriv (afePhase c) u) ^ 3) (Set.Ioi 0) ∧
    AntitoneOn (fun u => |deriv (fun v => afeWeight σ v * deriv (afePhase c) v) u| /
      (ν + deriv (afePhase c) u) ^ 2) (Set.Ioi 0) ∧
    AntitoneOn (fun u => |(afeWeight σ u * deriv (afePhase c) u) * deriv (deriv (afePhase c)) u| /
      (ν + deriv (afePhase c) u) ^ 3) (Set.Ioi 0)

declarations.name: afe_positive_second_integral_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem afe_positive_second_integral_bound {σ c ν a b : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hν : 0 < ν) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (h : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hh : h = deriv (afeWeight σ) ∨ h = fun u => afeWeight σ u * deriv (afePhase c) u) :
    ‖(∫ u in a..b, (h u : ℂ) * exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * I *
      ((afePhase c u + ν * u : ℝ) : ℂ))) -
      (((h b / (ν + deriv (afePhase c) b) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * I * ((afePhase c b + ν * b : ℝ) : ℂ)) -
       ((h a / (ν + deriv (afePhase c) a) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * I * ((afePhase c a + ν * a : ℝ) : ℂ))) /
          (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * I)‖ ≤
      |deriv h a| / (2 * Real.pi ^ 2 * (ν + deriv (afePhase c) a) ^ 2) +
        |h a * deriv (deriv (afePhase c)) a| /
          (2 * Real.pi ^ 2 * (ν + deriv (afePhase c) a) ^ 3)

declarations.name: afe_positive_second_tail_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem afe_positive_second_tail_bound {σ c a b : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (h : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hh : h = deriv (afeWeight σ) ∨ h = fun u => afeWeight σ u * deriv (afePhase c) u) :
    Summable (secondModeTerm (afePhase c) h a b) ∧
    ‖∑' n : ℕ, secondModeTerm (afePhase c) h a b n‖ ≤
      |h b| / (4 * Real.pi ^ 2) * ‖positiveTail (-b) (c / b)‖ +
      |h a| / (4 * Real.pi ^ 2) * ‖positiveTail (-a) (c / a)‖ +
      (|deriv h a| / (4 * Real.pi ^ 3)) *
        ((Real.log (c / a + 1) + Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) / (c / a) ^ 2 -
          (1 + 2 * (c / a)) / (2 * (c / a) ^ 2 * (c / a + 1))) +
      (|h a * (-c / a ^ 2)| / (4 * Real.pi ^ 3)) *
        ((Real.log (c / a + 1) + Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) / (c / a) ^ 3 -
          (1 + 3 * (c / a) + 3 * (c / a) ^ 2) / (2 * (c / a) ^ 3 * (c / a + 1) ^ 2))

structure PartIRegularity (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) : Prop where

  f_deriv_antitone : AntitoneOn (deriv f) (Set.Icc a b)
  g_differentiable : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, DifferentiableAt ℝ g x

  g_nonneg : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, 0 ≤ g x
  g_antitone : AntitoneOn g (Set.Icc a b)
  g_abs_deriv_antitone : AntitoneOn (fun x => |deriv g x|) (Set.Icc a b)
  g_quotient_antitone : AntitoneOn (fun x => |deriv g x| / (1 + deriv f x)) (Set.Icc a b)

declarations.statement:
theorem negativeCoefficient_bound {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}

    ‖negativeCoefficient f g a b n‖ ≤

declarations.name: waveDerivative_mul_phase
declarations.statement:
theorem waveDerivative_mul_phase (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (x ν : ℝ) :
    waveDerivative f g x * Complex.exp (-2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * (ν : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) =
      (((deriv g x : ℝ) : ℂ) + 2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * ((g x * deriv f x : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
        Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * ((f x - ν * x : ℝ) : ℂ))

declarations.name: integral_waveDerivative_expMode
declarations.statement:
theorem integral_waveDerivative_expMode (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (∫ x in a..b, waveDerivative f g x * expMode x n) = derivativeMode f g a b n

theorem integral_waveDerivative_expMode_neg (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :

      derivativeMode f g a b (-(n : ℝ))

declarations.name: integral_waveDerivative_sawtoothMode
declarations.statement:
theorem integral_waveDerivative_sawtoothMode {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (h : PartIRegularity f g a b) (n : ℕ) :
    (∫ x in a..b, waveDerivative f g x * sawtoothMode n x) =
      negativeCoefficient f g a b n - positiveCoefficient f g a b n

declarations.name: integral_waveDerivative_sawtooth
declarations.statement:
theorem integral_waveDerivative_sawtooth {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (h : PartIRegularity f g a b) :
    (∫ x in a..b, waveDerivative f g x * ((Int.fract x - 1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
      (∑' n, negativeCoefficient f g a b n) - ∑' n, positiveCoefficient f g a b n

declarations.name: norm_negativeCoefficient_tail_le_digamma
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_negativeCoefficient_tail_le_digamma {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (h : PartIRegularity f g a b) {N : ℕ} (hN : deriv f a < (N : ℝ) + 1) :
    ‖∑' n : ℕ, negativeCoefficient f g a b (n + N + 1)‖ ≤
      partICoefficient f g a *
        (((Complex.digamma ((N : ℝ) + 1 : ℝ)).re -
          (Complex.digamma ((N : ℝ) + 1 - deriv f a : ℝ)).re) / deriv f a)

declarations.name: norm_positiveCoefficient_sum_le_digamma
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_positiveCoefficient_sum_le_digamma {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (h : PartIRegularity f g a b) :
    ‖∑' n : ℕ, positiveCoefficient f g a b n‖ ≤
      partICoefficient f g a *
        (((Complex.digamma (deriv f a + 1 : ℝ)).re + Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) / deriv f a)

declarations.name: norm_negativeCoefficient_tail_le_source
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_negativeCoefficient_tail_le_source {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (h : PartIRegularity f g a b) {N : ℕ} (hN : deriv f a < (N : ℝ) + 1) :
    ‖∑' n : ℕ, negativeCoefficient f g a b (n + N + 1)‖ ≤
      (partICoefficient f g a / deriv f a) *
        (Real.log ((N : ℝ) + 1) - 1 / (2 * ((N : ℝ) + 1)) -
          (Complex.digamma ((N : ℝ) + 1 - deriv f a : ℝ)).re)

declarations.name: norm_positiveCoefficient_sum_le_source
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_positiveCoefficient_sum_le_source {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (h : PartIRegularity f g a b) :
    ‖∑' n : ℕ, positiveCoefficient f g a b n‖ ≤
      (partICoefficient f g a / deriv f a) *
        (Real.eulerMascheroniConstant + Real.log (1 + deriv f a) -
          1 / (2 * (1 + deriv f a)))

declarations.statement: noncomputable def B1 (x : ℝ) : ℝ

declarations.name: aestronglyMeasurable_B1
declarations.statement: lemma aestronglyMeasurable_B1 : AEStronglyMeasurable B1

declarations.statement: lemma abs_B1_le_half {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) : |B1 x| ≤ 1 / 2

declarations.name: integral_deriv_mul_add_const
declarations.statement:
lemma integral_deriv_mul_add_const (c : 𝕜) (hab : a ≤ b) (h_int : IntervalIntegrable (deriv f) volume a b)
    (hf_diff : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, DifferentiableAt ℝ f t) :
    ∫ t in a..b, (t + c) * deriv f t = (b + c) * f b - (a + c) * f a - ∫ t in a..b, f t

declarations.name: intervalIntegrable_deriv_mul_B1
declarations.statement:
lemma intervalIntegrable_deriv_mul_B1 (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) (h_cont : ContinuousOn (deriv f) [[a, b]]) :
    IntervalIntegrable (fun t ↦ deriv f t * B1 t) volume a b

declarations.name: integral_deriv_mul_floor_add_one
declarations.statement:
lemma integral_deriv_mul_floor_add_one (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf_diff : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, DifferentiableAt ℝ f t) (h_cont : ContinuousOn (deriv f) [[a, b]]) :
    ∫ t in a..b, deriv f t * (⌊t⌋₊ + 1) = (b + 1 / 2) * f b - (a + 1 / 2) * f a - (∫ t in a..b, f t) - ∫ t in a..b, deriv f t * B1 t

declarations.name: sum_eq_integral_add_integral_deriv
declarations.statement:
theorem sum_eq_integral_add_integral_deriv (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf_diff : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, DifferentiableAt ℝ f t)
    (h_cont : ContinuousOn (deriv f) [[a, b]]) :
    ∑ k ∈ Ioc ⌊a⌋₊ ⌊b⌋₊, f k =
      f a * B1 a - f b * B1 b + (∫ t in a..b, f t) + ∫ t in a..b, deriv f t * B1 t
