declarations.statement: theorem B1_eq_fract {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) : B1 x = Int.fract x - 1 / 2

declarations.name: sum_shift_nat_floor
declarations.statement:
theorem sum_shift_nat_floor (F : ℝ → ℂ) {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (k : ℤ) (hk : (k : ℝ) ≤ a) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc ⌊a - k⌋₊ ⌊b - k⌋₊, F ((n : ℝ) + k)) =
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc ⌊a⌋ ⌊b⌋, F (n : ℝ)

declarations.name: euler_maclaurin_int
declarations.statement:
theorem euler_maclaurin_int {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (F : ℝ → ℂ)
    (hd : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, DifferentiableAt ℝ F x)
    (hc : ContinuousOn (deriv F) (Set.Icc a b)) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc ⌊a⌋ ⌊b⌋, F (n : ℝ)) =
      F a * ((Int.fract a - 1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) - F b * ((Int.fract b - 1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) +
        (∫ x in a..b, F x) + ∫ x in a..b, deriv F x * ((Int.fract x - 1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)

declarations.statement: noncomputable def poissonBoundary (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) : ℂ

declarations.name: weighted_sum_eq_fourier
declarations.statement:
theorem weighted_sum_eq_fourier {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (h : PartIRegularity f g a b) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc ⌊a⌋ ⌊b⌋, weightedWave f g (n : ℝ)) =
      poissonBoundary f g a b + (∫ x in a..b, weightedWave f g x) +
        ((∑' n, negativeCoefficient f g a b n) - ∑' n, positiveCoefficient f g a b n)

theorem hasDerivAt_expMode (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :

negativeCoefficient_eq_boundary_add_integral
declarations.statement:
theorem negativeCoefficient_eq_boundary_add_integral {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (h : PartIRegularity f g a b) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    negativeCoefficient f g a b n =
      weightedWave f g b * expMode b n / (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * n) -
      weightedWave f g a * expMode a n / (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * n) +
        ∫ x in a..b, weightedWave f g x * expMode x n

declarations.name: poissonHeadBoundary_eq_sum
declarations.statement:
theorem poissonHeadBoundary_eq_sum (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) (M : ℕ) :
    poissonHeadBoundary f g x M =
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, weightedWave f g x * expMode x n / (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * n)

declarations.name: sum_negativeCoefficient_head
declarations.statement:
theorem sum_negativeCoefficient_head {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (h : PartIRegularity f g a b) (M : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, negativeCoefficient f g a b n) =
      poissonHeadBoundary f g b M - poissonHeadBoundary f g a M +
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, ∫ x in a..b, weightedWave f g x * expMode x n

declarations.name: poissonMain_eq_zero_add_head
declarations.statement:
theorem poissonMain_eq_zero_add_head (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (M : ℕ) :
    poissonMain f g a b M = (∫ x in a..b, weightedWave f g x) +
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, ∫ x in a..b, weightedWave f g x * expMode x n

declarations.name: negativeCoefficient_sum_eq_head_add_tail
declarations.statement:
theorem negativeCoefficient_sum_eq_head_add_tail {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (h : PartIRegularity f g a b) (M : ℕ) :
    (∑' n, negativeCoefficient f g a b n) =
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, negativeCoefficient f g a b n) +
        ∑' n : ℕ, negativeCoefficient f g a b (n + M + 1)

declarations.name: weighted_sum_eq_poissonMain_add_remainder
declarations.statement:
theorem weighted_sum_eq_poissonMain_add_remainder {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (h : PartIRegularity f g a b) (M : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc ⌊a⌋ ⌊b⌋, weightedWave f g (n : ℝ)) - poissonMain f g a b M =
      poissonHeadBoundary f g b M - poissonHeadBoundary f g a M +
        (∑' n : ℕ, negativeCoefficient f g a b (n + M + 1)) -
          (∑' n, positiveCoefficient f g a b n) + poissonBoundary f g a b

theorem norm_poissonHeadBoundary {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {x : ℝ} (hg : 0 ≤ g x) (M : ℕ) :

declarations.name: corrected_poisson_partI_zero
declarations.statement:
theorem corrected_poisson_partI_zero {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (h : PartIRegularity f g a b) :
    ‖(∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc ⌊a⌋ ⌊b⌋, weightedWave f g (n : ℝ)) -
      poissonMain f g a b ⌊deriv f a⌋₊‖ ≤ partIZeroError f g a b

declarations.name: poissonMain_eq_source
declarations.statement:
theorem poissonMain_eq_source (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (M : ℕ) :
    poissonMain f g a b M = ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 0 M,
      ∫ x in a..b, (g x : ℂ) *
        Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * ((f x - (n : ℝ) * x : ℝ) : ℂ))

declarations.statement:

    ‖finiteS1 ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) y‖ ≤ Real.log 2 + 1 / y

declarations.name: norm_poissonHeadBoundary_half_integer_le
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_poissonHeadBoundary_half_integer_le {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {x y : ℝ}
    (hx : ∃ k : ℤ, x = (k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) (hg : 0 ≤ g x) (hy : 0 < y) :
    ‖poissonHeadBoundary f g x ⌊y⌋₊‖ ≤
      g x / (2 * Real.pi) * (Real.log 2 + 1 / y)

declarations.name: corrected_poisson_partI_zero_half_integer
declarations.statement:
theorem corrected_poisson_partI_zero_half_integer {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (h : PartIRegularity f g a b)
    (ha : ∃ k : ℤ, a = (k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) (hb : ∃ k : ℤ, b = (k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) :
    ‖(∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc ⌊a⌋ ⌊b⌋, weightedWave f g (n : ℝ)) -
      poissonMain f g a b ⌊deriv f a⌋₊‖ ≤
        partIAnalyticError f g a + (g a + g b) / (2 * Real.pi) * (Real.log 2 + 1 / deriv f a)

declarations.name: corrected_poisson_partI_zero_noninteger
declarations.statement:
theorem corrected_poisson_partI_zero_noninteger {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (h : PartIRegularity f g a b)
    (ha : ∀ k : ℤ, a ≠ (k : ℝ)) (hb : ∀ k : ℤ, b ≠ (k : ℝ)) :
    ‖(∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc ⌊a⌋ ⌊b⌋, weightedWave f g (n : ℝ)) -
      poissonMain f g a b ⌊deriv f a⌋₊‖ ≤ partIAnalyticError f g a +
        (g b * tildeS1 b (deriv f a) + g a * tildeS1 a (deriv f a)) / (2 * Real.pi) +
          ‖poissonBoundary f g a b‖

declarations.name: PartIRegularityAt
declarations.statement:
structure PartIRegularityAt (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (N : ℕ) : Prop where
  lt : a < b
  f_differentiable : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, DifferentiableAt ℝ f x
  f_deriv_continuous : ContinuousOn (deriv f) (Set.Icc a b)
  lower_frequency_lt : (N : ℝ) < deriv f b
  f_deriv_antitone : AntitoneOn (deriv f) (Set.Icc a b)

declarations.statement:
theorem corrected_poisson_partI {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} {N : ℕ}
    (h : PartIRegularityAt f g a b N) :
    ‖(∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc ⌊a⌋ ⌊b⌋, weightedWave f g (n : ℝ)) -
      ∑ ν ∈ Finset.Icc N ⌊deriv f a⌋₊,
        ∫ x in a..b, (g x : ℂ) *
          Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * ((f x - (ν : ℝ) * x : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ≤
      partIError f g a b N

declarations.name: corrected_poisson_partI_half_integer
declarations.statement:
theorem corrected_poisson_partI_half_integer {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} {N : ℕ}
    (h : PartIRegularityAt f g a b N)
    (ha : ∃ k : ℤ, a = (k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) (hb : ∃ k : ℤ, b = (k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) :
    ‖(∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc ⌊a⌋ ⌊b⌋, weightedWave f g (n : ℝ)) -
      ∑ ν ∈ Finset.Icc N ⌊deriv f a⌋₊,
        ∫ x in a..b, (g x : ℂ) *
          Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * ((f x - (ν : ℝ) * x : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ≤
      partIShiftAnalyticError f g a N +
        (g a + g b) / (2 * Real.pi) * (Real.log 2 + 1 / (deriv f a - N))

declarations.name: corrected_poisson_partI_noninteger
declarations.statement:
theorem corrected_poisson_partI_noninteger {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} {N : ℕ}
    (h : PartIRegularityAt f g a b N)
    (ha : ∀ k : ℤ, a ≠ (k : ℝ)) (hb : ∀ k : ℤ, b ≠ (k : ℝ)) :
    ‖(∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc ⌊a⌋ ⌊b⌋, weightedWave f g (n : ℝ)) -
      ∑ ν ∈ Finset.Icc N ⌊deriv f a⌋₊,
        ∫ x in a..b, (g x : ℂ) *
          Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * ((f x - (ν : ℝ) * x : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ≤
      partIShiftAnalyticError f g a N +
        (g b * tildeS1 b (deriv f a - N) + g a * tildeS1 a (deriv f a - N)) / (2 * Real.pi) +
          ‖poissonBoundary (phaseShift f N) g a b‖

declarations.name: corollary_poisson_partI
declarations.statement:
theorem corollary_poisson_partI {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hfd : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, DifferentiableAt ℝ f x)
    (hfc : ContinuousOn (deriv f) (Set.Icc a b))
    (hfp : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, 0 < deriv f x) (hfa : StrictAntiOn (deriv f) (Set.Icc a b))
    (ha : ∃ k : ℤ, a = (k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) (hb : ∃ k : ℤ, b = (k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) :
    ‖(∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc ⌊a⌋ ⌊b⌋, Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * (f (n : ℝ) : ℂ))) -
      ∑ ν ∈ Finset.Icc 0 ⌊deriv f a⌋₊,
        ∫ x in a..b, Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * ((f x - (ν : ℝ) * x : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ≤
      (1 / Real.pi) * (Real.log (1 + deriv f a) + Real.log (1 + (⌊deriv f a⌋₊ : ℝ)) +
        Real.eulerMascheroniConstant - 1 / (2 * (1 + (⌊deriv f a⌋₊ : ℝ))) -
        1 / (2 * (1 + deriv f a)) - (Complex.digamma ((1 - Int.fract (deriv f a) : ℝ) : ℂ)).re +
        Real.log 2 + 1 / deriv f a)

        ∫ x in a..b, (x ^ (-sigma) : ℝ) *
          Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * ((c * Real.log x - (ν : ℝ) * x : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ≤

declarations.statement:
theorem derivativeMode_eq_amplitude_integrals {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (h : PartIRegularity f g a b) (ν : ℝ) :
    derivativeMode f g a b ν =
      (∫ u in a..b, ((deriv g u : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * I * ((f u - ν * u : ℝ) : ℂ))) +
      (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * I) *
        (∫ u in a..b, ((g u * deriv f u : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * I * ((f u - ν * u : ℝ) : ℂ)))

      (A / (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * d)) / I +
        (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) * (B / (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * d))

declarations.name: positiveCoefficient_eq_secondModes
declarations.statement:
theorem positiveCoefficient_eq_secondModes {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (h : PartIRegularity f g a b) (n : ℕ) :
    positiveCoefficient f g a b (n + 1) =
      secondModeTerm f (deriv g) a b n / I +
      (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) * secondModeTerm f (fun u => g u * deriv f u) a b n

declarations.name: negativeCoefficient_eq_upperModes
declarations.statement:
theorem negativeCoefficient_eq_upperModes {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}

    negativeCoefficient f g a b (n + M + 1) =
      upperModeTerm f (deriv g) a b M n / I +
      (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) * upperModeTerm f (fun u => g u * deriv f u) a b M n

declarations.name: tsum_positiveCoefficient_eq_secondModes
declarations.statement:
theorem tsum_positiveCoefficient_eq_secondModes {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (h : PartIRegularity f g a b)
    (hg : Summable (secondModeTerm f (deriv g) a b))
    (hgf : Summable (secondModeTerm f (fun u => g u * deriv f u) a b)) :
    (∑' n : ℕ, positiveCoefficient f g a b n) =
      (∑' n : ℕ, secondModeTerm f (deriv g) a b n) / I +
        (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) * ∑' n : ℕ, secondModeTerm f (fun u => g u * deriv f u) a b n

declarations.name: tsum_negativeCoefficient_eq_upperModes
declarations.statement:
theorem tsum_negativeCoefficient_eq_upperModes {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (h : PartIRegularity f g a b) (M : ℕ)
    (hg : Summable (upperModeTerm f (deriv g) a b M))
    (hgf : Summable (upperModeTerm f (fun u => g u * deriv f u) a b M)) :
    (∑' n : ℕ, negativeCoefficient f g a b (n + M + 1)) =
      (∑' n : ℕ, upperModeTerm f (deriv g) a b M n) / I +
        (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) * ∑' n : ℕ, upperModeTerm f (fun u => g u * deriv f u) a b M n

declarations.name: weighted_sum_eq_second_mode_series
declarations.statement:
theorem weighted_sum_eq_second_mode_series {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (h : PartIRegularity f g a b) (M : ℕ)
    (hgp : Summable (secondModeTerm f (deriv g) a b))
    (hgfp : Summable (secondModeTerm f (fun u => g u * deriv f u) a b))
    (hgn : Summable (upperModeTerm f (deriv g) a b M))
    (hgfn : Summable (upperModeTerm f (fun u => g u * deriv f u) a b M)) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc ⌊a⌋ ⌊b⌋, weightedWave f g (n : ℝ)) - poissonMain f g a b M =
      poissonHeadBoundary f g b M - poissonHeadBoundary f g a M +
        ((∑' n : ℕ, upperModeTerm f (deriv g) a b M n) / I +
          (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) * ∑' n : ℕ, upperModeTerm f (fun u => g u * deriv f u) a b M n) -
        ((∑' n : ℕ, secondModeTerm f (deriv g) a b n) / I +
          (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) * ∑' n : ℕ, secondModeTerm f (fun u => g u * deriv f u) a b n) +
        poissonBoundary f g a b

declarations.name: positiveModeError_pair_le
declarations.statement:
theorem positiveModeError_pair_le {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hfa : 0 < deriv f a) (hfd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (deriv f) a)
    (hgd : DifferentiableAt ℝ g a) :
    positiveModeError (deriv f) (deriv (deriv f)) (deriv g) (deriv (deriv g)) a b +
      2 * Real.pi * positiveModeError (deriv f) (deriv (deriv f))
        (fun u => g u * deriv f u) (deriv (fun u => g u * deriv f u)) a b ≤
      secondH f g b / (4 * Real.pi ^ 2) * ‖positiveTail (-b) (deriv f b)‖ +
      secondH f g a / (4 * Real.pi ^ 2) * ‖positiveTail (-a) (deriv f a)‖ +
      secondH1 f g a / (4 * Real.pi ^ 3) * plusSquareBound (deriv f a) +
      (secondH f g a * |deriv (deriv f) a| / (4 * Real.pi ^ 3)) * plusCubeBound (deriv f a)

declarations.name: norm_positiveCoefficient_le_mode_errors
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_positiveCoefficient_le_mode_errors {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (h : PartIRegularity f g a b)
    (hg : Summable (secondModeTerm f (deriv g) a b))
    (hgf : Summable (secondModeTerm f (fun u => g u * deriv f u) a b))
    (bg : ‖∑' n : ℕ, secondModeTerm f (deriv g) a b n‖ ≤
      positiveModeError (deriv f) (deriv (deriv f)) (deriv g) (deriv (deriv g)) a b)
    (bgf : ‖∑' n : ℕ, secondModeTerm f (fun u => g u * deriv f u) a b n‖ ≤
      positiveModeError (deriv f) (deriv (deriv f))
        (fun u => g u * deriv f u) (deriv (fun u => g u * deriv f u)) a b)
    (hfd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (deriv f) a) :
    ‖∑' n : ℕ, positiveCoefficient f g a b n‖ ≤
      secondH f g b / (4 * Real.pi ^ 2) * ‖positiveTail (-b) (deriv f b)‖ +
      secondH f g a / (4 * Real.pi ^ 2) * ‖positiveTail (-a) (deriv f a)‖ +
      secondH1 f g a / (4 * Real.pi ^ 3) * plusSquareBound (deriv f a) +
      (secondH f g a * |deriv (deriv f) a| / (4 * Real.pi ^ 3)) * plusCubeBound (deriv f a)

declarations.name: afe_positiveCoefficient_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem afe_positiveCoefficient_bound {σ c a b : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) :
    ‖∑' n : ℕ, positiveCoefficient (afePhase c) (afeWeight σ) a b n‖ ≤
      secondH (afePhase c) (afeWeight σ) b / (4 * Real.pi ^ 2) * ‖positiveTail (-b) (c / b)‖ +
      secondH (afePhase c) (afeWeight σ) a / (4 * Real.pi ^ 2) * ‖positiveTail (-a) (c / a)‖ +
      secondH1 (afePhase c) (afeWeight σ) a / (4 * Real.pi ^ 3) * plusSquareBound (c / a) +
      (secondH (afePhase c) (afeWeight σ) a * (c / a ^ 2) / (4 * Real.pi ^ 3)) * plusCubeBound (c / a)

declarations.name: negativeModeError_pair_le
declarations.statement:
theorem negativeModeError_pair_le {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hfa : 0 < deriv f a) {M : ℕ} (hM : deriv f a < (M : ℝ) + 1) (hfd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (deriv f) a)
    (hgd : DifferentiableAt ℝ g a) :
    negativeModeError (deriv f) (deriv (deriv f)) (deriv g) (deriv (deriv g)) a b M +
      2 * Real.pi * negativeModeError (deriv f) (deriv (deriv f))
        (fun u => g u * deriv f u) (deriv (fun u => g u * deriv f u)) a b M ≤
      secondH f g b / (4 * Real.pi ^ 2) * ‖negativeTail M b (deriv f b)‖ +
      secondH f g a / (4 * Real.pi ^ 2) * ‖negativeTail M a (deriv f a)‖ +
      secondH1 f g a / (4 * Real.pi ^ 3) * minusSquareBound M (deriv f a) +
      (secondH f g a * |deriv (deriv f) a| / (4 * Real.pi ^ 3)) * minusCubeBound M (deriv f a)

declarations.name: norm_negativeCoefficient_le_mode_errors
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_negativeCoefficient_le_mode_errors {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (h : PartIRegularity f g a b) (M : ℕ) (hM : deriv f a < (M : ℝ) + 1)
    (hg : Summable (upperModeTerm f (deriv g) a b M))
    (hgf : Summable (upperModeTerm f (fun u => g u * deriv f u) a b M))
    (bg : ‖∑' n : ℕ, upperModeTerm f (deriv g) a b M n‖ ≤
      negativeModeError (deriv f) (deriv (deriv f)) (deriv g) (deriv (deriv g)) a b M)
    (bgf : ‖∑' n : ℕ, upperModeTerm f (fun u => g u * deriv f u) a b M n‖ ≤
      negativeModeError (deriv f) (deriv (deriv f))
        (fun u => g u * deriv f u) (deriv (fun u => g u * deriv f u)) a b M)
    (hfd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (deriv f) a) :
    ‖∑' n : ℕ, negativeCoefficient f g a b (n + M + 1)‖ ≤
      secondH f g b / (4 * Real.pi ^ 2) * ‖negativeTail M b (deriv f b)‖ +
      secondH f g a / (4 * Real.pi ^ 2) * ‖negativeTail M a (deriv f a)‖ +
      secondH1 f g a / (4 * Real.pi ^ 3) * minusSquareBound M (deriv f a) +
      (secondH f g a * |deriv (deriv f) a| / (4 * Real.pi ^ 3)) * minusCubeBound M (deriv f a)

declarations.name: afe_negativeCoefficient_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem afe_negativeCoefficient_bound {σ c a b : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (M : ℕ) (hM : c / a < (M : ℝ) + 1) :
    ‖∑' n : ℕ, negativeCoefficient (afePhase c) (afeWeight σ) a b (n + M + 1)‖ ≤
      secondH (afePhase c) (afeWeight σ) b / (4 * Real.pi ^ 2) * ‖negativeTail M b (c / b)‖ +
      secondH (afePhase c) (afeWeight σ) a / (4 * Real.pi ^ 2) * ‖negativeTail M a (c / a)‖ +
      secondH1 (afePhase c) (afeWeight σ) a / (4 * Real.pi ^ 3) * minusSquareBound M (c / a) +
      (secondH (afePhase c) (afeWeight σ) a * (c / a ^ 2) / (4 * Real.pi ^ 3)) * minusCubeBound M (c / a)

lemma sum_eq_int_deriv {φ : ℝ → ℂ} {a b : ℝ} (apos : 0 ≤ a) (a_lt_b : a < b)
    (φDiff : ∀ x ∈ [[a, b]], HasDerivAt φ (deriv φ x) x)
    (derivφCont : ContinuousOn (deriv φ) [[a, b]]) :
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc ⌊a⌋₊ ⌊b⌋₊, φ n =
      (∫ x in a..b, φ x) + (⌊b⌋₊ + 1 / 2 - b) * φ b - (⌊a⌋₊ + 1 / 2 - a) * φ a

declarations.name: afe_finite_cpow_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem afe_finite_cpow_bound {sigma t a b : ℝ} (hsigma : 0 ≤ sigma) (ht : 0 < t)

    (hahalf : ∃ k : ℤ, a = (k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) :
    ‖(∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc ⌊a⌋ ⌊b⌋, (n : ℂ) ^ (-((sigma : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I))) -
      ∫ x in a..b, (x : ℂ) ^ (-((sigma : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I))‖ ≤
      a ^ (-sigma) / Real.pi * (1 + sigma / t) * afePartIFactor (t / (2 * Real.pi) / a) +
        b ^ (-sigma) / 2

declarations.name: tendsto_cpow_tail_sub_integral
declarations.statement:
theorem tendsto_cpow_tail_sub_integral {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) {s : ℂ}

    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc ⌊a⌋ (N : ℤ), (n : ℂ) ^ (-s)) -
      ∫ x in a..(N : ℝ), (x : ℂ) ^ (-s)) atTop
      (𝓝 (riemannZeta s - sharpZetaSum s a - (a : ℂ) ^ (1 - s) / (s - 1)))

declarations.name: afe_zeta_sub_sum_sub_pole_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem afe_zeta_sub_sum_sub_pole_bound {sigma t a : ℝ} (hsigma : 0 < sigma) (ht : 0 < t)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hcut : t / (2 * Real.pi) < a)
    (hahalf : ∃ k : ℤ, a = (k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) :
    ‖riemannZeta ((sigma : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) -
      sharpZetaSum ((sigma : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) a -
      (a : ℂ) ^ (1 - ((sigma : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) /
        (((sigma : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) - 1)‖ ≤
      a ^ (-sigma) / Real.pi * (1 + sigma / t) * afePartIFactor (t / (2 * Real.pi) / a)

declarations.statement:

      (Complex.digamma (((N : ℝ) + 1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)).re -
        (Complex.digamma (1 / 2 : ℂ)).re

declarations.name: half_integer_quadratic_sum_eq
declarations.statement:
theorem half_integer_quadratic_sum_eq (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N,
      (m : ℝ) ^ 2 / (((N : ℝ) + 1 / 2) ^ 2 * ((N : ℝ) + 1 / 2 - m))) =
      (Complex.digamma (((N : ℝ) + 1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)).re -
        (Complex.digamma (1 / 2 : ℂ)).re - (N : ℝ) / ((N : ℝ) + 1 / 2) -
          ((N : ℝ) * (N + 1) / 2) / ((N : ℝ) + 1 / 2) ^ 2

declarations.name: half_integer_quadratic_sum_le
declarations.statement:
theorem half_integer_quadratic_sum_le (N : ℕ) :

      (m : ℝ) ^ 2 / (((N : ℝ) + 1 / 2) ^ 2 * ((N : ℝ) + 1 / 2 - m))) ≤
      Real.log ((N : ℝ) + 1 / 2) + Real.eulerMascheroniConstant + 2 * Real.log 2 -
        3 / 2 + 1 / (8 * ((N : ℝ) + 1 / 2) ^ 2)

      (x : ℂ) ^ z * exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * I * (m : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) -

            exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * I * (m : ℂ) * (u : ℂ)))

      (x : ℂ) ^ (1 - s) * exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * I * (m : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) -
        (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * I * (m : ℂ)) * weightedIntegral (s - 1) 0 x m

declarations.name: weightedIntegral_parts_twice

    weightedIntegral s 0 x m =
      (x : ℂ) ^ (1 - s) * exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * I * (m : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) / (1 - s) -
        (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * I * (m : ℂ)) * (x : ℂ) ^ (2 - s) *
          exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * I * (m : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) / ((1 - s) * (2 - s)) -
        (4 * (Real.pi : ℂ) ^ 2 * (m : ℂ) ^ 2) / ((1 - s) * (2 - s)) *
          weightedIntegral (s - 2) 0 x m

declarations.name: weightedIntegral_parts_twice_half_integer
declarations.statement:
theorem weightedIntegral_parts_twice_half_integer {s : ℂ} (hs : s.re < 1)

          ((1 - s) * (2 - s)) -

          weightedIntegral (s - 2) 0 x m

theorem norm_sum_weightedIntegralTail_le {σ t a y : ℝ} (hσ : σ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1)

    (hcut : ∀ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊y⌋₊, t < Real.pi * (m : ℝ) * a) :
    ‖∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊y⌋₊,
      weightedIntegralTail ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) a (m : ℝ)‖ ≤
        2 * a ^ (-σ) / Real.pi * (Real.log y + 1)

theorem norm_sum_weightedIntegralTail_source {σ t a y : ℝ} (hσ : σ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1)

declarations.name: interval_weyl_differencing_complex
declarations.statement:
theorem interval_weyl_differencing_complex
    (a : Int -> Complex) (N H : Nat) (C : Real)
    (ha : forall n, n ∈ Finset.Ico (0 : Int) N -> ‖a n‖ <= 1)
    (hC : 0 <= C)
    (hcorr : forall h, h ∈ Finset.range H -> forall k, k ∈ Finset.range H -> h ≠ k ->
      ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico (-(H : Int)) N,
        star (paddedShift a N n h) * paddedShift a N n k‖ <= C) :
    (H : Real) ^ 2 * ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico (0 : Int) N, a n‖ ^ 2 <=
      ((N + H : Nat) : Real) * ((H : Real) * N + (H : Real) ^ 2 * C)

declarations.name: logarithmicDifferencePhase
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def logarithmicDifferencePhase
    (t A : Real) (h k : Nat) (x : Real) : Real

declarations.name: hasDerivAt_logarithmicDifferencePhase
declarations.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_logarithmicDifferencePhase
    (t A : Real) (h k : Nat) {x : Real}
    (hh : A + x + h ≠ 0) (hk : A + x + k ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (logarithmicDifferencePhase t A h k)
      (-t / (A + x + h) + t / (A + x + k)) x

declarations.name: hasDerivAt_logarithmicDifferencePhase_deriv
declarations.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_logarithmicDifferencePhase_deriv
    (t A : Real) (h k : Nat) {x : Real}
    (hh : A + x + h ≠ 0) (hk : A + x + k ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => -t / (A + y + h) + t / (A + y + k))
      (t / (A + x + h) ^ 2 - t / (A + x + k) ^ 2) x

declarations.name: logarithmicDifferencePhase_secondDifference
declarations.statement:
theorem logarithmicDifferencePhase_secondDifference
    (t A : Real) (h k n : Nat) (hA : 0 < A) :
    exists xi, xi ∈ Set.Ioo (n : Real) (n + 2) ∧
      t / (A + xi + h) ^ 2 - t / (A + xi + k) ^ 2 =
        (logarithmicDifferencePhase t A h k (n + 2) -
          logarithmicDifferencePhase t A h k (n + 1)) -
        (logarithmicDifferencePhase t A h k (n + 1) -
          logarithmicDifferencePhase t A h k n)

declarations.name: logarithmicDifferenceCurvature_bounds
declarations.statement:
theorem logarithmicDifferenceCurvature_bounds
    (t A u v r : Real) (ht : 0 < t) (hA : 0 < A) (hr : 0 < r)
    (huLow : A <= u) (huv : u <= v) (hvHigh : v <= 2 * A)
    (hvu : v - u = r) :
    t * r / (8 * A ^ 3) <= t / u ^ 2 - t / v ^ 2 ∧
      t / u ^ 2 - t / v ^ 2 <= 4 * t * r / A ^ 3

declarations.name: logarithmicDifference_secondDifference_bounds
declarations.statement:
theorem logarithmicDifference_secondDifference_bounds
    (t A : Real) (h k N : Nat) (ht : 0 < t) (hA : 0 < A)
    (hhk : h < k) (hsize : (N + 1 + k : Nat) <= A) :
    forall n, n < N ->
      t * (k - h : Nat) / (8 * A ^ 3) <=
        (logarithmicDifferencePhase t A h k (n + 2) -
          logarithmicDifferencePhase t A h k (n + 1)) -
          (logarithmicDifferencePhase t A h k (n + 1) -
            logarithmicDifferencePhase t A h k n) ∧
      (logarithmicDifferencePhase t A h k (n + 2) -
          logarithmicDifferencePhase t A h k (n + 1)) -
          (logarithmicDifferencePhase t A h k (n + 1) -
            logarithmicDifferencePhase t A h k n) <=
        4 * t * (k - h : Nat) / A ^ 3

declarations.name: logarithmicDifference_B_process
declarations.statement:
theorem logarithmicDifference_B_process
    (t A : Real) (h k N : Nat) (ht : 0 < t) (hA : 0 < A)
    (hhk : h < k) (hsize : ((N + 1 + k : Nat) : Real) <= A) :
    ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
        unitaryPhase (logarithmicDifferencePhase t A h k n)‖ <=
      ((N : Real) * (4 * t * (k - h : Nat) / A ^ 3) /
          (2 * Real.pi) + 2) *
        (2 * Real.pi /
            Real.sqrt (t * (k - h : Nat) / (8 * A ^ 3)) +
          2 * (Real.sqrt (t * (k - h : Nat) / (8 * A ^ 3)) /
            (t * (k - h : Nat) / (8 * A ^ 3)) + 1))

declarations.name: integerLogarithmicTerm
declarations.statement: noncomputable def integerLogarithmicTerm (t A : Real) (n : Int) : Complex

declarations.name: padded_logarithmic_correlation_eq
declarations.statement:
theorem padded_logarithmic_correlation_eq (t A : Real) (N H h k : Nat)
    (hh : h < H) (hk : k < H) (hhk : h < k) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico (-(H : Int)) N,
      star (paddedShift (integerLogarithmicTerm t A) N n h) *
        paddedShift (integerLogarithmicTerm t A) N n k) =
      star (∑ m ∈ Finset.range (N - (k - h)),
        unitaryPhase (logarithmicDifferencePhase t A 0 (k - h) m))

declarations.name: padded_logarithmic_correlation_norm_le_of_lt
declarations.statement:
theorem padded_logarithmic_correlation_norm_le_of_lt

    (hh : h < H) (hk : k < H) (hhk : h < k) :
    ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico (-(H : Int)) N,
      star (paddedShift (integerLogarithmicTerm t A) N n h) *
        paddedShift (integerLogarithmicTerm t A) N n k‖ <=
      logarithmicCorrelationBound t A N (k - h)

declarations.name: padded_logarithmic_correlation_norm_le

      star (paddedShift (integerLogarithmicTerm t A) N n h) *

declarations.name: logarithmic_weyl_AB_process
declarations.statement:
theorem logarithmic_weyl_AB_process

declarations.statement:
theorem vdc_product_bound

    (n * (32 * x) / (2 * Real.pi) + 2) *

declarations.name: criticalLineTerm_eq_cpow

theorem criticalLineTerm_eq_cpow (Y : Real) (m : Nat) (hm : 0 < m) :

declarations.name: norm_critical_chi_product
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_critical_chi_product (t : ℝ) :
    ‖(2:ℂ)^(criticalPoint t) * (Real.pi:ℂ)^(criticalPoint t - 1) *

declarations.name: chi_eq_two_mul
declarations.statement:
theorem chi_eq_two_mul (s : ℂ) :

declarations.name: zeta_eq_chi_mul_zeta_one_sub

declarations.name: conj_nonneg_cpow

declarations.name: chi_conj

declarations.name: cpow_two_pi_div_I
declarations.statement:
theorem cpow_two_pi_div_I (s : ℂ) :

declarations.name: gamma_factor_mul_one_sub_exp

declarations.name: norm_exp_pi_mul_I
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_exp_pi_mul_I (s : ℂ) :

declarations.name: one_sub_exp_neg_abs_le_norm

declarations.name: gammaChiError
declarations.statement: noncomputable def gammaChiError (s : ℂ) : ℂ

declarations.name: gammaChi_denominator_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem gammaChi_denominator_bound {s : ℂ} {t₀ : ℝ} (ht₀ : 0 < t₀)

    0 < 1 - Real.exp (-Real.pi * t₀) ∧

declarations.name: norm_gammaChiError_le

declarations.name: gamma_factor_eq_chi_mul_one_add

declarations.name: gamma_factor_lemma_seven

declarations.name: gamma_factor_conjugate_branch
declarations.statement:
theorem gamma_factor_conjugate_branch {s : ℂ} {t₀ : ℝ} (ht₀ : 0 < t₀)

declarations.name: dampedWeightedKernel_eq_laplace

declarations.name: integrableOn_dampedWeightedKernel

declarations.name: integral_dampedWeightedKernel_Ioi

declarations.statement:
theorem continuousAt_dampedGamma_factor (s : ℂ) {m : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m) :

declarations.statement:
theorem dampedWeightedKernel_zero (s : ℂ) (m u : ℝ) :

declarations.name: norm_dampedWeightedKernel_le

declarations.name: dampedWeightedKernel_finite_abel_limit
declarations.statement:
theorem dampedWeightedKernel_finite_abel_limit {s : ℂ} (hs : s.re < 1)

declarations.statement:
theorem norm_integral_dampedWeightedKernel_le {σ t ε m a b : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)

    (hcut : t < Real.pi * m * a) :
    ‖∫ u in a..b, dampedWeightedKernel ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I) ε m u‖ ≤

declarations.name: norm_integral_Ioi_dampedWeightedKernel_le
declarations.statement:

declarations.name: norm_dampedGamma_sub_finite_integral_le
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_dampedGamma_sub_finite_integral_le {σ t ε m R : ℝ}
    (hσ : σ ∈ Set.Ico 0 1) (hε : 0 < ε) (hm : 0 < m) (hR : 0 < R)
    (hcut : t < Real.pi * m * R) :
    ‖((ε : ℂ) - 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * I * (m : ℂ)) ^
        (((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I) - 1) * Gamma (1 - ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I)) -
      ∫ u in 0..R, dampedWeightedKernel ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I) ε m u‖ ≤
      2 * R ^ (-σ) / (Real.pi * m)

declarations.name: norm_gamma_sub_weightedIntegral_le
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_gamma_sub_weightedIntegral_le {σ t m R : ℝ} (hσ : σ ∈ Set.Ico 0 1)
    (hm : 0 < m) (hR : 0 < R) (hcut : t < Real.pi * m * R) :
    ‖(-(2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * I * (m : ℂ))) ^ (((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I) - 1) *
        Gamma (1 - ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I)) -
      weightedIntegral ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I) 0 R m‖ ≤
      2 * R ^ (-σ) / (Real.pi * m)

declarations.name: weightedIntegralTail_zero_eq_gamma
declarations.statement:
theorem weightedIntegralTail_zero_eq_gamma {σ t m : ℝ} (hσ : σ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1)
    (hm : 0 < m) :
    weightedIntegralTail ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I) 0 m =
      (-(2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * I * (m : ℂ))) ^ (((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I) - 1) *

declarations.name: cpow_negative_imaginary_frequency
declarations.statement:
theorem cpow_negative_imaginary_frequency (s : ℂ) {m : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m) :
    (-(2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * I * (m : ℂ))) ^ (s - 1) =

declarations.name: weightedIntegralTail_zero_eq_gamma_product
declarations.statement:
theorem weightedIntegralTail_zero_eq_gamma_product {σ t m : ℝ} (hσ : σ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1)
    (hm : 0 < m) :
    weightedIntegralTail ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I) 0 m =
      Gamma (1 - ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I)) *
        (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) / I) ^ (((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I) - 1) *
        (m : ℂ) ^ (((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I) - 1)

declarations.name: weightedIntegralTail_zero_eq_chi
declarations.statement:
theorem weightedIntegralTail_zero_eq_chi {σ t m t₀ : ℝ} (hσ : σ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1)
    (hm : 0 < m) (ht₀ : 0 < t₀) (ht : t₀ ≤ |t|) :
    weightedIntegralTail ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I) 0 m =
      chi ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I) *
        (1 + gammaChiError ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I)) *
        (m : ℂ) ^ (((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I) - 1)

declarations.name: weightedIntegralTail_eq_sub
declarations.statement:
theorem weightedIntegralTail_eq_sub {σ t m : ℝ} (hσ : σ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1)
    (hm : 0 < m) (a : ℝ) :
    weightedIntegralTail ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I) a m =
      weightedIntegralTail ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I) 0 m -
        weightedIntegral ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I) 0 a m

declarations.name: weightedIntegral_eq_tail_sub_lower_sub_upper
declarations.statement:
theorem weightedIntegral_eq_tail_sub_lower_sub_upper {σ t m : ℝ}
    (hσ : σ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1) (hm : 0 < m) (x R : ℝ) :
    weightedIntegral ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I) x R m =
      weightedIntegralTail ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I) 0 m -
        weightedIntegral ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I) 0 x m -

declarations.name: abs_height_le_norm_real_sub
declarations.statement:
theorem abs_height_le_norm_real_sub (a σ t : ℝ) :

declarations.name: height_sq_le_norm_boundary_denominator
declarations.statement:
theorem height_sq_le_norm_boundary_denominator (σ t : ℝ) :

declarations.name: sum_weightedIntegral_parts_twice
declarations.statement:
theorem sum_weightedIntegral_parts_twice {s : ℂ} (hs : s.re < 1)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (k : ℤ) (hxk : x = (k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, weightedIntegral s 0 x (m : ℝ)) =
      ((x : ℂ) ^ (1 - s) / (1 - s)) * (∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (-1 : ℂ) ^ m) -
      ((2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * I) * (x : ℂ) ^ (2 - s) / ((1 - s) * (2 - s))) *
        (∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (-1 : ℂ) ^ m * (m : ℂ)) -
      ((4 * (Real.pi : ℂ) ^ 2) / ((1 - s) * (2 - s))) *
        (∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (m : ℂ) ^ 2 * weightedIntegral (s - 2) 0 x (m : ℝ))

declarations.name: norm_lower_boundary_one_le
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_lower_boundary_one_le {σ t x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    ‖(x : ℂ) ^ (1 - ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I)) /

declarations.name: norm_lower_boundary_two_le
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_lower_boundary_two_le {σ t x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (ht : t ≠ 0) :

      ((1 - ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I)) * (2 - ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I)))‖ ≤
      (2 * Real.pi * x ^ (2 - σ)) / |t| ^ 2

declarations.name: norm_lower_remainder_coefficient_le
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_lower_remainder_coefficient_le {σ t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    ‖(4 * (Real.pi : ℂ) ^ 2) /
      ((1 - ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I)) * (2 - ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I)))‖ ≤

declarations.name: norm_lower_remainder_sum_le
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_lower_remainder_sum_le {σ t x y : ℝ} (hσ : σ ≤ 2)
    (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hscale : 2 * Real.pi * x * y = |t|)
    (N : ℕ) (hNy : (N : ℝ) < y) :
    ‖((4 * (Real.pi : ℂ) ^ 2) /
      ((1 - ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I)) * (2 - ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I)))) *
      (∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (m : ℂ) ^ 2 *
        weightedIntegral (((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I) - 2) 0 x (m : ℝ))‖ ≤
      (x ^ (-σ) / Real.pi) * ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (m : ℝ) ^ 2 / (y ^ 2 * (y - m))

declarations.name: norm_sum_lower_integral_le_arithmetic
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_sum_lower_integral_le_arithmetic {σ t x y : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1)
    (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hscale : 2 * Real.pi * x * y = |t|)
    (k : ℤ) (hxk : x = (k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) (N : ℕ) (hNy : (N : ℝ) < y) :
    ‖∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, weightedIntegral ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I) 0 x (m : ℝ)‖ ≤
      x ^ (1 - σ) / |t| + (2 * Real.pi * x ^ (2 - σ) / |t| ^ 2) * (((N : ℝ) + 1) / 2) +
        (x ^ (-σ) / Real.pi) * ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (m : ℝ) ^ 2 / (y ^ 2 * (y - m))

declarations.name: norm_sum_lower_integral_half_integer
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_sum_lower_integral_half_integer {σ t x y : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1)
    (hx : 0 < x) (hscale : 2 * Real.pi * x * y = |t|)
    (k : ℤ) (hxk : x = (k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) (N : ℕ) (hyN : y = (N : ℝ) + 1 / 2) :
    ‖∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, weightedIntegral ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I) 0 x (m : ℝ)‖ ≤

declarations.name: norm_sum_lower_integral_source

declarations.name: norm_sum_dual_powers_le

declarations.name: sum_weightedIntegralTail_zero_eq_chi
declarations.statement:
theorem sum_weightedIntegralTail_zero_eq_chi {σ t y t₀ : ℝ} (hσ : σ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1)

declarations.name: norm_sum_weightedIntegralTail_sub_chi_le
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_sum_weightedIntegralTail_sub_chi_le {σ t y t₀ : ℝ} (hσ : σ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1)
    (hy : 1 ≤ y) (ht₀ : 0 < t₀) (ht : t₀ ≤ |t|) :
    ‖(∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊y⌋₊, weightedIntegralTail ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I) 0 (m : ℝ)) -
      chi ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I) *
        ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊y⌋₊, (m : ℂ) ^ (((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I) - 1)‖ ≤
      ‖chi ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I)‖ *
        (Real.exp (-Real.pi * t) / (1 - Real.exp (-Real.pi * t₀))) *
        (y ^ σ * Real.log y + 1)

declarations.name: sum_weightedIntegral_eq_three_terms

      (∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊y⌋₊, weightedIntegralTail ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I) 0 (m : ℝ)) -
        (∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊y⌋₊, weightedIntegral ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I) 0 x (m : ℝ)) -
        (∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊y⌋₊, weightedIntegralTail ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I) R (m : ℝ))

declarations.name: norm_sum_weightedIntegral_sub_chi_le
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_sum_weightedIntegral_sub_chi_le {σ t x y R t₀ : ℝ}
    (hσ : σ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1) (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (hxhalf : ∃ k : ℤ, x = (k : ℝ) + 1 / 2)
    (hyhalf : ∃ k : ℤ, y = (k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) (hscale : 2 * Real.pi * x * y = |t|)
    (hR : 0 < R) (hcut : ∀ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊y⌋₊, t < Real.pi * (m : ℝ) * R)
    (ht₀ : 0 < t₀) (ht : t₀ ≤ |t|) :
    ‖(∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊y⌋₊, weightedIntegral ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I) x R (m : ℝ)) -
      chi ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I) *
        ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊y⌋₊, (m : ℂ) ^ (((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I) - 1)‖ ≤
      ‖chi ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I)‖ *
        (Real.exp (-Real.pi * t) / (1 - Real.exp (-Real.pi * t₀))) *
        (y ^ σ * Real.log y + 1) +
      x ^ (-σ) * (Real.log y / Real.pi +
        (Real.eulerMascheroniConstant + 2 * Real.log 2 - 3 / 2) / Real.pi +
          3 / (4 * Real.pi * y) + 3 / (8 * Real.pi * y ^ 2)) +
      2 * R ^ (-σ) / Real.pi * (Real.log y + 1)

theorem smoothDetector_contour_identity {ψ : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}

        K*(Real.log (3*H))^2*(2*H)^(1/4+κ) ≤ V^2 →
        V^2 ≤ K*(Real.log (3*H))^2*H^(1/2-δ) →
        oneSeparated W →
        (∀ t ∈ W, H ≤ t ∧ t ≤ 2*H) →
        (∀ t ∈ W, V ≤ zetaMomentCriticalNorm t) →
        (W.card:ℝ) ≤ D*H^ν*
          (H*(Real.log (3*H))^4/V^6 + H^2*(Real.log (3*H))^6/V^12)

    (hx : H^(1+δ) ≤ x) :
    t^b*x^(3/2-b) ≤ 2^b

declarations.name: exists_norm_fourthRightPiece_sub_cutoff_le
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_norm_fourthRightPiece_sub_cutoff_le {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ ∃ H₀ : ℝ, 4 ≤ H₀ ∧
      ∀ H : ℝ, H₀ ≤ H → ∀ t : ℝ, H ≤ t → t ≤ 2*H →
      ∀ N : ℕ, H^(1+δ) ≤ (N:ℝ) → ∀ a : ℝ, 0 < a →
      ‖zetaFourthRightPiece t-zetaFourthPrefix t a (Finset.range (N+1))‖ ≤ K

declarations.name: sum_sq_le_card_mul_sum_sq
declarations.statement:
lemma sum_sq_le_card_mul_sum_sq {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℝ) :
  (∑ i ∈ s, f i)^2 ≤ (s.card : ℝ) * ∑ i ∈ s, (f i)^2

declarations.name: complex_sum_sq_le_card_mul_sum_sq
declarations.statement:
lemma complex_sum_sq_le_card_mul_sum_sq {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℂ) :
  ‖∑ i ∈ s, f i‖^2 ≤ (s.card : ℝ) * ∑ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖^2

declarations.name: trigPoly
declarations.statement: noncomputable def trigPoly (s : Finset ℤ) (a : ℤ → ℂ) (x : ℝ) : ℂ

declarations.name: integral_cexp_int
declarations.statement:
lemma integral_cexp_int (k : ℤ) :
    (∫ x : ℝ in 0..2 * Real.pi,
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * (k : ℂ) * (x : ℂ))) =
      if k = 0 then (2 * Real.pi : ℝ) else 0

declarations.name: integral_conj_fourier_term_mul_fourier_term
declarations.statement:
lemma integral_conj_fourier_term_mul_fourier_term (a b : ℂ) (n m : ℤ) :
    (∫ x : ℝ in 0..2 * Real.pi,
      conj (a * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (x : ℂ))) *
        (b * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)))) =
      if n = m then (2 * Real.pi : ℝ) * (conj a * b) else 0

declarations.name: integral_conj_trigPoly_mul_trigPoly
declarations.statement:
lemma integral_conj_trigPoly_mul_trigPoly (s : Finset ℤ) (a b : ℤ → ℂ) :
    (∫ x : ℝ in 0..2 * Real.pi, conj (trigPoly s a x) * trigPoly s b x) =
      (2 * Real.pi : ℝ) * ∑ n ∈ s, conj (a n) * b n

declarations.name: integral_norm_sq_trigPoly
declarations.statement:
lemma integral_norm_sq_trigPoly (s : Finset ℤ) (a : ℤ → ℂ) :
    (∫ x : ℝ in 0..2 * Real.pi, ‖trigPoly s a x‖ ^ 2) =
      2 * Real.pi * ∑ n ∈ s, ‖a n‖ ^ 2

declarations.name: continuous_trigPoly
declarations.statement:
lemma continuous_trigPoly (s : Finset ℤ) (a : ℤ → ℂ) :
    Continuous (trigPoly s a)

declarations.name: integral_sawtooth_cexp
declarations.statement:
lemma integral_sawtooth_cexp (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    (∫ x : ℝ in 0..2 * Real.pi,
      ((Real.pi - x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (k : ℂ) * (x : ℂ))) =
      2 * Real.pi * Complex.I / (k : ℂ)

declarations.name: integral_sawtooth_cexp_all
declarations.statement:
lemma integral_sawtooth_cexp_all (k : ℤ) :
    (∫ x : ℝ in 0..2 * Real.pi,
      ((Real.pi - x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (k : ℂ) * (x : ℂ))) =
      if k = 0 then 0 else 2 * Real.pi * Complex.I / (k : ℂ)

declarations.name: hilbertForm
declarations.statement: noncomputable def hilbertForm (s : Finset ℤ) (a b : ℤ → ℂ) : ℂ

declarations.name: integral_sawtooth_conj_fourier_mul_fourier
declarations.statement:
lemma integral_sawtooth_conj_fourier_mul_fourier (a b : ℂ) (n m : ℤ) :
    (∫ x : ℝ in 0..2 * Real.pi,
      ((Real.pi - x : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        (conj (a * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (x : ℂ))) *
          (b * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (x : ℂ))))) =
      if n = m then 0 else
        2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * (conj a * b / ((m - n : ℤ) : ℂ))

declarations.name: integral_sawtooth_conj_trigPoly_mul_trigPoly
declarations.statement:
lemma integral_sawtooth_conj_trigPoly_mul_trigPoly
    (s : Finset ℤ) (a b : ℤ → ℂ) :
    (∫ x : ℝ in 0..2 * Real.pi,
      ((Real.pi - x : ℝ) : ℂ) * (conj (trigPoly s a x) * trigPoly s b x)) =
      2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * hilbertForm s a b

declarations.name: norm_sawtooth_conj_trigPoly_mul_trigPoly_le
declarations.statement:
lemma norm_sawtooth_conj_trigPoly_mul_trigPoly_le
    (s : Finset ℤ) (a b : ℤ → ℂ) {x : ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)) :
    ‖((Real.pi - x : ℝ) : ℂ) * (conj (trigPoly s a x) * trigPoly s b x)‖ ≤
      Real.pi * (‖trigPoly s a x‖ ^ 2 + ‖trigPoly s b x‖ ^ 2)

declarations.name: hilbertForm_norm_le
declarations.statement:
theorem hilbertForm_norm_le (s : Finset ℤ) (a b : ℤ → ℂ) :
    ‖hilbertForm s a b‖ ≤
      Real.pi * ((∑ n ∈ s, ‖a n‖ ^ 2) + ∑ n ∈ s, ‖b n‖ ^ 2)

declarations.name: nat_hilbertForm_norm_le
declarations.statement:
theorem nat_hilbertForm_norm_le (s : Finset ℕ) (a b : ℕ → ℂ) :
    ‖∑ m ∈ s, ∑ n ∈ s, if n = m then 0 else
        conj (a n) * b m / (((m : ℤ) - (n : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ)‖ ≤
      Real.pi * ((∑ n ∈ s, ‖a n‖ ^ 2) + ∑ n ∈ s, ‖b n‖ ^ 2)

declarations.name: abs_inv_log_sub_sub_div_le_one
declarations.statement:
lemma abs_inv_log_sub_sub_div_le_one {x y : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y)
    (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    |(Real.log y - Real.log x)⁻¹ - x / (y - x)| ≤ 1

declarations.name: norm_complex_log_kernel_error_le_one
declarations.statement:
lemma norm_complex_log_kernel_error_le_one {n m : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hnm : n ≠ m) :
    ‖(((Real.log m - Real.log n)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) -
        (n : ℂ) / (((m : ℤ) - (n : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1

declarations.name: logHilbertQuad
declarations.statement: noncomputable def logHilbertQuad (N : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) : ℂ

declarations.name: natMainQuad
declarations.statement: noncomputable def natMainQuad (N : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) : ℂ

declarations.name: logKernelErrorQuad
declarations.statement: noncomputable def logKernelErrorQuad (N : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) : ℂ

declarations.name: logHilbertQuad_eq_main_add_error
declarations.statement:
lemma logHilbertQuad_eq_main_add_error (N : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) :
    logHilbertQuad N a = natMainQuad N a + logKernelErrorQuad N a

declarations.name: logKernelErrorQuad_norm_le
declarations.statement:
lemma logKernelErrorQuad_norm_le (N : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    ‖logKernelErrorQuad N a‖ ≤
      (N : ℝ) * ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc N (2 * N), ‖a n‖ ^ 2

declarations.name: natScaledCoeff
declarations.statement: noncomputable def natScaledCoeff (N : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) (n : ℕ) : ℂ

declarations.name: natMainQuad_eq_scaled_hilbert
declarations.statement:
lemma natMainQuad_eq_scaled_hilbert (N : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    natMainQuad N a = (N : ℂ) *
      (∑ m ∈ Finset.Ioc N (2 * N), ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc N (2 * N),
        if n = m then 0 else conj (natScaledCoeff N a n) * a m /
          (((m : ℤ) - (n : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ))

declarations.name: natScaledCoeff_l2_le
declarations.statement:
lemma natScaledCoeff_l2_le (N : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc N (2 * N), ‖natScaledCoeff N a n‖ ^ 2) ≤
      4 * ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc N (2 * N), ‖a n‖ ^ 2

declarations.name: natMainQuad_norm_le
declarations.statement:
lemma natMainQuad_norm_le (N : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    ‖natMainQuad N a‖ ≤
      (5 * Real.pi) * (N : ℝ) *
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc N (2 * N), ‖a n‖ ^ 2

declarations.name: logHilbertQuad_norm_le
declarations.statement:
theorem logHilbertQuad_norm_le (N : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    ‖logHilbertQuad N a‖ ≤
      (5 * Real.pi + 1) * (N : ℝ) *
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc N (2 * N), ‖a n‖ ^ 2

declarations.name: dirichletTime
declarations.statement: noncomputable def dirichletTime (N : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) (t : ℝ) : ℂ

declarations.name: endpointTwist
declarations.statement: noncomputable def endpointTwist (T : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) (n : ℕ) : ℂ

declarations.name: norm_endpointTwist
declarations.statement:
lemma norm_endpointTwist (T : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖endpointTwist T a n‖ = ‖a n‖

declarations.name: integral_conj_dirichlet_term_mul_dirichlet_term
declarations.statement:
lemma integral_conj_dirichlet_term_mul_dirichlet_term
    (T : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) {n m : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hm : 0 < m) :
    (∫ t : ℝ in 0..T,
      conj (a n * Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * (t : ℂ) * (Real.log n : ℂ)))) *
        (a m * Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * (t : ℂ) * (Real.log m : ℂ))))) =
      if n = m then (T : ℂ) * (conj (a n) * a n) else
        Complex.I *
          (conj (endpointTwist T a n) * endpointTwist T a m - conj (a n) * a m) /
            ((Real.log m - Real.log n : ℝ) : ℂ)

declarations.name: integral_conj_dirichletTime_mul_dirichletTime
declarations.statement:
lemma integral_conj_dirichletTime_mul_dirichletTime
    (N : ℕ) (T : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) :
    (∫ t : ℝ in 0..T, conj (dirichletTime N a t) * dirichletTime N a t) =
      (T : ℂ) * ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc N (2 * N), conj (a n) * a n +
        Complex.I * (logHilbertQuad N (endpointTwist T a) - logHilbertQuad N a)

declarations.name: continuous_dirichletTime
declarations.statement:
lemma continuous_dirichletTime (N : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) :
    Continuous (dirichletTime N a)

declarations.name: ofReal_integral_norm_sq_dirichletTime
declarations.statement:
lemma ofReal_integral_norm_sq_dirichletTime (N : ℕ) (T : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) :
    (((∫ t : ℝ in 0..T, ‖dirichletTime N a t‖ ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      (T : ℂ) * ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc N (2 * N), conj (a n) * a n +
        Complex.I * (logHilbertQuad N (endpointTwist T a) - logHilbertQuad N a)

declarations.name: integral_norm_sq_dirichletTime_le
declarations.statement:
theorem integral_norm_sq_dirichletTime_le (N : ℕ) (T : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℂ)
    (hN : 0 < N) (hT : 0 ≤ T) :
    (∫ t : ℝ in 0..T, ‖dirichletTime N a t‖ ^ 2) ≤
      (T + 2 * (5 * Real.pi + 1) * (N : ℝ)) *
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc N (2 * N), ‖a n‖ ^ 2

declarations.name: norm_sum_mul_sq_le
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_sum_mul_sq_le {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (s : Finset ι) (a b : ι → ℂ) :
    ‖∑ i ∈ s, a i * b i‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, ‖a i‖ ^ 2) * (∑ i ∈ s, ‖b i‖ ^ 2)

declarations.name: dirichletTime_shift
declarations.statement:
theorem dirichletTime_shift (N : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) (v t : ℝ) :
    dirichletTime N a (t+v) = dirichletTime N (endpointTwist v a) t

declarations.name: integral_norm_sq_dirichletTime_interval_le
declarations.statement:
theorem integral_norm_sq_dirichletTime_interval_le
    (N : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) {A B : ℝ} (hN : 0 < N) (hAB : A ≤ B) :
    (∫ t : ℝ in A..B, ‖dirichletTime N a t‖^2) ≤
      (B-A+2*(5*Real.pi+1)*(N:ℝ)) *
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc N (2*N), ‖a n‖^2

declarations.name: integral_norm_sq_dirichletTime_reflected_le
declarations.statement:
theorem integral_norm_sq_dirichletTime_reflected_le
    (N : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) (u : ℝ) {H : ℝ} (hN : 0 < N) (hH : 0 ≤ H) :
    (∫ t : ℝ in H..2*H, ‖dirichletTime N a (u-t)‖^2) ≤
      (H+2*(5*Real.pi+1)*(N:ℝ)) *
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc N (2*N), ‖a n‖^2

declarations.name: dirichletPrefix
declarations.statement: def dirichletPrefix (N : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) (t : ℝ) : ℂ

declarations.name: continuous_dirichletPrefix
declarations.statement:
theorem continuous_dirichletPrefix (N : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) :
    Continuous (dirichletPrefix N a)

declarations.name: dirichletPrefix_one
declarations.statement:
theorem dirichletPrefix_one (a : ℕ → ℂ) (t : ℝ) :
    dirichletPrefix 1 a t = a 1

declarations.name: dirichletPrefix_double
declarations.statement:
theorem dirichletPrefix_double (N : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) (t : ℝ) :
    dirichletPrefix (2*N) a t = dirichletPrefix N a t+dirichletTime N a t

declarations.name: dirichletPrefix_pow_two
declarations.statement:
theorem dirichletPrefix_pow_two (M : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) (t : ℝ) :
    dirichletPrefix (2^M) a t =
      a 1+∑ j ∈ Finset.range M, dirichletTime (2^j) a t

declarations.name: norm_dirichletPrefix_pow_two_sq_le
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_dirichletPrefix_pow_two_sq_le (M : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) (t : ℝ) :
    ‖dirichletPrefix (2^M) a t‖^2 ≤
      2*((M:ℝ)+1)*(‖a 1‖^2+∑ j ∈ Finset.range M, ‖dirichletTime (2^j) a t‖^2)

declarations.name: integral_norm_sq_dirichletPrefix_le_blocks
declarations.statement:
theorem integral_norm_sq_dirichletPrefix_le_blocks
    (M : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) {A B : ℝ} (hAB : A ≤ B) :
    (∫ t : ℝ in A..B, ‖dirichletPrefix (2^M) a t‖^2) ≤
      2*((M:ℝ)+1)*((B-A)*‖a 1‖^2+
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range M, ∫ t : ℝ in A..B, ‖dirichletTime (2^j) a t‖^2)

declarations.name: integral_norm_sq_dirichletPrefix_le
declarations.statement:
theorem integral_norm_sq_dirichletPrefix_le
    (M : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) {A B L : ℝ} (hAB : A ≤ B)
    (hone : ‖a 1‖^2 ≤ L)
    (hcoeff : ∀ j ∈ Finset.range M,
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc (2^j) (2*(2^j)), ‖a n‖^2) ≤ L) :
    (∫ t : ℝ in A..B, ‖dirichletPrefix (2^M) a t‖^2) ≤
      2*((M:ℝ)+1)^2*(B-A+2*(5*Real.pi+1)*(2:ℝ)^M)*L

declarations.name: integral_norm_sq_dirichletPrefix_reflected_le
declarations.statement:
theorem integral_norm_sq_dirichletPrefix_reflected_le
    (M : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) (u : ℝ) {H L : ℝ} (hH : 0 ≤ H)
    (hone : ‖a 1‖^2 ≤ L)
    (hcoeff : ∀ j ∈ Finset.range M,
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc (2^j) (2*(2^j)), ‖a n‖^2) ≤ L) :
    (∫ t : ℝ in H..2*H, ‖dirichletPrefix (2^M) a (u-t)‖^2) ≤
      2*((M:ℝ)+1)^2*(H+2*(5*Real.pi+1)*(2:ℝ)^M)*L

declarations.name: fourth_divisorTerm_eq_coeff_phase
declarations.statement:
theorem fourth_divisorTerm_eq_coeff_phase (t c u : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    divisorDirichletTerm (afeCriticalPoint (-t)+((c:ℂ)+(u:ℂ)*I)) n =
      zetaFourthCoeff c n*Complex.exp (-(I*((u-t):ℂ)*(Real.log n:ℂ)))

declarations.name: sum_fourth_divisorTerm_eq_prefix
declarations.statement:
theorem sum_fourth_divisorTerm_eq_prefix (t c u : ℝ) (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N+1),
      divisorDirichletTerm (afeCriticalPoint (-t)+((c:ℂ)+(u:ℂ)*I)) n) =
        dirichletPrefix N (zetaFourthCoeff c) (u-t)

declarations.name: norm_dirichletPrefix_le
declarations.statement:
theorem norm_dirichletPrefix_le (N : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) (t : ℝ) :
    ‖dirichletPrefix N a t‖ ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 N, ‖a n‖

declarations.name: continuous_dirichletPrefix_reflected
declarations.statement:
theorem continuous_dirichletPrefix_reflected (N : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) (t : ℝ) :
    Continuous (fun u : ℝ => dirichletPrefix N a (u-t))

declarations.name: integrable_gaussian_dirichletPrefix_norm_pow
declarations.statement:
theorem integrable_gaussian_dirichletPrefix_norm_pow
    {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (N : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) (t : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun u : ℝ => Real.exp (-b*u^2)*‖dirichletPrefix N a (u-t)‖^k)

declarations.name: exists_integral_sq_fourthPolynomial_le
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_integral_sq_fourthPolynomial_le {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ D : ℝ, 0 < D ∧ ∀ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c → ∀ M : ℕ,
      ∀ H : ℝ, 0 ≤ H → ∀ u : ℝ,
      (∫ t : ℝ in H..2*H,
        ‖dirichletPrefix (2^M) (zetaFourthCoeff c) (u-t)‖^2) ≤
          D*((M:ℝ)+1)^2*(H+2*(5*Real.pi+1)*(2:ℝ)^M)*((2:ℝ)^M)^ε

declarations.name: exists_integral_sq_fourthDivisorSum_le
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_integral_sq_fourthDivisorSum_le {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ D : ℝ, 0 < D ∧ ∀ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c → ∀ M : ℕ,
      ∀ H : ℝ, 0 ≤ H → ∀ u : ℝ,
      (∫ t : ℝ in H..2*H,
        ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range (2^M+1),
          divisorDirichletTerm (afeCriticalPoint (-t)+((c:ℂ)+(u:ℂ)*I)) n‖^2) ≤
          D*((M:ℝ)+1)^2*(H+2*(5*Real.pi+1)*(2:ℝ)^M)*((2:ℝ)^M)^ε

declarations.name: integrable_gaussian_dirichletPrefix_prod
declarations.statement:
theorem integrable_gaussian_dirichletPrefix_prod
    {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (N : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) (A B : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun z : ℝ × ℝ =>
      Real.exp (-b*z.2^2)*‖dirichletPrefix N a (z.2-z.1)‖^2)
      ((volume.restrict (uIoc A B)).prod volume)

declarations.name: intervalIntegrable_gaussianPrefixMean
declarations.statement:
theorem intervalIntegrable_gaussianPrefixMean
    {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (N : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) (A B : ℝ) :
    IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ =>
      ∫ u : ℝ, Real.exp (-b*u^2)*‖dirichletPrefix N a (u-t)‖^2) volume A B

declarations.name: integral_gaussianPrefixMean_swap
declarations.statement:
theorem integral_gaussianPrefixMean_swap
    {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (N : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) (A B : ℝ) :
    (∫ t : ℝ in A..B, ∫ u : ℝ,
      Real.exp (-b*u^2)*‖dirichletPrefix N a (u-t)‖^2) =
        ∫ u : ℝ, Real.exp (-b*u^2)*
          (∫ t : ℝ in A..B, ‖dirichletPrefix N a (u-t)‖^2)

declarations.name: exists_integral_gaussian_fourthPolynomial_le
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_integral_gaussian_fourthPolynomial_le {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ D : ℝ, 0 < D ∧ ∀ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c → ∀ M : ℕ, ∀ H : ℝ, 0 ≤ H →
      (∫ t : ℝ in H..2*H, ∫ u : ℝ,
        Real.exp (-98*u^2)*‖dirichletPrefix (2^M) (zetaFourthCoeff c) (u-t)‖^2) ≤
          D*((M:ℝ)+1)^2*(H+2*(5*Real.pi+1)*(2:ℝ)^M)*((2:ℝ)^M)^ε

declarations.name: critical_norm_matches_existing
declarations.statement:
theorem critical_norm_matches_existing (t : ℝ) :
    MathCollab.Density.Stronger.zetaMomentCriticalNorm t =
      ‖riemannZeta (afeCriticalPoint t)‖

declarations.name: fourth_height_power_identity
declarations.statement:
theorem fourth_height_power_identity {H q : ℝ} (hH : 0 < H) :
    (2*H)^(2*q)*H^(1+q)*(2*H^(1+q))^(2*q) =
      (2:ℝ)^(4*q)*H^(1+5*q+2*q^2)

declarations.name: exists_fourth_dyadic_budget
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_fourth_dyadic_budget {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1) :
    ∃ D : ℝ, 0 < D ∧ ∀ H : ℝ, 1 ≤ H → ∀ M : ℕ,
      (2:ℝ)^M ≤ 2*H^(1+q) →
      (2*H)^(2*q)*((M:ℝ)+1)^2*
        (H+2*(5*Real.pi+1)*(2:ℝ)^M)*((2:ℝ)^M)^q ≤ D*H^(1+7*q)

declarations.name: exists_scaled_gaussian_fourthPolynomial_le
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_scaled_gaussian_fourthPolynomial_le {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1) :
    ∃ D : ℝ, 0 < D ∧ ∀ H : ℝ, 1 ≤ H → ∀ M : ℕ,
      (2 : ℝ)^M ≤ 2*H^(1+q) →
      (2*H)^(2*q) *
        (∫ t : ℝ in H..2*H, ∫ u : ℝ,
          Real.exp (-98*u^2)*‖dirichletPrefix (2^M) (zetaFourthCoeff q) (u-t)‖^2) ≤
        D*H^(1+7*q)

declarations.name: integral_weighted_sq_le
declarations.statement:
theorem integral_weighted_sq_le
    (g f : ℝ → ℝ) (hg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ g x) (hgi : Integrable g)
    (hgf : Integrable (fun x => g x*f x))
    (hgf2 : Integrable (fun x => g x*(f x)^2))
    (hmass : 0 < ∫ x : ℝ, g x) :
    (∫ x : ℝ, g x*f x)^2 ≤ (∫ x : ℝ, g x)*(∫ x : ℝ, g x*(f x)^2)

declarations.name: exists_norm_sq_fourthPrefix_le_gaussian
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_norm_sq_fourthPrefix_le_gaussian {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 4 ≤ t → 4*c ≤ t → ∀ N : ℕ,
      ‖zetaFourthPrefix t c (Finset.range (N+1))‖^2 ≤ K*t^(2*c)*
        ∫ u : ℝ, Real.exp (-98*u^2)*
          ‖dirichletPrefix N (zetaFourthCoeff c) (u-t)‖^2

declarations.name: zeta_fourth_dyadic
declarations.statement:
theorem zeta_fourth_dyadic :
    ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ C H₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
      ∀ H : ℝ, H₀ ≤ H → 0 < H →
        (∫ t in H..2*H, zetaMomentCriticalNorm t^4) ≤ C*H^(1+η)

declarations.statement:
theorem detectorTerm_finite_split {T : ℝ} (hT : 1 ≤ T) (ρ : ℂ) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : n < firstDetectorCutoff T) :
    detectorTerm ρ (firstDetectorX T) T n =
      (if n = 1 then (Real.exp (-1/T) : ℂ) else 0) +
      firstDetectorCoefficient T n*(n : ℂ)^(-ρ)

declarations.statement:
theorem finiteDetector_decomposition {T : ℝ} (hT : 1 ≤ T)
    (hK : 1 < firstDetectorCutoff T) {ρ : ℂ} (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ.re) :
    (Real.exp (-1/T) : ℂ) + finiteDetector ρ T +
      (∑' n : ℕ, detectorTerm ρ (firstDetectorX T) T (n+firstDetectorCutoff T)) =
        smoothedDetector ρ (firstDetectorX T) (1/T)

declarations.name: finiteDetector_eventually_large_of_zeta_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem finiteDetector_eventually_large_of_zeta_bound {η C : ℝ}
    (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hη' : η < 1/48) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hW : ∀ t : ℝ, ‖riemannZeta ((1/2 : ℂ)+(t : ℂ)*I)‖ ≤ C*(1+|t|)^(1/6+η)) :
    ∀ᶠ T : ℝ in atTop, ∀ ρ : ℂ,
      3/4 ≤ ρ.re → ρ.re < 1 → T ≤ |ρ.im| → |ρ.im| ≤ 2*T →
      riemannZeta ρ = 0 → (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ ‖finiteDetector ρ T‖

theorem detector_descPochhammer_neg (β : ℝ) (j : ℕ) :

      (detectorDyadicCount T : ℝ) ≤ 5*Real.log T ∧

    (hT : 1 ≤ T) (hN : 0 < N) (hN' : (N : ℝ) ≤ T^2)
    (hβ : 0 ≤ ρ.re) (hβ' : ρ.re ≤ 1) :

    (hT : 1 ≤ T) (hN : 0 < N) (hN' : (N : ℝ) ≤ T^2)
    (hβ : 0 ≤ ρ.re) (hβ' : ρ.re ≤ 1)
    {D : ℝ} (hD : 0 < D)
    (hsmall : 3*T^(-1 : ℝ) ≤ 1/(4*D))
    (hblock : 1/(2*D) ≤ ‖genericBlock ρ a N‖) :
    ∃ j ∈ Finset.range (detectorTaylorCutoff T+1),
      (N : ℝ)^ρ.re/(8*D) ≤ ‖genericTaylorPolynomial a N j ρ.im‖

theorem smoothShortCoefficient_support (X Y : ℝ) {N : ℝ} (hN : 0 < N)

      (smoothDyadicWeight (((n+2 : ℕ) : ℝ)/(2*M)) : ℂ)) =

        (smoothDyadicWeight (((n+2 : ℕ) : ℝ)/(2*M)) : ℂ)‖/2 ≤

declarations.statement:
theorem exists_smoothShortTaylor_component (X N : ℝ) {Y T : ℝ} {M : ℕ} {ρ : ℂ}
    (hY : 0 < Y) (hT : 1 ≤ T) (hM : 0 < M) (hM' : (M : ℝ) ≤ T^2)
    (hβ : 0 ≤ ρ.re) (hβ' : ρ.re ≤ 1) {D : ℝ} (hD : 0 < D)

declarations.name: exists_fixedDetector_component
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_fixedDetector_component {T : ℝ} {N : ℕ} {ρ : ℂ}
    (hT : 1 ≤ T) (hN : 0 < N) (hN' : (N : ℝ) ≤ T^2)
    (hβ : 0 ≤ ρ.re) (hβ' : ρ.re ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : 3*T^(-1 : ℝ) ≤ 1/(4*(detectorDyadicCount T : ℝ)))
    (hblock : 1/(2*(detectorDyadicCount T : ℝ)) ≤ ‖detectorBlock ρ T N‖) :
    ∃ j ∈ Finset.range (detectorTaylorCutoff T+1),
      (N : ℝ)^ρ.re/(8*(detectorDyadicCount T : ℝ)) ≤ ‖detectorTaylorPolynomial T N j ρ.im‖

declarations.name: fixedDetector_cover_of_zeta_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem fixedDetector_cover_of_zeta_bound {η C : ℝ}
    (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hη' : η < 1/48) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hW : ∀ t : ℝ, ‖riemannZeta ((1/2 : ℂ)+(t : ℂ)*I)‖ ≤ C*(1+|t|)^(1/6+η)) :
    ∀ᶠ T : ℝ in atTop, ∀ (σ : ℝ) (ρ : ℂ),
      3/4 ≤ σ → σ ≤ ρ.re → ρ.re < 1 → T ≤ |ρ.im| → |ρ.im| ≤ 2*T →
      riemannZeta ρ = 0 →
      ∃ p ∈ fixedDetectorIndices T,
        firstDetectorX T/2 < ((2^p.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ∧
        ((2^p.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) < T*(Real.log T)^2 ∧
        ((2^p.1 : ℕ) : ℝ)^σ/(40*Real.log T) ≤ ‖detectorTaylorPolynomial T (2^p.1) p.2 ρ.im‖

    (hsmall : 3*T^(-1 : ℝ) ≤ 1/(4*D))
    (hblock : 1/D ≤ ‖smoothDetectorBlock ρ X Y j‖) :
    0 < j ∧ ∃ e ∈ Finset.range 2, ∃ r ∈ Finset.range (detectorTaylorCutoff T+1),
      (smoothHalfScale j e : ℝ)^ρ.re/(8*D) ≤
        ‖genericTaylorPolynomial (smoothShortCoefficient X Y ((2 : ℝ)^j))
          (smoothHalfScale j e) r ρ.im‖

declarations.name: smooth_short_Taylor_cover
declarations.statement:
theorem smooth_short_Taylor_cover {σ δ : ℝ} (hσ : 3/4 < σ) :
    ∀ᶠ T : ℝ in atTop, ∀ (ρ : ℂ) (j : ℤ),
      σ ≤ ρ.re → ρ.re ≤ 1 →
      j ∈ smoothScaleIndices (detectorY σ T*(Real.log T)^2) →
      detectorX δ T/2 < (2 : ℝ)^j →
      (2 : ℝ)^j ≤ T^(smoothingExponent σ/2) →
      (1/(24*Real.log T) : ℝ) ≤ ‖smoothDetectorBlock ρ (detectorX δ T) (detectorY σ T) j‖ →
      ∃ p ∈ smoothTaylorIndices σ T, p.1 = j ∧
        detectorX δ T/4 ≤ (smoothHalfScale p.1 p.2.1 : ℝ) ∧
        (smoothHalfScale p.1 p.2.1 : ℝ) ≤ T^(smoothingExponent σ/2) ∧
        (smoothHalfScale p.1 p.2.1 : ℝ)^σ/(192*Real.log T) ≤
          ‖smoothTaylorMember σ δ T p ρ.im‖

declarations.name: smooth_long_or_short_Taylor_cover
declarations.statement:
theorem smooth_long_or_short_Taylor_cover {σ δ : ℝ}
    (hσ : 3/4 < σ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hδ' : δ ≤ 1/8) :
    ∀ᶠ T : ℝ in atTop, ∀ ρ : ℂ,
      σ ≤ ρ.re → ρ.re < 1 → T ≤ |ρ.im| → |ρ.im| ≤ 2*T → riemannZeta ρ = 0 →
      (∃ j ∈ smoothScaleIndices (detectorY σ T*(Real.log T)^2),
        T^(smoothingExponent σ/2) < (2 : ℝ)^j ∧
        (1/(24*Real.log T) : ℝ) ≤ ‖smoothDetectorBlock ρ (detectorX δ T) (detectorY σ T) j‖) ∨
      (∃ p ∈ smoothTaylorIndices σ T,
        detectorX δ T/4 ≤ (smoothHalfScale p.1 p.2.1 : ℝ) ∧
        (smoothHalfScale p.1 p.2.1 : ℝ) ≤ T^(smoothingExponent σ/2) ∧
        (smoothHalfScale p.1 p.2.1 : ℝ)^σ/(192*Real.log T) ≤
          ‖smoothTaylorMember σ δ T p ρ.im‖)

declarations.statement:
theorem exists_normalizedSmoothPowered_height {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (K : ℕ) :
    ∀ᶠ T : ℝ in atTop, ∀ (σ X Y t : ℝ) (j : ℤ) (e r k : ℕ),

      (smoothHalfScale j e : ℝ)^σ/(192*Real.log T) ≤

      ∃ l ∈ Finset.range k,

declarations.name: zetaSlab_large_values_cover_indexed
declarations.statement:
theorem zetaSlab_large_values_cover_indexed {ι : Type*} {κ ε : ℝ} (hκ : 0 < κ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (σ lo hi H B : ℝ) (J : Finset ι)
      (N : ι → ℕ) (V : ι → ℝ) (coeff : ι → ℕ → ℂ),
      2 ≤ H → 0 ≤ B → hi ≤ lo+H →
      (∀ k : ℤ, (∑ ρ ∈ (zetaZeroFinset σ lo hi).filter
        (fun ρ => ordinateBin ρ = k), (zetaMultiplicity ρ : ℝ)) ≤ B) →
      (∀ j ∈ J, 0 < N j ∧ 0 < V j ∧ H^(1/3 : ℝ) ≤ (N j : ℝ) ∧
        (N j : ℝ) ≤ H ∧ (N j : ℝ)^(3/4+κ) ≤ V j ∧
        ∀ n ∈ Finset.Ioc (N j) (2*N j), ‖coeff j n‖ ≤ 1) →
      (∀ ρ ∈ zetaZeroFinset σ lo hi, ∃ j ∈ J,
        V j ≤ ‖detectingPolynomial (N j) (coeff j) ρ.im‖) →
      (zetaSlabCount σ lo hi : ℝ) ≤ C*B*H^ε*
        ∑ j ∈ J, ((N j : ℝ)^2/(V j)^2+(N j : ℝ)^3*Real.sqrt H/(V j)^4)

theorem zetaSubset_large_values_cover_indexed {ι : Type*} {κ ε : ℝ} (hκ : 0 < κ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (σ lo hi H B : ℝ) (J : Finset ι)
      (N : ι → ℕ) (V : ι → ℝ) (coeff : ι → ℕ → ℂ) (S : Finset ℂ),
      S ⊆ zetaZeroFinset σ lo hi →

      (∀ k : ℤ, (∑ ρ ∈ (zetaZeroFinset σ lo hi).filter
        (fun ρ => ordinateBin ρ = k), (zetaMultiplicity ρ : ℝ)) ≤ B) →
      (∀ j ∈ J, 0 < N j ∧ 0 < V j ∧ H^(1/3 : ℝ) ≤ (N j : ℝ) ∧
        (N j : ℝ) ≤ H ∧ (N j : ℝ)^(3/4+κ) ≤ V j ∧

      (∀ ρ ∈ S, ∃ j ∈ J,
        V j ≤ ‖detectingPolynomial (N j) (coeff j) ρ.im‖) →
      (∑ ρ ∈ S, (zetaMultiplicity ρ : ℝ)) ≤ C*B*H^ε*

declarations.name: smooth_remaining_zeros_have_long_detector
declarations.statement:
theorem smooth_remaining_zeros_have_long_detector {σ δ η : ℝ}

declarations.name: densityCountingEta_margins
declarations.statement:
theorem densityCountingEta_margins {σ ε : ℝ} (hσ : 3/4 < σ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    0 < densityCountingEta σ ε ∧
      8*densityCountingEta σ ε < σ-3/4 ∧ 12*densityCountingEta σ ε < ε

declarations.name: zetaDensityCount_eq_zero_of_one_le
declarations.statement:
theorem zetaDensityCount_eq_zero_of_one_le {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 1 ≤ σ) (T : ℝ) :
    zetaDensityCount σ T = 0

declarations.name: zeta_density_bound_of_weyl
declarations.statement:
theorem zeta_density_bound_of_weyl {σ ε η₀ Cw : ℝ}
    (hσ : 3/4 < σ) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hη₀ : 0 ≤ η₀) (hη₀' : η₀ < 1/48) (hCw : 0 ≤ Cw)
    (hW : ∀ t : ℝ, ‖riemannZeta ((1/2 : ℂ)+(t : ℂ)*I)‖ ≤ Cw*(1+|t|)^(1/6+η₀)) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ T : ℝ, 2 ≤ T →
      (zetaDensityCount σ T : ℝ) ≤ C*T^(2*(1-σ)+ε)

declarations.name: stronger_density_bound_native
declarations.statement:
theorem stronger_density_bound_native {σ ε : ℝ} (hσ : 3/4 < σ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ T : ℝ, 2 ≤ T →
      (zetaDensityCount σ T : ℝ) ≤ C*T^(3*(1-σ)/(2*σ)+ε)

declarations.name: exact_membership
declarations.statement:
theorem exact_membership {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 3/4 < σ) (T : ℝ) (ρ : ℂ) :
    ρ ∈ zetaZeroFinset σ (-T) T ↔
      riemannZeta ρ = 0 ∧ σ ≤ ρ.re ∧ |ρ.im| ≤ T

declarations.name: exact_multiplicity
declarations.statement:
theorem exact_multiplicity {σ T : ℝ} {ρ : ℂ}
    (hρ : ρ ∈ zetaZeroFinset σ (-T) T) :
    0 < analyticOrderNatAt riemannZeta ρ ∧
    (analyticOrderNatAt riemannZeta ρ : ℕ∞) = analyticOrderAt riemannZeta ρ ∧
    analyticOrderAt riemannZeta ρ ≠ ⊤

declarations.name: density_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem density_bound : ∀ σ ε : ℝ, 3/4 < σ → 0 < ε →
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ T : ℝ, 2 ≤ T →
      ∃ Z : Finset ℂ,
        (∀ ρ : ℂ, ρ ∈ Z ↔ riemannZeta ρ = 0 ∧ σ ≤ ρ.re ∧ |ρ.im| ≤ T) ∧
        (∀ ρ ∈ Z, 0 < analyticOrderNatAt riemannZeta ρ ∧
          (analyticOrderNatAt riemannZeta ρ : ℕ∞) = analyticOrderAt riemannZeta ρ ∧
          analyticOrderAt riemannZeta ρ ≠ ⊤) ∧
        (∑ ρ ∈ Z, (analyticOrderNatAt riemannZeta ρ : ℝ)) ≤
          C*T^(3*(1-σ)/(2*σ)+ε)

declarations.name: actual_moment_integrable
declarations.statement:
theorem actual_moment_integrable (a b : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => ‖riemannZeta ((1/2 : ℂ)+(t : ℂ)*I)‖^n) (Icc a b)

declarations.name: twelfth_moment
declarations.statement:
theorem twelfth_moment : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ ∃ T₀ : ℝ, ∀ T : ℝ, T₀ ≤ T →
      (∫ t in Icc 0 (3*T), ‖riemannZeta ((1/2 : ℂ)+(t : ℂ)*I)‖^12) ≤
        K*T^(2+ε)

declarations.name: empty_region
declarations.statement:
theorem empty_region {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 1 ≤ σ) (T : ℝ) :
    zetaDensityCount σ T = 0
